articles.title: AnyCam: Anything Can Represent Camera for Video Generation
articles.content: Camera-controlled video generation re-renders a video along a target camera trajectory, yet moving the camera around an object, the most natural way to change the viewpoint of an object-centric scene, remains difficult. Existing methods condition either on camera parameters, which are scale-ambiguous in monocular video, or on explicit geometry such as warped point clouds or depth, which breaks down under large viewpoint changes. We present AnyCam, a method that represents the camera with an anchor object in the scene: we reconstruct it in 3D and render it along the target trajectory, a camera signal that is scale-aware, view-complete and easy to specify relative to the object. A video diffusion model transfers the content and dynamics of the source video to the new viewpoint. Its H-Concat layout aligns source and target frames in time, so the model can be distilled into AnyCam-AR, a streaming few-step generator for on-the-fly camera control. Both models are trained on paired videos with pixel-aligned anchor renderings from multi-camera videos and static-scene captures. Experiments on diverse datasets and trajectories show that AnyCam performs favorably against camera-controlled video generation and 3D reconstruction methods in camera control and visual quality.

articles.content_zh: 相机控制的相机生成器沿目标相机轨迹重新传送出相机,然而将相机围绕一个物体移动,这是改变以物体为中心的场景观点的最自然的方法,仍然很困难. 现有方法或以相机参数为条件,而相机参数在单相机视频中是相机相模相模相模相模相模相模相模相模相模相模相模相模相模相模相模相模相模相模相模相模相模相模相模相模相模相模相模相模相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相模相相相相相模相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 我们呈现AnyCam,一种在场景中用锚地物体代表相机的方法:我们用3D来重建相机,并让它沿着目标轨迹而成相机信号,这种相机信号具有尺度感知性,可视性完整并易于与相机相对指定. 视频传播模式将源视频的内容和动态转移到了新的视角. 其H-Concat布局能及时对源与目标帧进行对接,因此该模型可以被分馏为AnyCam-AR,这是一个流出数步生成器,用于飞行相机控制. 两种模型都通过多相机视频和静态场景捕捉的像素相通主播渲染进行配对视频培训. 对各种数据集和轨迹的实验表明,AnyCam在相机控制和视觉质量方面对相机控制的视频生成和3D重建方法表现优异.

articles.title: Tracking Any Point with Agentic Visual Reasoning
articles.content: A general-purpose Vision-Language Model (VLM) has surpassed expert vision models in many domains such as object detection and video recognition. However, point correspondence is known to be challenging for VLMs since it goes beyond object-level recognition: it requires pixel-level localization of the same physical surface point across observations, even when appearance changes or the point disappears and later reappears. In this paper, we introduce AgenTAP, a VLM-based agent that directly predicts point coordinates and visibility and actively reasons over videos. Starting from its own estimate, the agent autonomously chooses what to inspect and uses the resulting evidence to verify point identity and refine its predictions. With GPT-6 Astra, it surpasses expert vision models in both point localization and visibility prediction, without correspondence-specific fine-tuning. We further use AgenTAP to re-identify physical points after disappearance and reconnect fragmented tracks, constructing EgoTAP-4D, a dataset of 3D point trajectories in long real-world egocentric videos. On sampled reappearing points, its predictions approach human agreement, and adding EgoTAP-4D to D4RT training improves average 3D tracking performance.

articles.title_zh: 跟踪任何带有代理视觉原因的点
articles.content_zh: 一个通用的视野语言模型(VLM)在许多领域,如物体检测和视频识别,已经超过了专家的视野模型. 然而,对于VLMs来说,点通信已知是具有挑战性的,因为它超越了对象级识别:它需要像素级本地化的同一物理表面点跨观测,即使外观变化或点消失后再出现. 在本文中,我们介绍了AgenTAP,这是一个基于VLM的代理,直接预测点坐标和能见度,以及视频上的积极原因. 从自己的估计开始,该剂自主选择检查什么,并使用由此而来的证据来验证点识别并完善其预测. 有了GPT-6 Astra,它在点定位和能见度预测上都超过了专家的视野模型,没有对应特定的微调. 我们进一步使用AgenTAP在消失后重新识别物理点并重新连接被分解的轨迹,构建了"EgoTAP-4D",这是一款由3D点轨迹组成的数据集,在长而真实的以自我为中心的视频中. 在抽样再现点上,其预测接近人类协议,并在D4RT培训中加入EgoTAP-4D,提高了平均3D跟踪性能.

articles.title: Improving and Expanding Video Editing Capabilities Without Videos
articles.content: Image editing models can follow a wide range of instructions, but video editing models still lag behind, limited in part by the difficulty of collecting paired source and edited videos. Is it possible to transfer advanced image editing capabilities to video editors without new paired videos? We introduce Image-to-Video Transfer (I2VT), which improves pretrained video editors and expands them to new editing tasks using an image editor. It enables efficient post-training with no architectural changes and no new videos, using only individual images. Our key idea is to let the video editor role-play as an image editor: it edits an image as a one-frame video, with the image editor guiding the video editor's predictions at each denoising step. Although the video editor sees only single images during training, at test time it applies the improved and expanded capabilities to whole video clips while preserving temporal consistency. To push the boundaries of video editing, we introduce OpenVE++, an extension of OpenVE-Bench that adds four new editing tasks useful for video production, including action changes, expression changes, body movements, and scene relighting. Our experiments across three different video editors show that I2VT improves existing editing capabilities and expands them to new tasks, and our models achieve state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on both OpenVE-Bench and OpenVE++.

articles.title_zh: 改进和扩大视频编辑能力(没有视频)
articles.content_zh: 图像编辑模型可以遵循广泛的指令,但视频编辑模型仍然滞后,部分受到收集对等源和被编辑视频的困难所限制. 能否在没有新配对视频的情况下将高级图像编辑能力转移给视频编辑?. 我们引入了图像到视频传输(I2VT),它改进了预先训练的视频编辑器,并用图像编辑器将其扩展为新的编辑任务. 它使培训后效率高,没有建筑改变,也没有新的录像,只使用个人图像。 我们的关键想法是让视频编辑器角色扮演作为图像编辑器:它编辑一个图像作为一帧视频,由图像编辑器指导视频编辑器在每个去诺斯步骤上的预测. 虽然视频编辑器在训练期间只看到单个图像,但在测试时,它将改进后和扩大的能力应用于整个视频片段,同时保持时间一致性. 为了推动视频编辑的界限,我们引入了"OpenVE++",这是"OpenVE-Bench"的扩展,增加了4个新的编辑任务,用于视频制作,包括动作改变,表达改变,身体运动,和场景重燃等. 我们跨越三个不同的视频编辑器的实验显示,I2VT提高了现有的编辑能力并扩展到新的任务,我们的模型在OpenVE-Bench和OpenVE++上都实现了最先进的(SOTA)性能.

articles.title: LuxAvatar: Real-Time Relightable Head Avatars via Causal Neural Shading of 3D Intrinsic Proxies
articles.content: We present LuxAvatar, a feed-forward framework for real-time head avatar animation and relighting from a single portrait. To achieve both 3D controllability and complex facial light transport, we factorize avatar synthesis into an animatable 3D intrinsic Gaussian proxy and a causal autoregressive neural shader. This proxy disentangles canonical geometry and reflectance attributes, rapidly rasterizing deformed Gaussians into view- and motion-consistent PBR buffers. Conditioned on these buffers, our neural shader formulates forward rendering as a conditional video diffusion process, bypassing explicit PBR computation to synthesize realistic shading effects under target illumination. We achieve real-time streaming through heterogeneous distillation from a pretrained multi-step bidirectional relighting teacher to a two-step causal autoregressive neural shader, inheriting broad synthetic lighting priors while minimizing conditioning and decoding latency. To further specialize these priors to human heads, we construct a hybrid relighting dataset for domain-specific fine-tuning, capturing authentic facial dynamics and physically grounded light transport. Extensive experiments show that our framework enables 3D-controllable, real-time portrait animation and relighting, outperforming state-of-the-art methods in visual fidelity, motion control, and lighting accuracy.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LuxAvatar:通过3D内相快取的Causal Neural Shading的实时可发光头神通
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍LuxAvatar,这是实时头像动画和从一幅肖像中重新点亮的信号前导框架。 为了实现3D可控性和复杂的面相光传输,我们将可视化的活性合成作为可视化的3D内在高斯亚代用物和因果自相递入神经阴道. 这种代理脱落了犬形几何和反射属性,将已变形的高斯人迅速光栅化为景色和运动相容的PBR缓冲. 以这些缓冲器为条件,我们的神经阴影器将前向渲染作为有条件的视频传播过程,绕过明确的PBR计算,以合成目标照明下的现实的阴影效果. 我们通过不同分泌实现实时流线,从预先训练的多步双向复电老师到双步因果自旋神经遮蔽器,继承了广泛的合成照明前科,同时将调节和解码后期. 为了进一步专门化这些人类头部的前科,我们构建了一个混合重燃数据集,用于特定域的微调,捕捉真实的面部动态和物理上被禁入的光传输. 广泛的实验表明,我们的框架能够实现3D控制,实时的肖像动画和再光,在视觉忠贞,运动控制和照明精度方面表现优于最先进的方法.

articles.title: A Mesh for Every Moment
articles.content: We present MEMO (a Mesh for Every MOment), a method that reconstructs the geometry of complete dynamic scenes, captured by multiple synchronized cameras, and extracts a mesh at every frame. Existing dynamic Gaussian splatting methods either model appearance alone or target isolated objects segmented by foreground masks, and all of them recover meshes by TSDF fusion or Poisson reconstruction, whose fixed grids limit the detail they can capture. At the core of MEMO is a per-Gaussian motion model inspired by Gaussian processes, which represents each Gaussian's position and rotation over time as a combination of temporal Gaussian kernels. The model keeps every Gaussian a valid surface element throughout the sequence and carries an implicit representation of the dynamic geometry, so a mesh can be derived at any time from a field defined by the Gaussians. Although common in real captures, large and fast motion poses a challenge that dynamic Gaussian splatting methods usually overlook. To account for it, we design a track-based initialization scheme that fits each Gaussian's initial trajectory to point tracks in closed form. We evaluate MEMO on Blender-Moments, a new benchmark of nine animated scenes with ground-truth meshes at every frame, and on two real-world datasets. MEMO reconstructs the most accurate geometry among state-of-the-art methods, and remains competitive in novel-view synthesis and training time. Project page: https://memo-4d.github.io
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 每个时刻的网格
articles.content_zh: 我们提出MEMO(一种Mesh for Every Moment),这种方法重建了完整的动态场景的几何,被多台同步相机所捕获,并在每个帧取出一个网格. 已存在的动态高斯滑板方法要么是模式外观单独出现,要么是瞄准被前地口罩分割的被隔离的物体,所有它们都通过TSDF聚变或Poisson重建来取回中子,其固定网格限制了它们能够捕捉到的细节. MEMO的核心是受高斯进程所启发的每高斯运动模型,它代表了每个高斯人的位置并随时间而旋转,作为时间性高斯内核的组合. 该模型使每个高斯人在整个序列中都保持一个有效的地表元素,并带有动态几何的隐含表示,因此一个网格可以随时从高斯人定义的一字段得到. 虽然在真实的捕捉中很常见,但大而快的动作构成了一个挑战,动态高斯滑板方法通常会忽略. 为了说明这一点,我们设计了一个基于轨迹的初始化方案,这个方案适合每个高斯人的初始轨迹,以封闭的形式指向轨迹. 我们在Blender-Moments上对MEMO进行了评价,这是9个动画场景的新基准,每个场景都有地上真实的网格,以及两个现实世界的数据集。 MEMO在最先进的方法中重建了最准确的几何学,在小说视角综合和培训时间上仍然具有竞争力. 项目网页:https://memo-4d.github.io

articles.title: Can image generation help visual reasoning? An empirical study
articles.content: Language models think in words; then multimodal models might think in images. We test whether a generated helper improves the answer to a visual question. A model describes the helper it needs and then answers using the original and generated images together. Across 13 vision-language model and generator pairs, generation lowers mean accuracy by 3.7 percentage points, with declines on nine of ten tasks. Two unified models, BAGEL and Janus-Pro-7B, each lose accuracy on eight tasks. On VSTAR, adding a generated image to the same planning hint lowers accuracy by 10.47 points. Repeated image edits yield different outcomes across tasks. ChartQAPro and MathVista stay below their no-generation baselines, while ERQA gains three points after ten edits.

articles.title_zh: 图像生成能帮助视觉推理吗? 实证研究
articles.content_zh: 语言模型用文字思考;然后多模式模型可能用图像思考. 我们测试一个生成的帮助者是否改善了视觉问题的答案. 一个模型描述它需要的帮助者,然后用原始图像和生成的图像一起回答. 在13个视觉语言模型和发电机对中,一代的精确度下降3.7个百分点,10个任务中有9个下降。 BAGEL和Janus-Pro-7B两个统一型号,各自在8个任务上失去准确性. 在VSTAR上,在同一个规划提示上添加一个生成的图像会将精度降低10.47分. 重复的图像编辑在任务中产生不同的结果. ChartQAPro和MathVista都保持低于他们的"不生成"基线,而ERQA则在十次编辑后得到三分.

articles.title: DynMF2: Rigid Motion Factorization by Expectation-Maximization for Monocular 4D Reconstruction and Motion Segmentation
articles.content: A single casual video leaves a moving scene under-determined: a point seen once from each place can slide toward or away from the camera and still match every frame. We constrain the reconstruction with the structure of the motion itself. Building on DynMF, we model a scene's motion as a handful of SE(3) trajectories, each rigid, and let every point follow one of them alone, never a blend. DynMF2 computes this factorization directly from 3D point trajectories, with no rendering, by Expectation-Maximization (EM). Its M-step fits, in closed form, every rigid motion to the points assigned to it, and its E-step reassigns every point to the motion that explains it with the least error. The background is simply one more motion, the camera's, so no masks are needed. Three tools then revise the factorization: requery adds trajectories where the rendering shows parts the tracker missed, merge joins motions that move together, and split separates those that do not. Thus the number of motions follows the scene. Without masks, DynMF2 clearly outperforms the mask-based baselines in view synthesis on iPhone and NVIDIA and in 3D tracking on iPhone. It recovers what masks leave out, from thin parts and details to small movers far in the background. Its motions segment the moving parts of MOVi-F and iTACO scenes competitively, although DynMF2 is never trained to segment. What moves in a scene is not decided in advance: it emerges from the rigid motions themselves.

articles.title_zh: DynMF2: 单体4D重建与运动分解通过期望-最大分化进行固定运动因子化
articles.content_zh: 单一的随机视频会让移动场景落空:从每个地方看到一次的点可以滑向相机或从相机上走去,仍然与每个相框相匹配. 我们用运动本身的结构来限制重建。 在DynMF的基础上,我们把一个场景的动作模拟成一小撮SE(3)的轨迹,每个刚性地,让每个点单独跟随其中之一,从不搞混. DynMF2直接从3D点轨迹计算出这种因子化,没有渲染,由Expectation-Maximization(EM). 它的M步以闭合的形式适合每一个刚性地运动到分配给它的分数,而它的E步将每一个分数重新分配给以最小错误解释它的运动. 背景只是又一个动作,相机的,所以不需要口罩. 3个工具随后修改了因子化:Requery在渲染显示跟踪器所错失的部分时会添加出轨迹,合并了一起移动的动作,并分拆了不移动的动作. 因此,动议的数量跟随现场。 没有口罩,DynMF2在iPhone和NVIDIA上的视图合成以及iPhone上的3D跟踪中明显地超过了基于口罩的基线. 它能收回面具留下的东西 从薄薄的零件和细节 到小移动器,在背景很深。 它的运动会以竞争的方式将MOVi-F和ITACO场景的移动部位分割开来,尽管DynMF2从未受过分会训练. 场景的动向不是事先决定的:它是从僵硬的动议中产生的。

articles.title: High-Fidelity Image Matting with Pixel-Space Diffusion Transformers
articles.content: Diffusion models have shown strong potential for image matting by transferring generative priors learned from large-scale pretraining. However, existing approaches largely rely on latent diffusion models, whose compressed representations and VAE-based reconstruction introduce a mismatch with the high-frequency precision required for matting. We present PixelMatte, a framework that adapts pretrained pixel-space diffusion transformers for high-fidelity image matting. We show that strong image-conditioned matting capabilities can be acquired even from a pure text-to-image model without paired image-to-image pretraining. Our approach reuses the backbone's native patch embedding to jointly process the input image, trimap, and noisy alpha matte as spatially aligned tokens, enabling direct pixel-space prediction without additional condition encoders or adapters. With pixel-accurate synthetic supervision and real-image fine-tuning, PixelMatte predicts alpha mattes in a single forward pass. Two lightweight calibration modules, LayerShift and High-Pass Refiner, further improve regional opacity accuracy and boundary fidelity. Experiments across four benchmarks and two distinct pixel diffusion backbones demonstrate substantial improvements over existing methods, reducing SAD and gradient errors by 24-44% relative to RenderMatte on P3M-500-NP and AM-2K, while achieving competitive performance on AIM-500 and RenderMatte-2K. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of pixel-space generative priors for precision-sensitive image matting. Project page: https://white-yc.github.io/pixelmatte/.

articles.title_zh: 使用像素-空间扩散变换器进行高纯度图像装配
articles.content_zh: 扩散模型通过转移从大规模预训中吸取的基因前科,显示出图像分解的强大潜力。 然而,现有方法在很大程度上依赖于潜在的扩散模型,其压缩表达和基于VAE的重建导致与交配所需的高频精度不相匹配. 我们提出PixelMatte,这个框架可以调整预先训练的像素-空间扩散变压器,以进行高真实度的图像交配. 我们显示,即使从纯文本到图像模型也可以获得强大的图像条件相配能力,而无需对映图像到图像的预训. 我们的方法重新使用主干线的本地补丁嵌入,共同处理输入图像,三相图,和吵闹的alpha matte作为空间对齐的符号,使得可以直接进行像素-空间预测而无需附加条件编码器或适配器. 通过像素-精确的合成监督并进行真实的图像微调,像素Matte在一次前行通道中预测出α分量. 两个轻量级校正模块"LayerShift"和"高活度炼油"(High-Pass Refineer),进一步提高了区域不透明度精度和边界忠诚度. 跨越4个基准和2个不同的像素传播主干线的实验显示,相对于现有方法,在P3M-500-NP和AM-2K上将SAD和梯度误差比RenderMatte减少24.44%,同时在AIM-500和RenderMatte-2K上实现竞争性能. 这些结果显示了像素-空间基因前缀对于精密敏感图像交配的有效性. 项目网页:https://white-yc.github.io/pixelmatte/.

articles.title: Cairn: Object-Centric 3D Trajectory Priors for Steering Frozen VLAs
articles.content: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) are capable low-level controllers, but they tie where objects go to the layouts they were trained on: when objects are moved or obstacles block the way, they carry them to the wrong place or into collisions. Fine-tuning on new layouts needs robot data for each one and erodes skills the model already has. We introduce Cairn, which keeps the VLA frozen and steers it at test time along learned 3D trajectories of the object in its gripper. A small prior reads point clouds of the scene and the held object, along with its pose when grasped and the instruction, and samples SE(3) trajectories up to its release that lead it around obstacles and turn it to fit through gaps. The prior and the VLA form the two levels of a hierarchical planner in which feedback runs both ways: the VLA's intended motion chooses and reshapes the trajectories, and the chosen one guides the VLA's denoising. Its predicted actions, mapped to the held object's poses through the grasp, are pulled toward the next waypoint, while the VLA's weights stay untouched. Across 1,941 held-out LIBERO scenes with displaced objects and obstacles, Cairn raises the success rate of a frozen π0.5 from 24.5% to 95.1%, above that of a π0.5 fine-tuned on our training layouts, without hurting standard LIBERO. On the third-party LIBERO-PRO benchmark, it raises success from 27.3% to 38.0%, and from 54.4% to 81.1% on the episodes it steers. On a real Franka, with a prior trained purely in simulation, it guides the frozen DROID π0.5 around an obstacle and to a placement at the limit of the arm's reach, where it otherwise fails. All code, models and data will be made public.

articles.title_zh: Cairn:用于指导冻VLA的物体-Centric 3D轨迹
articles.content_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型(VLAs)是有能力的低等控制器,但是它们会将那些被训练到布局的物体捆绑起来:当物体被移动或障碍物挡住时,它们会把它们带到错误的地方或相撞. 对新布局的精细调整需要每个模型的机器人数据,并会侵蚀模型已经具备的技能. 我们介绍Cairn,它使VLA保持了冰冻状态,并在测试时沿着所学到的3D轨迹在它的抓取器上来引导. 一个小的前读点云 场景和被持有的物体, 及其被抓住时的姿势 和指示, 和样本SE(3) 轨迹直到它的释放, 引导它绕过障碍, 使其适应漏洞。 前作和VLA组成了分级规划器的两级,其中反馈通过两种方式运行:VLA的预定运动选择并重塑了轨迹,被选定的一个指导了VLA的去名. 它的预想行动,通过抓取被持有的物体的姿势, 被拉向了下一个方向, 而VLA的分量则没有被改变。 在1,941起LIBERO的场景中,有流离失所的物体和障碍,凯恩将0.5起被冻结的场景的成功率从24.5%提高到95.1%,高于0.5起对我们的训练布局进行微调的场景,而不会伤害标准的LIBERO. 在第三方LIBERO-PRO基准上,成功率从27.3%提高到38.0%,在它所指导的赛事上从54.4%提高到81.1%。 在真正的Franka身上,它以前受过纯模拟训练,它将被冻结的DROID = 0.5绕过一个障碍,并放置在手臂伸入的极限处,否则就失效了。 所有代码,模型和数据都将公开.

articles.title: LiveVAE: Causal Window Attention Makes Efficient Streaming Video VAE
articles.content: While video diffusion models have grown faster and increasingly streamable, the video VAE remains a primary latency bottleneck across interactive generation and editing pipelines. Existing VAEs and their acceleration methods rely mainly on heavy convolutions or full frame attention, and most focus only on decoding, leaving encoding costly for streaming conditional generation and editing. This raises a natural question: Do video VAE encoding and decoding actually require such global spatiotemporal modeling? By analyzing the effective receptive fields of pretrained video VAEs, we find that both encoding and decoding a patch rely almost entirely on its spatial and temporal neighbors. To exploit this strong locality, we introduce LiveVAE, a streaming encoder and decoder built on causal window attention, which cuts per frame compute while keeping the temporal KV cache bounded for streaming. Decoupled encoder/decoder distillation followed by joint finetuning preserves the pretrained latent space, making LiveVAE a drop-in replacement for the original VAE. On MiniMax-H3, LiveVAE achieves 5.2-6.2x faster encoding and 3.0-3.3x faster decoding than the official VAE with higher PSNR. Paired with our dedicated inference infrastructure, LiveVAE pushes the speedup to 13.4x with almost no quality loss. Code and models will be released.

articles.title: Agentic LongLive: Asynchronous Agentic Memory for Long Video Generation
articles.content: Real-time autoregressive video generators stream minutes of video and accept new prompts on the fly, but struggle to keep people, objects, and places consistent over a long interactive story. Agent systems provide such memory for offline multi-shot generation, yet they read the whole script in advance, plan each shot before generating it, and regenerate failed shots, which a live stream does not allow. We present Agentic LongLive, an asynchronous agentic memory for long video generation. A memory agent on separate GPUs reads only the prompts revealed so far, never the generated video, and keeps a text state and evolving images for every person, object, and scene. From this entity memory it composes a global image and a per-shot memory image, which an auxiliary GPU prefills into the generator's attention sink before the next shot starts, and writes entity cards for the prompts that name them, so the video never waits for memory and video errors are not written back. A small language model, trained with reinforcement learning and an image reward calibrated using downstream video outcomes, decides what to remember before the next prompt is known. On LongStory-Online, a new benchmark of 25 stories (857 shots) revealed one shot at a time, Agentic LongLive improves persistent-state accuracy of LongLive-2.0, its base generator, by 26.3 points, protagonist identity by 44.9, and revisited-place consistency by 40.4, at about 1% extra generation time on H100. The full system streams faster than real time on one 8xB200 node with the generator in BF16 (34.3 FPS), keeps image quality stable over 14-minute stories, and improves identity on two MiniMax-H3 generators, one of which, LongLive-H3, also runs in real time with it. To our knowledge, it is the first real-time video generator with text and image memory kept by an LLM agent.

articles.title: ProbFaS: Probabilistic Video Frame Selection for MLLMs via Multi-Fidelity Calibration
articles.content: Processing long videos with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is prohibitively expensive, making informative frame selection essential for accurate video understanding. The default uniform sampling often misses task-relevant keyframes, while recent training-free selectors instead pick frames by how well each one matches the question under an image-text alignment (ITA) score. However, we show that ITA signals correspond poorly with the MLLM's true needs: their rankings correlate weakly with downstream accuracy and are even negatively correlated on over 40% of questions, whereas the MLLM's internal yes/no judgment yields a much stronger signal. We present ProbFaS, a training- and label-free probabilistic pipeline that fuses both signals for key frame selection. ProbFaS treats dense ITA scores as cheap, biased measurements and sparse MLLM judgments as accurate, costly ones, unifying them via co-kriging, a multi-fidelity Gaussian process, to calibrate relevance across all frames. A temporal determinantal point process then selects frames capturing relevance peaks while preserving temporal coverage. Across Video-MME, MLVU and LongVideoBench, ProbFaS is the most accurate among fourteen state-of-the-art training-free selectors and uniform sampling in 13 of 15 settings (8-128 frames), outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 3.1 percentage points. On MLVU and LongVideoBench, 32 ProbFaS frames match or surpass the top baseline at 128 frames and uniform sampling with up to 768 frames.

articles.content_zh: 使用多式大型语言模型(MLLMs)处理长相视频的费用太高,因此信息框的选择对准确理解视频至关重要。 默认的统一采样往往错过了与任务相关的密钥框架,而最近的无培训选择者则根据图像文本对齐(ITA)的分数来选择框架。 然而,我们显示,ITA信号与MLLM的真正需求不相称:其排名与下游准确性关系薄弱,甚至与超过40%的问题有负关联,而MLLM的内部是/否判断则产生更强的信号. 我们提出ProbFAS, 一个没有培训和标签的概率管道, 将两个信号都连接起来,用于选择关键框架。 ProbFAS将密集的ITA分数视为廉价,偏颇的测量,和稀疏的MLLM判断视为准确,昂贵的判断,通过多功能高斯进程(多功能高斯进程)的同心并用,来校正所有帧的相关性. 然后,一个时间决定因素点过程在保留时间覆盖范围的同时,选择捕获相关峰值的框架。 在整个Video-MME、MLVU和LongVideo Bench中,ProbFAS在15个环境(8-128个框架)中的13个中,在14个最先进的无培训选择者和统一取样中是最准确的,比最强基线表现最高可达3.1个百分点。 在MLVU和LongVideo Bench上,32 ProbFa 框架与128个框架和最多为768个框架的统一采样相匹配或超过最高基准。

articles.title: Enhancing Maritime Domain Awareness using Latent Space Representations
articles.content:
This work presents a novel application of Earth Observation (EO) embeddings for Maritime Domain Awareness (MDA) from the perspective of the geospatial foundation model TerraMind. By operating directly on compressed latent-space representations rather than on the original Sentinel-1 imagery, this approach directly addresses the data gravity bottleneck that increasingly constrains operational EO processing, in line with the objectives of the Embed2Scale project. In particular, linear and non-linear probing of compressed embeddings, latent space representations of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery, is used to detect, localise, and characterise vessels from Sentinel-1 GRD images. Vessel detection achieves a ROC-AUC of 0.95, while vessel localisation has a median error of around 300 m for vessels longer than 100 m, and vessel AIS type-code classification achieves 62% accuracy for the majority classes. The latter, however, is highly correlated with vessel length. These results reveal both the potential and current limitations of Geospatial Foundation Models (GeoFMs) when applied to fine-grained MDA understanding in real-world scenarios.
  Additionally, a new maritime remote sensing dataset is released, pairing about 2,000 Sentinel-1 images with temporally aligned AIS signals from commercial vessels. Through manual inspection, each candidate sample was verified for bounding-box quality and for consistency between the AIS-reported vessel length and the observed vessel extent, cross-checking vessel identity and location against publicly available vessel records and, where available, photographs. The dataset was made ready for use with the NeuCo-Bench neural compression benchmark framework, publicly available on HuggingFace through https://huggingface.co/datasets/embed2scale/S1-single-ship-downstream .

articles.title: What a Drop Reveals: Sim-to-Real Material Estimation for Deformable Objects from Video
articles.content: How an object deforms when it hits the ground reveals what it is made of. From a single real video of a drop, we estimate a deformable object's density-normalized stiffness $E/ρ$, and its yield stress $σ_Y/ρ$ when the impact causes plastic deformation, with a feed-forward predictor trained only in simulation. Real videos carry no material labels, so such predictors are developed and validated on synthetic data alone. We show that synthetic validation ranks their geometric inputs in the wrong order. Material acts through 3D deformation, and tracklets lifted to 3D with estimated depth are indeed the most accurate input in simulation. However, on real drops they are the least accurate, and better depth does not repair them: the failure persists with simulator depth in training, LiDAR depth at test time, and exact depth on rendered replays of the real drops. Short 2D optical-flow tracklets do the opposite: they improve nothing in simulation, yet they transfer best. Material is therefore better read from what perception measures consistently in both domains than from what is most informative in simulation. Our predictor, PhysReader, reads the video and 2D tracklets and learns the lift to 3D in simulation by matching a teacher that sees exact 3D deformation. To measure transfer, we introduce PhysReader-Real: 16 everyday objects dropped five times each, with reference materials fit jointly to each object's drops and checked against tensile tests. On PhysReader-Real, PhysReader is closer to the reference materials than every other input and baseline. The one exception is a per-scene optimizer started from PhysReader's prediction, which ends slightly closer but takes 49 minutes per video instead of 12 seconds.

articles.title: FineDex: Bridging Fine-Grained Human-Object Interaction Generation to Dexterous Humanoid Manipulation
articles.content: Dexterity is, at its core, finger-level control, yet existing dexterous manipulation and human-object interaction (HOI) generation methods rarely let one specify how an interaction is performed: five-fingered hands are often reduced to grippers, or finger usage is copied from individual human demonstrations. We present FineDex, a framework that makes finger-level intent both expressible and executable. FineDex learns coordinated human body, hand, and object motions that follow fine-grained instructions on hand selection, individual fingers, and contacts with articulated objects. To bridge generation and execution, FineDex leverages generated interactions as actionable priors for an agent that discovers physically feasible contact strategies through practice in a physics-based digital twin. By adapting at test time without per-instance retraining, FineDex generalizes across fine-grained instructions and object configurations. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art HOI generation quality and fine-grained controllability, substantial improvements in dexterous manipulation success, and successful deployment on a real dexterous humanoid robot.

articles.title: Stranger Things: When Objects Appear Without Their Typical Neighbors
articles.content: Visual context is a powerful cue for object recognition: scenes inform what, where, and at what scale objects are likely to appear. Yet over-reliance on context becomes a failure mode when models predict objects based on their typical neighbors rather than the objects' own visual features, which we call typicality bias. While extensively studied in the pre-Transformer era, it has often been assumed that architectural and scale improvements would naturally solve it, and a systematic diagnostic across the modern vision stack remains absent. We provide such a diagnostic framework. We measure typicality bias via normalized pointwise mutual information (NPMI) over object pairs, and introduce STRANGE-Bench (Synthetic Typicality-RANked Grounded Evaluation Benchmark): a photorealistic, layout-controlled benchmark spanning 17 sub-tiers from typical to never-co-occurring object pairs. Across five model families (specialist detectors, open-vocabulary detectors, self-supervised, vision-language, and multimodal large language models) and three recognition tasks (supervised detection, open-vocabulary detection, and classification), the bias is prevalent: gaps of 5-11 p.p. persist when objects appear outside their typical company, and do not consistently shrink with scale. To mitigate it, we turn to data augmentation: existing augmentations are designed for visual diversity, not for breaking co-occurrence shortcuts, and sample from the very distribution that produces typicality bias. We propose Anchor-Atypicality Sampling (AAS), a simple sampling rule for paste-based augmentations that uses the NPMI signal to tilt the training-time co-occurrence distribution toward atypical partners. AAS reduces the typicality gap by up to 1.6 p.p. on natural-image COCO splits and 23.0 p.p. on synthetic STRANGE-Bench across three model families, without sacrificing overall performance.

articles.title_zh: 陌生人 事物: 当物体出现时没有其典型的邻居
articles.content_zh: 视觉上下文是物体识别的有力提示:场景告知物体可能出现的内容、地点和规模。 然而过度依赖上下文却成为了一种失败模式,当模型根据物体的典型邻接而不是物体自身的视觉特征来预测物体,我们称之为典型偏差. 虽然在过渡前时代进行了广泛的研究,但人们常常认为建筑和规模的改进会自然地解决它,而整个现代视觉堆积的系统诊断仍然缺失. 我们提供了这样一个诊断框架。 我们通过对对象对的常态化点相信息(NPMI)来测量典型性偏差,并引入了STRANGE-Bench(Synthetic Classicity-RANed Grounded Evaluation Birgin):一个从典型对到永不同时发生的17个子级的光现实性,布局控制的基准. 5个模范家庭(专业探测器、开放式活道探测器、自我监督、视觉语言和多模式大型语言模型)和3个识别任务(监督探测、开放式活道探测和分类)的偏差很普遍:当物体出现在其典型公司之外时,5-11p.的空隙就持续存在,而且不会随规模而持续收缩。 为了缓解它,我们转向数据增强: 现有的增强是为了视觉多样性而设计的,而不是为了打破共同发生的捷径, 以及来自产生典型偏差的分布的样本。 我们提出Anchor-非典型抽样(AAS),这是基于粘贴的增强的简单抽样规则,利用国家预防暴力倡议的信号,将培训时间同步分布向非典型伙伴倾斜。 AAS在自然成像COCO分出上将典型差距缩小到1.6p.p.,在合成STRANGE-Bench上缩小到23.0p.,跨越了三个模型家族,同时不牺牲整体性能.

articles.title: Towards Closing the Performance Gap in Cross-Modal Place Recognition
articles.content: Cross-modal place recognition (CMPR) matches natural language descriptions against databases of geo-tagged reference images, enabling localization without visual queries. Despite its potential for language-guided navigation, existing vision-language models lag far behind visual place recognition (VPR) baselines, even after task adaptation. Unlike general-purpose text-to-image retrieval, place recognition relies on subtle local cues to distinguish visually similar locations. We therefore hypothesize that a primary bottleneck in CMPR is capturing fine-grained correspondences between image regions and text details, which requires higher visual token granularity, strong text representation capacity, and local cross-modal matching. To address this challenge, we propose CrossPlace, a two-stage CMPR framework. Stage 1 performs global retrieval by pairing a jointly aligned DINOv2-B/14 visual backbone with a progressively fine-tuned BGE-Large text encoder, while Stage 2 refines top candidates using a lightweight token-level cross-attention reranker. Through systematic analysis, we isolate the drivers of retrieval accuracy and show that visual token density provides the largest performance improvement, while text encoder capacity and task fine-tuning offer complementary gains. To evaluate robustness under realistic conditions, we also extend CMPR evaluation to city-scale and severe weather and illumination settings. Across all existing and new benchmarks, CrossPlace achieves double-digit Recall@1 improvements over prior cross-modal methods, closes the gap to unimodal text retrieval, and narrows it to unimodal VPR. Code and benchmarks are available at https://github.com/oferidan1/CrossPlace

articles.title_zh: 努力缩小跨山地识别方面的绩效差距
articles.content_zh: 跨模式位置识别(CMPR)与地理标记参考图像数据库的自然语言描述相匹配,使得无需视觉查询即可本地化. 尽管具有语言引导导航的潜力,但现有的视觉语言模型远远落后于视觉位置识别(VPR)基线,即使在任务调整后也是如此. 与通用文本到图像检索不同,位置识别依赖于微妙的局部提示来区分视觉相近的位置. 因此,我们假设,CMPR中的一个主要瓶颈正在捕捉图像区域与文本细节之间的精细对应,这需要更高的视觉符号颗粒性、强大的文本代表能力以及本地的跨模式匹配。 为了应对这一挑战,我们提议跨平台,即《议定书》/《公约》缔约方会议的两个阶段框架。 第1阶段通过将一个联合对齐的DINOv2-B/14视觉主干线与一个逐渐微调的BGE-Large文本编码器进行配对来进行全局检索,而第2阶段则使用轻量级的代号级交叉取号来完善顶级候选者. 通过系统分析,我们隔离了检索精度的驱动力,并表明视觉符号密度提供了最大的性能改进,而文本编码器能力和任务微调则提供了互补收益. 为了在现实条件下评价稳健性,我们还将《议定书》/《公约》缔约方会议评价范围扩大到城市规模和恶劣天气及照明环境。 在所有现有的和新的基准中,CrossPlace实现两位数Recall@1比以往的交叉模式方法改进,将差距缩小到单模式文本检索,并缩小到单模式 VPR。 守则和基准见https://github.com/oferidan1/CrossPlace。

articles.title: Focus Only on What's Important: Training-Free Focus Maps for Frozen Vision Transformers in Long-Video Object Segmentation
articles.content: Vision transformers are strong but costly image encoders for video object segmentation. Training-free token merging cuts compute uniformly across the frame, including on tracked objects. We give a frozen DINOv3 ViT inside a trained Cutie head a training-free focus map: full resolution where the segmenter expects its objects and coarser merging elsewhere. Protecting only the previous frame's mask works on short clips but fails on long videos, where fast motion pushes targets outside the margin and into background merging, locking in loss. Our policy instead takes the union of velocity-shifted and block-matched masks, runs a camera-compensated surprise check, delegates uncertain regions to the compared merger, and falls back to it when all objects are lost. On long videos (LVOS V2 valid, pre-specified protocol, three ViT-S seeds), it beats ALGM 0.98 by +2.76 J&F (95% object CI [+1.22,+4.44]; video-cluster [+0.99,+4.52]) at 16% fewer counted encoder FLOPs (0.385 vs. 0.459), sitting 1.0 J&F point below the dense-encoder baseline; at ViT-B the gain over ALGM 0.95 is +3.89 [+2.03,+5.87]. On DAVIS 2017 val it stays within -0.19 J&F of the dense encoder at ViT-S (-0.12 at ViT-B). Controls qualify the result: protecting only the previous mask under ALGM matches or exceeds accuracy at higher FLOPs (0.486), so expectation and surprise mainly reduce counted encoder compute. Practically, lower counted encoder compute did not reduce startup-inclusive mean Cutie step time on a 12-video LVOS sample (3%-8% lower in steady state; an equally engineered ALGM is faster at ViT-S and ViT-B). Section 5.2 separately examines a Cutie permanent-memory schedule and its latency and memory trade-offs. Code: https://github.com/boletoms/focused-cv

articles.title: BOP-Refer: Benchmark for Monocular 3D and 2D Object Grounding
articles.content: We introduce BOP-Refer, the first benchmark for monocular 3D and 2D grounding of everyday and industrial objects sourced from 9 diverse BOP datasets. We pair images from these datasets with VLM-generated and human-verified referring expressions, and derive accurate ground-truth 3D and 2D bounding boxes of the referred objects from their 3D models and 6DoF pose annotations. Our systematic evaluation of 17 frontier VLMs across the major proprietary and open-weight families (Gemini, GPT, Claude, Qwen, Gemma) shows that the best model, Gemini 4 Carbon, reaches 72.6% AP_IoU2D in 2D but only 12.4% AP_IoU3D in 3D, despite the more lenient IoU thresholds in 3D. The predicted 3D boxes are usually centered on the target objects in the image but often off in depth by more than the object's size, suggesting that metric scale estimation, which needs reliable object size priors, is currently by far the main source of error.

articles.title_zh: BOP-参考:单体三维和二维对象定位基准
articles.content_zh: 我们采用BOP-Refer,这是从9个不同的BOP数据集取自的日常和工业物体的单光三维和二维地平地的第一个基准. 我们将这些数据集的图像与VLM生成的和经人验证的引用表达式相配对,并从它们3D模型和6DOF中得出被引用物体的准确地-真实的3D和2D边框. 我们系统评估了17个前沿VLM, 跨越主要的专有和开放重量家庭(Gemini、GPT、Claude、Quen、Gemma), 所预测的3D框通常以图像中的目标对象为中心,但往往被深度超过对象大小而关闭,这表明需要可靠对象大小前身的度量尺度估计目前是出错的主要来源.

articles.title: DocDUR-Net: Degradation-Aware Unified Document Image Restoration
articles.content: Captured document images often suffer from diverse degradations caused by uncontrolled imaging conditions, which reduce readability and obscure fine text structures. Single-degradation restoration methods are usually trained and deployed for individual degradation types, and therefore require model selection before restoration. Unified restoration models alleviate the need to maintain multiple restoration networks by sharing one network across tasks, but representative unified document image restoration methods still depend on external task selection. This dependency limits automatic document image restoration. We propose DocDUR-Net, a degradation-aware unified restoration network that derives restoration guidance directly from the input image. It introduces a Degradation Perception Module (DPM) to extract degradation representations and predict degradation weights, and Degradation Prior-guided Adaptive Feature Fusion (DP-AFF) to combine learnable degradation priors with degradation features extracted from the input. The resulting guidance is injected into a shared restoration backbone, enabling adaptive restoration without external task selection. DocDUR-Net also supports a manual mode with explicit task selection. Experiments on document image restoration benchmarks show that DocDUR-Net achieves the best average PSNR of 29.405 dB and SSIM of 0.960 among unified methods while remaining competitive with single-degradation methods.

articles.title_zh: DocDUR-Net: 降解-意识到 统一文档图像恢复
articles.content_zh: 被捕获的文件图像往往因不受控制的成像条件而出现不同的退化,降低了可读性并模糊了文字结构. 单降解还原方法通常是针对个别降解类型进行训练和部署的,因此在恢复前需要模型选择. 统一恢复模型通过共享一个跨任务的网络来缓解维持多个恢复网络的需要,但代表性的统一文档图像恢复方法仍然依赖于外部任务选择. 这种依赖性限制了自动文档图像恢复. 我们提出DocDUR-Net,这是一个退化意识的统一恢复网络,直接取自输入图像的恢复指导. 它引入了可降解感官模块(DPM)来提取可降解性能并预测可降解性能的分量,以及可降解性能的先导适应性融合(DP-AFF),将可被学习的可降解性前兆与从输入中提取的可降解性能结合起来。 由此产生的指导意见被注入一个共享的恢复主干线,从而能够在不选择外部任务的情况下进行适应性恢复。 DocDUR-Net也支持带有明确任务选择的手动模式. 对文件图像恢复基准的实验表明,DocDUR-Net在统一方法中实现了29.405 dB和0.960的SSIM的最佳平均PSNR,同时仍然与单降解方法具有竞争力.

articles.title: TIDE-Flow: Fine-Grained Temporal Evidence and Structured Displacement Matching for Spike Optical Flow
articles.content: Spike cameras capture high-speed motion through an integrate-and-fire mechanism, providing fine-grained temporal observations without exposure blur. However, their binary streams encode accumulated illumination rather than instantaneous intensity, making reliable motion estimation challenging. Existing spike-based methods exploit temporal aggregation to construct motion representations, but this process may weaken fine-grained firing patterns. Meanwhile, correlation-based estimators often rely on learned matching features without explicitly characterizing the spatial distribution and ambiguity of candidate displacements. To address these challenges, we propose TIDE-Flow, a spike-based optical flow estimation framework that jointly exploits Temporal Integration Evidence (TIE) and Displacement Evidence Encoding (DEE). TIE combines raw spike patterns, multi-scale firing statistics, temporal moments, and boundary-aware interval cues, preserving complementary temporal information before spatial feature compression. DEE further integrates structured candidate-grid features with explicit displacement statistics to characterize matching geometry and competing correspondences. Both components are incorporated into a difference-correlation recurrent refinement framework, enabling effective temporal motion modeling and correspondence estimation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of TIDE-Flow, with controlled ablations validating the contributions of temporal and displacement evidence modeling.

articles.content_zh: 斯派克相机通过集成相和相火机制来捕捉高速运动,提供细纹的时间观测而不会暴露模糊. 然而,它们的二进制流编码积累了照明而不是瞬间强度,使得可靠的运动估计具有挑战性. 现有的以扑克为基础的方法利用时间聚合来构建运动表达,但这一过程可能会削弱精细的射出模式. 同时,基于相关性的估算往往依赖所学到的匹配特征,而没有明确描述候选人员迁移的空间分布和模糊性。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议采用以 " 花 " 为基点的光学流估计框架,共同利用 " 时间综合证据 " 和 " 流离失所证据编码 " 。 TIE结合了原始的悬崖图案,多尺度的起火统计,时间瞬间,和边界意识间隔提示,在空间特征压缩前保留了互补的时间信息. articles.title: Real2SimLab: A Unified Platform for Real-to-Simulation Transfer
articles.content: Real-to-simulation transfer, which builds simulations from real-world observations, has long been studied in research and industry. Recently, coding agents have become capable of generating simulation programs from video recordings, and several benchmarks have been proposed to evaluate them. However, each individual benchmark defines its own inputs, deliverables, and scoring pipeline. This leads to $N \times M$ integrations when evaluating $N$ methods on $M$ benchmarks. To this end, we present Real2SimLab, a unified platform for real-to-simulation transfer. It evaluates a method by running its written program and scoring the output simulation with the original scorer of each benchmark. Moreover, Real2SimLab provides a pipeline to create training data and reward annotations for real-to-simulation methods. Our pipeline carefully avoids data contamination by filtering out the video recordings that exist in benchmarks. For each video recording, a program is first produced, and then our pipeline computes its reward with the same code that Real2SimLab uses for evaluation. So far, it supports 47 coding agents and 5 non-agent methods on 6 benchmarks. Both the platform and Awesome-Real2Sim, our research map of nearly 300 real-to-simulation papers, are open source, and we invite the Real2SimHub community to build them together.

articles.title_zh: Real2SimLab: 真实到模拟传输的统一平台
articles.content_zh: 真实到模拟的转录,从真实世界的观测中构建出模拟,长期被研究和工业所研究. 最近,编码代理已经有能力从录相中生成模拟程序,并提出了几个评价基准. 然而,每个基准都确定了自己的投入、可交付成果和评分管道。 这导致在按百万美元基准评价美元方法时,将百万美元纳入其中。 为此,我们提出Real2SimLab,一个实现真实到模拟传输的统一平台. 它通过运行其书面程序来评价一种方法,并用每个基准的原始计分器来评分输出模拟. 此外,Real2SimLab还提供一条管道,为真实到模拟方法创建培训数据和奖励说明. 我们的管道通过过滤基准中存在的录像,小心避免数据被污染。 每次录相,首先制作一个程序,然后我们的管道用Real2SimLab用于评价的同一种代码计算它的奖励. 迄今为止,它支持47个编码剂和6个基准上的5个非代理方法. 平台和Aweasy-Real2Sim,即我们近300个真实到模拟论文的研究地图,都是开源的,我们邀请Real2SimHub社区共同建造.

articles.title: Probing Visual Idiosyncrasies in Text-to-Image Models
articles.content: Text-to-Image (T2I) models turn short text descriptions into images, and the leading models now produce images of comparable visual quality. Whether their outputs still carry model-specific characteristics matters for attribution, for model comparison beyond aggregate quality, and for evaluations that assume anonymity. We ask whether images from frontier T2I models can still be classified by source, and which visual properties make this possible. Here we show that a standard ResNet-50 identifies the source of an image among HiDream-O1-Dev, FLUX.2-dev, HunyuanImage-3.0, and Qwen-Image-2512, the four highest-ranked open-source models on the Text-to-Image Arena, with 100.00% accuracy on held-out prompts. Human participants reach only 62.61% on the pairwise version of this task, so the distinguishing cues are not visually obvious. They are also not tied to a particular classifier and survive severe image corruptions and out-of-distribution prompts. We trace them to visual idiosyncrasies at three levels. Low-level texture statistics alone let a lightweight multi-layer perceptron match ResNet-50. Object layout, depth, and albedo estimated from the images each carry a source signal. Image captions reveal model-specific preferences in style and background that the prompts never specify. A one-sentence hint about these cues raises human accuracy by 9.03 percentage points. These idiosyncrasies make source classification a tool for measuring similarity between models and between real and generated images, and they caution against assuming anonymity in human preference evaluation of T2I models.

articles.title_zh: 测试文本到图像模型中的视觉特质
articles.content_zh: 文本到图像(T2I)模型将短文本描述转换为图像,现在领先模型产生具有可比较视觉质量的图像. 其产出是否仍然具有特定模式的特点,涉及归属、超出总体质量的模型比较以及匿名评价。 我们询问来自边疆T2I模型的图像是否能够仍然按照源头进行分类,以及哪些视觉特性使得这成为可能. 在这里,我们显示一个标准的ResNet-50在HiDream-O1-Dev,FLUX.2-dev,Hunyuanimage-3.0和Quen-Image-2512中识别出一个图像的来源,这是Text-to-Image Arena上的四个排名最高的开源模型,在被搁置的提示上精确度为100.0%. 人类参与者在这项任务的对等版本上只达到62.61%,所以区分的提示在视觉上并不明显. 它们也不与特定的分类者联系在一起,在严重的图像腐败和分配外提示下幸存了下来。 我们追踪到三个层次的视觉特质 低等纹理统计更是让轻量级多层受体匹配ResNet-50. 从图像中估计的物体布局、深度和反照率都带有源信号。 图像标题会在样式和背景中显示提示从未指定的模式偏好。 有关这些提示的一席之地提示将人的准确度提高了9.03个百分点. 这些特异性使得源分类成为测量模型之间以及真实和生成的图像之间的相似性的工具,它们告诫在人类对T2I模型的偏好评价中不要假定匿名.

articles.title: Diffusion Steering via Adaptive Reward Estimation and Resampling
articles.content: Text-to-image diffusion models can generate images that satisfy complex prompts, yet often produce images that omit requested objects, attributes, or relationships. We ask if models can more reliably generate text-aligned images by redistributing probability toward their more successful outcomes. We propose TrailMix, a training-free method that uses the base model's distribution of possible outcomes to adaptively guide generation toward better text alignment. During denoising, TrailMix generates inexpensive lookahead images from parallel trajectories (trails) and scores their alignment with the prompt using an external judge. The resulting distribution of reward scores allows us to estimate how strongly to steer generation toward a desired alignment level. We use these estimates to reweight and resample trajectories, favoring more promising outcomes. Across three text-to-image benchmarks, TrailMix outperforms existing baselines, with particularly strong gains on rare multi-object compositions. We further extend TrailMix to targeted image editing and introduce SEAM-Bench (Semantic Editing and Attribute Maintenance), a systematic benchmark evaluating whether semantic edits preserve other image content. Experiments on SEAM-Bench and existing benchmark PIE-Bench demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach for controlled image editing. Our results show how a model's own possible outcomes can inform reliable and controllable generation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过适应性奖励估计和复标传播引导
articles.content_zh: 文本到图像的传播模型可以生成满足复杂提示的图像,但往往生成省略所请求的对象,属性,或关系等的图像. 我们询问,模型能否通过重新分配更成功结果的概率,更可靠地生成文本相通的图像。 我们提出TrailMix,一种无培训方法,它利用基准模型对可能结果的分布来适应性地引导生成者更好地调整文本。 在解密期间,TrailMix从平行的轨迹(轨迹)中生成廉价的外观图像,并使用外部判断器将其与即时进行比对。 由此而来的奖励分数分配,使我们能够估计如何有力地引导一代人达到理想的一致水平。 我们利用这些估计来重新加重和再现出轨迹,有利于取得更有希望的结果。 从文字到图像的三项基准来看,TrailMix的绩效超过了现有的基线,在稀有的多对象组成上特别有显著的收获. 我们进一步将TrailMix扩展为定向图像编辑,并引入SEAM-Bench(语义编辑和属性维护),这是一个系统性的基准,评估语义编辑是否保存了其他图像内容. 关于SEAM-Bench和现有基准PIE-Bench的实验表明我们控制图像编辑方法的有效性. 我们的结果表明,一个模型本身的可能结果如何为可靠和可控制的一代人提供信息。

articles.title: Beyond Feature Fusion: Sensor-Grounded Semantic-Spiking Learning for Robust Object Detection
articles.content: Underexposure weakens object details, and overexposure obscures boundaries. Spike cameras encode light into high-frequency binary streams. Long-window spike counts give stable appearance cues, while short observations reveal changes in firing rates from sparse measurements. We propose SPIRE, a sensor-grounded semantic-spiking framework for illumination-robust object detection from a single spike stream. SPIRE builds an appearance view from the full packet through detection-oriented illumination adaptation and constructs a sequence of cumulative views from progressively longer prefixes. Each prefix supplies a rate map, an edge map, and a rate difference that tracks changes as spikes accumulate. At selected scales, ANN features and spike-derived initialization jointly set the initial membrane potentials and firing thresholds, allowing semantic cues to shape the responses during temporal encoding. Local spike-count contrasts supervise both branches during training. The residual between measured and ANN-predicted contrasts combines with the spiking features to produce a bounded correction to the fused feature pyramid. On simulated VOC and COCO, SPIRE-D outperforms the strongest baseline by 4.00-5.50 AP50 points across the four under- and overexposure settings. On real PKU-Vidar-DVS recordings, it achieves 67.07 AP50 and 40.10 AP75. SPIRE-D also uses 50.4% fewer MACs than SPFD.

articles.title_zh: Beyond Feature Fusion: 为强健对象检测而学习感官-圆形语义-跳动
articles.content_zh: 接触不足会削弱物体细节,而过度接触会模糊边界. 斯派克相机将光线编码成高频二进制流. 长窗钉子的计数提供了稳定的外观提示,而短暂的观测显示,从零星的测量中,燃烧率有所变化。 我们提出SPIRE,一个传感器定位的语义活化框架,用于从单一的悬崖流中探测出发光-活性物体。 SPIRE通过以检测为导向的照明改造从全包中构建出外观,并构建出从逐渐更长的前缀中累积的视图序列. 每个前缀都提供一个速率图,边缘图,以及随着悬赏累积而跟踪变化的速率差. 在所选择的尺度上,ANN特性和突起初始化共同设定了初始膜潜能值和发火阈值,允许语义提示在时间编码时塑造出响应. 在培训期间,各地的挂钩比对监督这两个部门。 所测量到的和ANN预想的对比值之间的残存与平起伏的特征结合,对被引信的地物金字塔产生有限度的校正. 在模拟VOC和COCO时,SPIRE-D在四个低暴露度和超暴露度设置上比最强基线高出4.00-5.50 AP50分. 在真实的PKU-Vidar-DVD录音上,它实现了67.07 AP50和40.10 AP75. SPIRE-D也使用比SPFD少50.4%的MAC.

articles.title: Solve Vision with Code: Coding Agents Are Stronger Visual Reasoners Than Video Models
articles.content: Video generation models are increasingly evaluated as visual reasoners: given a first frame and a natural-language prompt, can the model produce the video in which the specified task is carried out? The paradigm is considered advantageous because the reasoning is native to the visual medium, unfolding directly in the frames rather than through language or code. Whether this native route is in fact the more reliable path to visual reasoning has not been tested against a symbolic alternative under the same conditions. We therefore pose the same tasks, with identical inputs, output specification and evaluator, to both media: rather than denoising pixels, a coding agent writes a program that renders the answer video, which an unmodified rule-based evaluator scores. On VBVR-Pro-Bench (Xu et al., 2026), a 500-instance suite spanning five cognitive categories with symbolic ground truth, the agent receives the same first frame and prompt as the video model, with no access to ground truth, metadata or generation models, and one attempt per instance. Three closed-model agents (Codex with gpt-6-astra, Claude Code with Fable 5.1 and Gemini CLI with Gemini 3.1 Pro) score 0.923, 0.894 and 0.893, each more than 0.22 above the strongest video model. Among 23 runnable open-weight models, the best, GLM-5, reaches 0.572, above all video models except the RL-trained one. Together, we show that for tasks whose solutions can be computed from a first frame and a prompt, program synthesis is currently a substantially more reliable route to visual reasoning than video generation. We further distinguish depictive programs, which navigate the image to recover a transferable scheme, from propositional programs, which operate on hard-coded values, revealing how visual reasoning unfolds in agent-written programs and what it implies for its nature of reasoning in general.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 以代码解决视觉: 编码代理是更强大的视觉理性 比视频模型
articles.content_zh: 视频生成模型越来越多地被评价为视觉理性:鉴于第一个帧和自然语言的提示,该模型能否产生执行所指定任务的视频? 范式被认为是有利的,因为推理是视觉介质的本能,直接在框架而不是通过语言或代码进行. 实际上,这种本土路线是否是视觉推理的更可靠途径,还没有在同样条件下通过象征性的替代办法加以检验。 因此,我们向两种媒体提出相同的任务,提供相同的投入,输出规格和评价者:一个编码代理撰写的程序不是去名化像素,而是让解答视频成名,一个没有修改的规则评价者得分. 在VBVR-Pro-Bench(Xu等,2026年)上,代理商获得与视频模型相同的第一帧和即时,无法访问地面真理,元数据或生成模型,每例一次尝试. 3个闭合型特效(Codex有gpt-6-astra,克洛德代码有Fable 5.1和双子座CLI有双子座3.1 Pro)得分为0.923分,0.894分和0.893分,每分都超过最强的视频模型上方的0.22分. 在23个可运行的可开放量级模型中,最优秀的GLM-5达到0.572,更是除RL训练的外所有视频模型. 我们共同表明,对于从第一个框架和即时计算出解决方案的任务来说,程序合成目前是比视频生成更可靠的视觉推理途径。 我们进一步区分了描绘性程序,它导航图像以恢复可转移方案,它与命题程序,它们以硬码值运行,揭示透视推理如何在代理写作程序中展开,以及它对于一般推理的性质意味着什么.

articles.title: HOG-WAM: Improving Visual Robustness through Future Gradient Prediction
articles.content: World-action models jointly predict future observations and actions, yet visual corruption can disrupt the resulting policies. We introduce HOG-WAM, which adds future Histograms of Oriented Gradients (HOG) as structural supervision derived directly from demonstration images. An auxiliary HOG diffusion transformer (DiT) module reads RGB features through asymmetric attention, allowing its objective to shape the visual representation used for control. The module is used only during training and removed at inference, preserving FastWAM's RGB-to-action architecture. We evaluate four controlled observation corruptions through a visual-corruption extension of RoboTwin, termed RoboTwin-Plus; HOG-WAM achieves the highest success among the compared policies under all four. Mixed-noise success increases from 78.86% to 82.86% relative to FastWAM, with comparable performance on clean scenes. On LIBERO Plus, overall success increases from 74.49% to 75.26%, with the largest gain under sensor noise, from 74.14% to 78.89%. Across four Franka tasks, average success increases from 40% to 59% under clean observations and from 17% to 24% under noisy observations. A representation ablation favors combining RGB observations with auxiliary HOG prediction over replacing RGB with HOG. These findings support future-gradient prediction as complementary supervision for visually robust control, with larger absolute gains on physical tasks than in simulation. Code is available at https://github.com/iPPLab/HOG-WAM.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HOG-WAM:通过未来渐进预测提高视觉自强性
articles.content_zh: 世界行动模式共同预测未来的观察和行动,但视觉腐败可能破坏由此产生的政策。 我们引入了HOG-WAM,它添加了未来东方渐变图(HOG)作为结构监督的直接出自演示图像. 一个辅助的HOG扩散变压器(DIT)模块通过不对称的注意来读取RGB的特性,使其目标可以塑造用于控制的视觉表现. 该模块仅在培训期间使用,并在推论中被移除,保留了FastWAM的RGB-to-Action架构. 我们通过RoboTwin的视觉腐败延伸,评估了4起受控的观察腐败,称为RoboTwin-Plus;HOG-WAM在所有四项政策下的比较政策中取得了最大的成功。 相较于FastWAM,混合噪声成功率从78.86%增至82.86%,在清洁场景中的表现相当. 在LIBERO Plus上,总体成功率从74.49%增加到75.26%,在感应噪声下收益最大,从74.14%增加到78.89%. 平均成功率从40%增加到59%, 一个表示偏好将RGB观测和辅助HOG预测相结合,而不是用HOG来取代RGB. 这些结论支持未来渐进预测,作为视觉强力控制的补充监督,在实际任务上比模拟获得更大的绝对收益. 代码见https://github.com/iPPLab/HOG-WAM.

articles.title: WorldExpand: Building Coherent 3D Worlds via Sparse Joint Panoramic Expansion
articles.content: Constructing complete 3D worlds from a single panorama is challenging because large portions of the scene remain unobserved. Existing panoramic-video methods expand spatial coverage through dense sequential generation, but neighboring frames contain substantial redundancy, long trajectories accumulate errors, and independently generated directions may be inconsistent. We present WorldExpand, which formulates single-panorama world expansion as the generation of sparse, complementary, and high-resolution panoramic observations. This representation concentrates the generation budget on informative scene regions and preserves the fine-grained details required for 3D construction. WorldExpand addresses two key challenges: where to observe and how to synthesize. Our Coverage-Guided View Selection identifies informative target locations using scene-adaptive quadrants and warp-based coverage scores, while our Joint Panoramic Diffusion uses Gaussian-splatting-based geometric warps to jointly synthesize four pose-grounded and cross-view-consistent panoramas. A diagnostic-guided global--local attention schedule retains global attention only in sensitive layers, reducing the training and inference costs of high-resolution joint generation. The resulting posed panoramas can be directly fed into an existing reconstruction pipeline to build an explicit 3D representation. Experiments show that WorldExpand recovers content behind occluders and around distant corners, improves both novel-view synthesis and downstream 3D reconstruction metrics across various datasets, and generalizes robustly to diverse in-the-wild scenes. WorldExpand runs significantly faster than the state-of-the-art panoramic-video method while producing higher-resolution observations with stronger cross-view consistency.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 世界扩展:通过Sparse联合全景扩展建设和谐的 三维世界
articles.content_zh: 从单一全景构建完整的三维世界具有挑战性,因为大片场景仍然无人观察. 现有的全景-视频方法通过密集相继生成来扩大空间覆盖范围,但相邻的帧包含大量的冗余,长轨积分错误,独立生成的方向可能不一致. 我们介绍《世界扩展》,它提出单一泛泛世界的扩展,作为稀少、互补和高分辨率全景观测的生成。 这一表述将发电预算集中在信息丰富的场景区域,并保留了3D建设所需的精细细节. 《世界扩展》涉及两个关键挑战:在哪里观察以及如何综合。 我们的"覆盖-引导视图选择"(Speed-Guided View Setch)通过场景调整四分仪和曲面覆盖分数确定信息性目标位置,而"联合全景传播"则使用高斯-镀层-几何曲面来联合合成四个姿势基础和相容的全景. 诊断指导的全球-地方关注时间表只保留敏感层次的全球关注,降低了高分辨率联合生成的培训和推论成本. 由此产生的全景可直接输入现有的重建管道,以建立明确的三维代表。 实验显示,"世界扩展"恢复了占卜器后方和相距遥远的角落周围的内容,改进了小说-视野合成和下游的3D重建度量衡,跨越了各种数据集,并强力地概括到多样化的"万事通"场景. WorldExpand的运行速度大大快于最先进的全景-视频方法,同时产生分辨率更高的观测结果并具有更强的交叉视图一致性.

articles.title: Guidance as Variance Matching
articles.content: Guidance repels the prediction of a diffusion model away from a weaker reference prediction. It substantially improves sample quality, but its mechanism remains poorly understood. We first find that, at the scales used in practice, guidance does not improve the prediction of the posterior mean (the model's training target); it makes the prediction worse, while samples improve. Second, posterior-mean predictions have less variance than the data, and we find that guidance restores it. We introduce variance-matched guidance: a closed-form rule that picks the guidance scale by matching the variance of the guided predictions to that of the data. Without tuning, it recovers the hand-picked scales of eleven widely used models across image, video, audio, motion, and world generation; to our knowledge, no previous explanation of guidance predicts them. Applied per noise level, it yields a schedule without tuned hyperparameters that users prefer to hand-crafted ones on SD 3.5 Medium. Third, we offer an interpretation of the mechanism behind guidance: each model makes a random error in predicting the posterior mean, and guidance rescales the difference of these errors into a sample with the posterior's covariance, which improves sampling. This view also suggests two new hypotheses that our experiments support: guidance can work with negative scales, and guiding a model with its own checkpoint needs a larger scale than guiding it with an independently trained model.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 指导作为差异 匹配
articles.content_zh: 指导使对扩散模型的预测远离较弱的参考预测。 它大大提高了抽样质量,但其机制仍然缺乏了解。 我们首先发现,在实际使用的尺度上,指导并不能改进对后期平均值(模型的训练目标)的预测;它使得预测更糟糕,而样品则有所改善. 第二,后指的预测与数据相比差异较小,我们发现指导可以恢复. 我们采用差异相匹配的指向:一个封闭式规则,通过将所引导的预测与数据相匹配来选择指向尺度. 不调音,它恢复了由11个广泛使用的模型组成的手取尺度,这些模型跨越了图像,视频,音频,运动,以及世界代;据我们所知,之前对指南的解释没有预测它们. 应用每个噪声级别,它产生一个没有调制超参数的调度,用户更喜欢SD 3.5 Medium上的手制. 第三,我们给出了对指向背后的机制的解释:每个模型在预测后方指向时都会发生随机出错,而指向则会用后方的同分力来将这些出错的区别重新分级到样本中去,从而改进了取向. 这种观点还提出两个新的假设,即我们的实验支持:指导可以与负尺度相配合,指导一个带有自己检查站的模型需要比用独立训练的模型指导更大的尺度.

articles.title: CIRKDV2: Cross-Image Relational Knowledge Distillation with Contextual Modeling for Efficient Semantic Segmentation
articles.content: Existing Knowledge Distillation (KD) methods for semantic segmentation often guide the student to mimic the teacher's structured information generated from an individual image. However, they ignore the global semantic relations across various images that are valuable for KD. This paper proposes Cross-Image Relational KD V2 (CIRKDV2), which focuses on transferring structured pixel-to-pixel, pixel-to-region, and channel-to-channel relations modeled from global images in the dataset. A large teacher network often constructs a well-structured feature space in terms of global contextual dependencies. CIRKDV2 makes the student mimic the better structured semantic relations of the teacher, thus improving the feature representational capability. Beyond relational distillation, we further propose contextual feature distillation by using context aggregation to augment student pixel embeddings to match the semantic level with the teacher. This avoids the semantic gap problem between the teacher and student occurred in traditional feature distillation studies. Experimental results on Cityscapes, ADE20K, Pascal VOC, and COCO-Stuff-164K demonstrate that CIRKDV2 outperforms the state-of-the-art semantic segmentation distillation methods by large margins across various network architectures. Our code and pre-trained models are publicly available at https://github.com/winycg/CIRKD.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CIRKDV2: 跨图像关系知识分解与背景建模高效语义分解
articles.content_zh: 现有的知识分解(KD)方法用于语义分解,经常会引导学生模仿老师从个人形象中生成的结构化信息. 然而,它们忽略了对KD有价值的各种图像的全球语义关系. 本文提出跨图像关系KD V2(CIRKDV2),重点是将结构化的像素到像素,像素到区域,以及从数据集中的全局图像所建模的通道到通道关系. 大型教师网络往往从全球背景依赖性的角度构建出结构完善的特色空间. CIRKDV2使学生模仿教师结构较好的语义关系,从而提升了特色表现能力. 除了亲和分馏之外,我们进一步提出背景特征分馏,利用上下文聚合来增强学生像素嵌入,使语义层次与老师相匹配. 这避免了传统特征分解研究中发生的师生间语义差距问题. 关于Cityscapes,ADE20K,Pascal VOC,和COCO-Stuff-164K的实验结果显示,CIRKDV2通过跨越各种网络架构的大幅差幅来超越最先进的语义分解分解法. 我们的代码和预先训练过的模型可在https://github.com/winycg/CIRKD上公开查阅。

articles.title: SceneDesigner3D: Agentic Evolutionary Search for Principled Rearrangement of 3D Indoor Scenes
articles.content: Scene rearrangement is an essential task for 3D content creation applications, requiring generation of diverse, aesthetic and functional scene rearrangements. We present SceneDesigner3D, an agentic evolutionary search method for 3D indoor scene rearrangement that systematically explores the design space of 3D scenes and generates multiple solutions according to common interior design principles. Given an input scene and a text prompt, SceneDesigner3D represents the rearrangement as an editable program and evolves a population of candidate layouts. Starting from distinct design ideas, a VLM agent mutates the programs by refining promising candidates, exploring new rearrangement strategies or redesigning from scratch, while verifying the layouts for physical validity. Proposals are scored by a VLM judge for adherence to the input prompt and satisfaction of design principles such as balance, zoning and emphasis, as well as numerically computed principles such as circulation and clutter. An archive of top-performing, structurally varied candidates further increases diversity of rearrangements. Experiments on the SAGE-10k and SceneSmith datasets show that SceneDesigner3D improves prompt adherence and computed design principle scores over baselines by up to 5.1% and 15.2%, respectively. Code will be made publicly available.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 场景设计者3D: 代理进化 搜索 3D 室内场景的原则重排
articles.content_zh: 场景重排是3D内容创建应用程序的一项基本任务,需要生成多样性,美学和功能性的场景重排. 我们介绍SceneDesigner3D,是一种用于3D室内场景重排的代理演化搜索方法,它系统地探索了3D场景的设计空间,并根据共同的内部设计原理生成多款解决方案. 考虑到一个输入场景和一个文本提示,SceneDesigner3D作为可编辑的程序代表了重排,并演化出一组候选布局. 从不同的设计理念开始,一个VLM代理通过精炼有前途的候选者,探索新的重排策略或从零开始重新设计来改变程序,同时验证物理有效性的布局. 提议由一位VLM法官评分,以确定是否遵守了平衡、分区和强调等设计原则以及流通和杂乱无章等数字计算原则的迅速投入和满意程度。 一批业绩最佳、结构多样的候选人进一步增加了重新安排的多样性。 对SAGE-10k和SceneSmith数据集的实验显示,SceneDesigner3D可以提高快速的遵守率并计算出设计原则在基线上的得分,分别最高可达5.1%和15.2%. 守则将公布于众。

articles.title: Generation as Reverse Encoding
articles.content: Pretrained visual representations accelerate generative learning by abstracting away appearance and spatial detail. Yet the same abstraction makes the return to pixels far harder, shifting much of the burden onto a larger decoder. We ask why the representation-to-pixel path should be learned independently when the encoder already provides a learned pixel-to-semantics path (the semantic encoding path). We introduce RevFlow, based on the principle of generation as reverse encoding. RevFlow uses intermediate representations of a frozen encoder as successive generative targets, first generating deep semantic representations, then shallow representations that retain appearance and spatial detail, before decoding to pixels. To learn these transitions without training a separate generator for each stage, we develop HyC-DiT, a unified generative model with a standard DiT backbone shared across stages and stage-specific condition injection. We further show that native matching in semantic representation space enables few-step generation. RevFlow accelerates both learning and sampling. On ImageNet $256 \times 256$, RevFlow reaches 1.96 FID at 690M and 1.74 FID at 1.55B after only 5 training epochs. It also achieves 30.25 dB reconstruction PSNR with an 89M decoder. After a short native-matching adaptation phase, RevFlow-XL achieves 2.85 FID using a single sampling step in each stage. Our code repository is at https://github.com/ChengShiest/RevFlow
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 生成为反向编码
articles.content_zh: 预受训练的视觉表现通过取出外观和空间细节来加速基因学习. 然而,同样的抽象使得返回像素更加困难,将大部分负担转移到更大的解码器上. 我们询问,当编码器已经提供了已学习到的像素到语义路径(语义编码路径)时,为什么应该独立地学习到代表到像素路径. 我们引入了RevFlow,基于生成原则作为逆向编码. RevFlow将被冻结的编码器的中间表示作为相继的基因目标,先生成深语义表示,再生成保留外观和空间细节的浅相表示,再解码为像素. 为了在不培训每个阶段的单独发电机的情况下学习这些过渡,我们开发了HyC-DIT,一个统一的基因模型,有一个标准的DiT主干线,在各阶段和不同阶段的特定条件注射中共享. 我们进一步表明,在语义表达空间中本土匹配能够产生几步。 RevFlow既能加速学习,又能加速采样. 在ImageNet上,256\times 256美元,RevFlow仅经过了5个训练时代后,在690M上达到1.96FID,在1.55B上达到1.74FID. 它还以89M解码器实现30.25 dB重建PSNR. 经过一个简短的本土相配适应阶段后,RevFlow-XL在每个阶段使用一个单一的采样步骤实现2.85 FID. 我们的代码存储器在https://github.com/ChengShiest/RevFlow上

articles.title: Comparative Study of Deep Learning Architectures for Brain Tumour Classification
articles.content: Accurate and early classification of brain tumours from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is essential for treatment planning, yet many published deep learning studies are trained and tested on small, single-source datasets, reporting accuracies that may not hold outside these datasets. This study compares six deep learning architectures for four-class classification (healthy, meningioma, glioma and pituitary tumour): a baseline convolutional neural network (CNN), an attention-based CNN, ShuffleNet, and EfficientNet-B0, ResNet-50 and Xception augmented with the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM). The models were trained on a corpus assembled from four publicly available MRI datasets. Because these datasets carry no patient identifiers, a leakage-aware pipeline was developed that removes exact duplicates using MD5 hashing (550 images) and near-duplicates using perceptual hashing (8,024 images), and assigns visually similar images to the same fold during 5-fold group cross-validation. A leave-one-dataset-out (LODO) test on a fully held-out dataset was used to measure cross-dataset generalisation. Under a conventional random split, ShuffleNet achieved 97.1% accuracy with 1.2M parameters. Under leakage-aware group K-fold cross-validation, ShuffleNetV2 (98.41%) and EfficientNet-B0 (98.23%) were statistically indistinguishable (paired t-test, p = 0.19), and both significantly outperformed the custom CNNs. On the held-out dataset, accuracy dropped for every model: EfficientNet-B0 generalised best (78.4%), while ShuffleNetV2 fell to 66.2%. Glioma-meningioma confusion was the dominant error mode, and Grad-CAM maps showed that predictions were driven by tumour regions. These results indicate that in-distribution accuracy alone overstates real-world performance and that leakage-aware and cross-dataset evaluation should be reported alongside it.
