articles.title_zh: 脑肿瘤分类深层学习结构比较研究
articles.content_zh: 对磁共振成像(MRI)产生的脑肿瘤进行准确和早期的分类对于治疗规划至关重要,然而许多已出版的深度学习研究却在小型的单源数据集上得到培训和测试,报告强度可能不在这些数据集之外. 本研究比较了四类分类(健康、脑膜瘤、胶囊瘤和垂体肿瘤)的六种深层学习结构:基线神经网络(CNN)、基于注意力的有线电视新闻网、ShuffleNet和高效Net-B0、ResNet-50和Xception,并配有 " 进化分块注意力模块 " (CBAM)。 这些模型接受了关于从四个公开的核磁共振数据集组装的核磁共振仪的培训。 因为这些数据集没有携带病人识别器,因此开发出一条有渗漏意识的管道来去除使用MD5 hashing(550个图像)的精确重复和使用能感知到的hashing(8,024个图像)的近似复制,并在5倍分组交叉验证时将视觉相近的图像分配到同一折叠上. 在一个完全被搁置的数据集上进行了留一数据集(LODO)测试,以测量跨数据集的通论. 在常规的随机分拆下,ShuffleNet以1.2M参数实现了97.1%的精度. 在有渗漏意识的K倍交叉验证组下,ShuffleNetV2(98.41%)和高效Net-B0(98.23%)在统计学上是无法区分的(paired t-t-test,p=0.19),两者的性能都大大超过自定义的CNN. 在被搁置的数据集上,每个模型的精度下降: 高效Net-B0 通用最佳(78.4%),而ShuffleNetV2则下降到66.2%. Glioma-meningioma混淆是最主要的出错模式,Grad-CAM地图显示预测由肿瘤区域所驱动. 这些结果表明,仅分配中的准确性就过分夸大了现实世界的绩效,同时应报告渗漏意识和跨数据集评价。

articles.title: SOLVE: Sparse, Ordered Keyposes Make LLM Agents Versatile and Efficient Robot Manipulator
articles.content: LLM agents have made remarkable progress in robot manipulation, yet they suffer from expensive inference, dense step-by-step control, and tool bottlenecks. We introduce SOLVE, a training-free, versatile and efficient agent policy: a multimodal LLM agent writes a sparse, ordered sequence of 6-DoF end-effector keyposes per call, observes the result, and writes the next, while a motion planner interpolates between them. The agent decides the number and spacing of keyposes for both fast long-range motion and fine-grained manipulation. This granularity matches the sparsity of teleoperated manipulation: most demonstrations in DROID can be compressed into a few keyposes instead of dense actions. SOLVE grounds keyposes with sparse depth queries answered by noisy sources, such as multi-view triangulation, stereo, or monocular depth, and copes with that noise itself. It also improves from execution feedback, reflecting on its own rollouts and distilling a few rules per task. SOLVE reaches state-of-the-art performance of 74.5% on RoboDojo and 84.5% on RoboLab, with only $1.7 per episode on average, 12x less than previous dense-control agent policies. On a real robot, the same agent achieves an 88% success rate (75 of 85 episodes) over 16 challenging zero-shot tasks. Our project page is at https://serenos.github.io/solve-website.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SOLVE: sparse, 有序键盘制作 LLM 虚拟和高效机器人操纵器
articles.content_zh: LLM代理在机器人操纵上取得了显著的进步,然而他们却遭受了昂贵的推断,密集的分步控制,以及工具瓶颈. 我们引入了SOLVE, 一个免费、多功能和高效的代理政策:一个多式LLM代理写着一个稀疏的、按序排列的每通电话6-DoF端效键, 观察结果,然后写下一个结果,而一个运动规划者在它们之间插入。 代理人决定键盘的数量和间隔,既用于快速远程运动又用于精细操纵. 这种颗粒性与电传操作操纵的相匹配:DROID中的大多数演示可以被压缩成几个密钥来代替密集动作. SOLVE用噪音源解答的稀有深度询问,如多视三角形、立体声或单相干深度,并应付这种噪音本身。 它还通过执行反馈有所改进,反思了自己的推出,并提炼出每项任务的一些规则. SOLVE在"RoboDojo"和"RoboLab"上分别达到74.5%和84.5%的先进性能,平均每集只有1.7分,比之前的密集控制代理政策还少了12分. 在真正的机器人上,同名特工在16个挑战性零镜头任务上取得了88%的成功率(85集中的75集). 我们的项目网页见https://serenos.github.io/solve-website。

articles.title: Was the Model Given the Right Action? Auditing and Repairing Action Interfaces in Navigation World Models
articles.content: World models are evaluated by predicting future observations from actions. These evaluations assume that actions are prepared the same way as during training, but an unchecked mismatch can make a model appear less accurate than it is. We audit this assumption in Navigation World Models (NWM) and find three interacting differences between its training and rollout code. Correcting the inputs, without retraining, reduces mean visual prediction error by 42%, measured with DreamSim on the RECON navigation dataset. The correction also changes the ranking of NWM checkpoints in an exploratory analysis and removes or reduces two alternative models' measured advantages. Correcting only the normalization offset instead increases error, showing why interacting mismatches must be checked together. To test whether sensitivity to input preparation extends beyond NWM, we deliberately introduce encoding errors into two alternative models; both become less accurate. We introduce ActRosetta, a tool that checks whether action encoding matches training, identifies supported causes of disagreement, and repairs inputs when sufficient information is available. Repair helps little where predictions barely respond to actions, the tool's diagnosis has limited coverage, and improved control remains unproven. For any action-conditioned world model, the lesson is the same: before reporting rollout error, verify that evaluation encodes actions exactly as training did.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 模式是否赋予了正确的行动? 导航世界模型中的审计和修复行动接口
articles.content_zh: 通过预测未来对行动的观察来评估世界模型。 这些评价假定,行动是在培训期间以同样的方式准备的,但不加控制的不匹配会使模型看起来不如实际准确。 我们在导航世界模型(NWM)中审计这一假设,发现其培训和推出代码之间存在三个相互作用的差异. 校正输入,不进行再培训,在RECON导航数据集上用DreamSim测量,将平均视觉预测误差减少42%. 更正还改变了NWM检查站在探索性分析中的排名,并去除或减少两个备选模式的衡量优势。 只纠正正常化反而会增加出错,表明为什么必须一起检查相互作用的不匹配。 为了测试对输入制备的敏感度是否超越了NWM,我们特意将编码错误引入了两个替代模型;两者都变得不太准确. 我们提出《罗塞塔法案》,这是一个工具,用以检查行动编码是否与培训相匹配,查明出现分歧的辅助原因,并在获得足够信息时修复投入。 修复对于预测几乎无法响应动作的地方帮助不大,工具的诊断范围有限,改进的控制仍未得到证实. 对于任何有行动条件的世界模式,教训是一样的:在报告推出错误之前,核实评价对行动的编码与培训完全一样。

articles.title: WorldInteract: Controllable Streaming Video Generation for Multi-Material Interactions
articles.content: Video world models aim to create interactive physical worlds that capture how diverse materials move and interact. Yet material-dependent dynamics remain underexplored in controllable video generation, limiting reliable control in scenes with different materials. We present WorldInteract, a streaming video generation framework that decomposes cross-material interaction into material-dependent behavior generation and contact response computation. External pushes and contact impulses are expressed through a shared velocity-increment interface, allowing material behaviors learned from interaction-free videos to be reused in interacting scenes. A physics controller predicts contacts and computes velocity increments from estimated masses and restitution coefficients, while a causal generator executes these increments using learned material behaviors. This separation enables cross-material interaction without supervised contact videos spanning diverse material pairings and contact configurations. We train the generator on 30k simulated interaction-free videos spanning 22 material classes and introduce Material-Aware RL, using verifiable physical rewards to refine material behavior and control execution. WorldInteract substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods on Physics-IQ and delivers more reliable push control on real-world images.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: World Interact:用于多元交互的可控流视频生成
articles.content_zh: 视频世界模型旨在创造互动物理世界,捕捉出不同材料如何移动和互动. 然而,依赖材料的动态在可控视频生成方面仍然没有得到充分利用,限制了对不同材料的场景的可靠控制. 我们介绍World Interact,一个流动的视频生成框架,将跨材料交互分解成依赖材料的行为生成和接触响应计算. 外推和接触冲动通过共享速度-增量界面来表达,使得从无互动视频中吸取的物质行为可以在互动场景中被再用. 物理控制器会预测接触并从估计质量和还原系数中计算出速度递增,而因果发生器则利用所学的材料行为执行这些递增. 这种分离可以实现跨材料交互,而无需监督的接触视频,涵盖不同的材料配对和接触配置。 我们训练发电机使用30k模拟无相互作用视频,这些视频跨越22个材料类,并采用材料-Aware RL,利用可核查的物理奖励来完善材料行为和控制执行. World Interact在物理-智商方面大大超越了最先进的方法,对现实世界的图像提供了更可靠的推力控制.

articles.title: LiDAR Intensity Reconstruction with Limited Real Data: An Architecture Benchmark under Fixed-Epoch Training
articles.content: Physics-derived simulation can supplement scarce real-world LiDAR intensity measurements, but its effectiveness depends on the learning architecture and the amount of real training data available. We benchmark nine neural architectures for LiDAR intensity reconstruction from depth, semantic labels, incidence angle, and material reflectance, using real SemanticKITTI and synthetic VoxelScape range-image data. All models follow a fixed 20-epoch protocol; this controls the number of training passes, not the computational cost across architectures. We report mean absolute error (MAE), mean squared error (MSE), peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), structural similarity (SSIM), inference timing, and spectral-energy agreement. We also evaluate four selected architectures with fixed-size training mixtures containing 0\%, 1\%, 5\%, 10\%, 20\%, 50\%, or 100\% real frames. With real-only training, UNet-V2 achieves the best reported reconstruction metrics (MAE 0.234, MSE 0.140, PSNR 8.64 dB, and SSIM 0.647), followed by a denoising diffusion model (DDPM). In several mixtures containing 1--10\% real data, DDPM achieves lower error and higher image-quality metrics than the evaluated deterministic alternatives, whereas UNet-V2 leads with 100\% real data. Spectral analysis additionally reveals architecture-dependent discrepancies across frequency bands. These findings characterize reconstruction trade-offs under the stated data mixtures and fixed-epoch protocol, without establishing compute-matched superiority or isolating the diffusion objective from backbone differences.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LiDAR 利用有限真实数据进行密集重建:固定设备培训下的建筑基准
articles.content_zh: 物理派生的模拟可以补充稀缺的现实世界的LiDAR强度测量,但其有效性取决于学习架构和可获得的实际培训数据的数量. 我们利用真实的SemanticKITTI和合成的VoxelScape射程-图像数据,从深度,语义标签,事件角度,和物质反射等角度,为LiDAR强度重建设定了9个神经架构的基准. 所有模型都遵循一个固定的20世纪协议;这控制了训练通行证的数量,而不是整个架构的计算成本. 我们报告指绝对出错(MAE)、正方形出错(MSE)、峰值信号-噪音比(PSNR)、结构相似性(SSIM)、推断时间和光谱-能协议。 包括0-Q、1-X、5-X、10-X、20-X、50-X或100-X等真实框架。 UNet-V2通过实事求是的培训,实现了最佳的被报道的重建度量衡(MAE 0.234,MSE 0.140,PSNR 8.64 dB,和SSIM 0.647),并接踵而来的是去名扩散模型(DDPM). 在包含1-----++真实数据的若干混合物中,DDPM比评价的确定性替代品实现更低的误差和更高的图像质量度量,而UNet-V2则领先于100++真实数据. 光谱分析还揭示了不同频段之间结构依赖性的差异. 这些调查结果是所述数据混合物和定时协议下的重建取舍的特点,没有确定计算比对的优越性或将扩散目标同骨干差异相隔离。

articles.title: Reading, Not Adapting: Unlocking Frozen Visual Knowledge for AI-Generated Image Detection
articles.content: Generalization to unseen image generators has driven efforts to adapt pretrained visual representations for detection. Yet recent findings show that vision foundation models already encode transferable detection knowledge, while further adaptation can impair generalization. This motivates a shift from backbone adaptation to knowledge readout. Conventional linear probing offers a direct way to read this knowledge but is limited to final-layer RGB features. Multi-cue detectors broaden the evidence base, but their designs introduce other tradeoffs: adaptation may compromise pretrained transferability, heterogeneous encoders complicate feature integration, and late fusion precludes intermediate cross-view interaction. To overcome these limitations, we propose ReMoT, a Mixture-of-Transformers-inspired framework that reads complementary knowledge from spatially aligned RGB and wavelet views within a fully frozen visual foundation. ReMoT employs staged joint attention to enable controlled local and global cross-view interaction, while learnable fusion queries progressively read complementary evidence across Transformer depth without writeback. ReMoT achieves 91.2% average accuracy across eight benchmark groups with 3,074 trainable parameters, attaining the highest overall average among the evaluated methods. These results support structured knowledge readout as a promising alternative to backbone adaptation. Code is available at https://github.com/yunncheng/ReMoT.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 阅读, 不适应: 解锁可视知识用于 AI- Generated 图像检测
articles.content_zh: 通俗化到看不见的图像生成器推动了调整预先训练的视觉表现以用于检测的努力。 然而,最近的调查结果表明,愿景基础模型已经编码了可转让检测知识,而进一步调整则会妨碍一般化。 这促使人们从骨干适应转向知识阅读。 常规线性探测为读取这一知识提供了直接途径,但仅限于最后一级RGB特征. 多管探测器拓宽了证据基础,但其设计引入了其他取舍:适应可能损害被预先训练的可转移性,多管编码器使特征集成复杂化,而后聚变排除了中间跨视相互作用. 为了克服这些限制,我们提议ReMOT,一个“转换器”启发式框架,从空间一致的RGB和完全被冻结的视觉基础上的波浪观点读取补充知识。 ReMOT利用了阶段性的联合关注来使受控的局部和全球交叉视图互动成为可能,而可学习的聚变查询则在不回写的情况下逐渐读取跨变形器深度的补充证据. ReMOT在有3 074个可训练参数的8个基准组中实现了91.2%的平均精度,达到评价方法中最高的总平均值。 这些成果支持有条理地阅读知识,作为骨干适应的一种有希望的替代办法。 代码见https://github.com/yunncheng/ReMoT.

articles.title: Effect of class proportion shifts on classifier curvature
articles.content: Changing the class mix can alter mean loss without changing the classifier. To distinguish this reweighting from changes in the model itself, we studied ten-class CIFAR-10 classification in separate branches for two target classes, measuring the trace of the loss Hessian with respect to the output-layer parameters on fixed images of each target class. Across ten new initialisations, after 60 updates to the output layer with frozen features, the trace changed by -0.152% on average in branches where the target class share rose from 10% to 19%, and by +0.071% in branches where it fell to 1%, relative to each branch's initial trace. These changes do not isolate the effect of class share from that of the assigned training images. We developed a forecast based on initial class gradients after examining the first experiment's results and then tested it prospectively without modification. For direct increases from 10% to 19%, rather than increases after a deficit, its mean absolute error was 0.022 percentage points on the initial-trace scale, compared with 0.152 for a zero-change forecast and 0.104 for equally weighted gradients. Using the assigned class proportions improved the forecast of how much the trace would change.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 类别比例变化对分类器曲率的影响
articles.content_zh: 改变类组合可以改变平均损失而不改变分类器. 为了将这种再加权与模型本身的变化区分开来,我们分两个目标类分别研究了十类CIFAR-10分类,就每个目标类的固定图像上输出层参数衡量损失的痕迹. 在10个新的初始化中,经过60个更新,输出层具有冷冻特征后,目标类份额从10%上升到19%的分支的微量平均变化为-.152%,与每个分支的初始微量相比,在下降至1%的分支中的微量变化为+0.071%。 这些变化并不将班级共享的效果与指定培训图像的效果相隔离. 我们在检查了第一次实验的结果之后,根据初始的分级梯度制订了一个预测,然后在不作修改的情况下对结果进行预测。 对于从10%直接增加到19%,而不是在赤字后增加,其平均绝对误差在初始轨距为0.022个百分点,而零变化预测为0.152个百分点,加权梯度相同为0.104个百分点。 使用分配的类别比例改进了对追踪将改变多少的预测。

articles.title: Seeing the Right Context: Grounded On-Policy Distillation for Remote Sensing
articles.content: Remote sensing scene understanding requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to interpret queried targets in relation to nearby objects and surrounding structures, which serve as spatial references or define the scope of an answer. However, standard answers and bounding boxes often leave these contextual relationships implicit. Thus, we construct GeoContext-5K to make them explicit in 5,394 training pairs for visual question answering (VQA), with spatial cues, visual facts, and supporting regions. GeOPD uses these annotations for on-policy distillation, guiding a frozen teacher with region marks on the full image and a visual fact while preserving surrounding spatial references. It prioritizes teacher corrections that agree with the shift in the student's next token distribution when evidence is restored. A complementary objective weights the contrast between the student's scores on the two views by how much masking lowers the teacher's log probability for the same sampled token. Experiments on five remote sensing VQA benchmarks show that GeOPD outperforms the evaluated open-source MLLMs and matched post-training baselines, improving over the 4B and 9B base models by 5.81 and 2.97 percentage points on average. The dataset and code will be publicly released at https://github.com/YeeCharm/GeOPD.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 二. 了解正确的背景:遥感的政策问题
articles.content_zh: 遥感场景理解要求多模式大型语言模型(MLLMs)对所询问的目标与相邻的物体和周围结构进行解释,作为空间参考或界定答案的范围. 然而,标准答案和边框往往使这些背景关系隐含. 因此,我们构建了GeoContext-5K,在5,394个可进行视觉问答的训练对中明确它们,并附有空间提示、视觉事实和支持区域。 GeOPD使用这些说明进行政策分解,指导被冷冻的老师在保存周围空间参考物的同时,在全图像和视觉事实上带有区域标记. 它优先考虑那些同意学生在证据被恢复后下一个符号分配的转变的教师矫正. 一个互补的客观权衡了学生在两种观点上的分数对比,通过遮掩多少降低了老师对同一被采样的令牌的日志概率. 关于5个遥感VQA基准的实验表明,GeOPD的绩效超过了评估的开源MLLM,并匹配了培训后的基线,比4B和9B的基准模型平均提高了5.81和2.97个百分点. 数据集和代码将在https://github.com/YeeCharm/GeOPD上公开发布.

articles.title: ShowNow: Fine-Grained Speculative Streaming for Responsive World Models
articles.content: Interactive world models must generate video continuously while responding promptly to user actions. Real-time throughput alone leaves input latency unresolved: coarse generation blocks delay action updates, and generation after input adds work to the response path. We introduce ShowNow, a fine-grained speculative streaming framework that uses computation available during playback to prepare action-conditioned futures before input arrives. Single-latent commitment enables frequent decisions, while configurable preparation covers one to eight actions. We construct a matched multi-future dataset to train alternative continuations from a common state; shared-history tree execution and fused commitment make their preparation efficient. On a single H100, our 5B model sustains 480p generation at 16 fps with eight prepared futures. In ViZDoom, the complete ShowNow deployment reduces median input-to-display latency from 620 to 208 ms relative to the native-block SolarWM-FT deployment. Matched-policy experiments reduce restart empty ticks from 1.56% to 0.09% (94%) and improve on-time responses to action changes. These results establish complementary roles for fine-grained commitment and advance preparation, with measured trade-offs in visual fidelity and long-horizon consistency. ShowNow turns playback-time computation into responsive visual interaction. Project: https://github.com/showlab/ShowNow.

articles.title_zh: 现出:精细分辨的分光流,用于响应世界模式
articles.content_zh: 互动的世界模式必须不断生成视频,同时迅速回应用户的行动。 仅实时吞吐量就留下了输入延迟未解决的问题:粗体生成块会延迟动作更新,输入后生成会给响应路径添加工作. 我们引入了ShowNow(ShowNow),一个精细的投机流线框架,它使用在回放时可用的计算,在输入到来之前准备有行动条件的未来. 单方承诺可以经常作出决定,而可描述的准备涵盖一至八项行动。 我们构建一个匹配的多未来数据集,从一个共同状态来训练替代的续作;共享历史树的被执行和被融合的承诺使得其编写效率高. 在单一的H100上,我们的5B模型维持了480p的生成量为16fps,并有8个备好的未来. 在"ViZDoom"中,ShowNow的完整部署相对于本土块"SolarWM-FT"的部署,将中位输入-播放后置从620米降低到208米. 相匹配的政策实验将重启的空勾从1.56%减少到0.09%(94%)并改进对动作变化的实时响应. 这些成果为精细承诺和预先准备确立了互补作用,在视觉忠诚和长期一致性方面进行了权衡取舍。 ShowNow将回放时的计算转换为响应视觉交互. 项目:https://github.com/showlab/SshowNow。

articles.title: Find the Clue, Not the Scene: Rethinking Reasoning for Entity Recognition in Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Answering a knowledge-based visual question requires first recognizing the entity in the image and then recalling knowledge about it. Thinking vision-language models (VLMs) reason for thousands of tokens before answering, yet it remains underexplored how well such thinking VLMs perform each of these two steps. We therefore analyze thinking VLMs on this task and make two key observations. (1) Recognition is the bottleneck, since 76.3% of errors across four models on ViQuAE stem from misrecognizing the entity, and 84.9% of these failures are resolved once the entity name is provided in the question. (2) Recognition is driven by entity-recall clues rather than by general descriptions of the image. An entity-recall clue is a distinctive visual detail that helps the model recall the entity, such as keys, a traditional attribute of Saint Peter. Based on these findings, we propose ClueRL, a reinforcement learning approach that extends Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with an advantage localized to the entity-recall clue in the thinking trace. Rather than injecting new entity knowledge, ClueRL changes how VLMs think: it leads them to attend more closely to visual details and spot these clues, helping them use the knowledge they already have. Consequently, it outperforms both GRPO and a perception-reward baseline on three entity recognition benchmarks. Moreover, this clue-seeking behavior generalizes beyond entity recognition, the only task used for training. Since recognition is the bottleneck, the gains carry over to knowledge-based visual question answering. They even extend to general multimodal reasoning, raising Qwen3.5-4B by 4.4 and 4.0 points on the ScienceQA and MMMU subsets of MMStar, respectively.

articles.title_zh: 寻找 Clue 而不是场景: 在视觉语言模型中重新思考实体识别的理由
articles.content_zh: 回答一个以知识为基础的视觉问题,首先需要识别图像中的实体,然后回顾有关它的知识. 思考视觉语言模型(VLMs)在回答前有上千个符号的理由,然而,对于这种思考的VLMs在这两步中的每一个步都表现得多么好,仍然没有得到充分的探讨. 因此,我们分析关于这项任务的自愿多数意见,并提出两项关键意见。 (1) 承认是瓶颈,因为ViQuAE上四个模型的76.3%的错误源于对该实体的误解,在问题中提供实体名称后,84.9%的失误得到解决。 (2) 识别是由实体召回线索驱动,而不是由图像的一般描述所驱动. 一个实体召回的线索是一个独特的视觉细节,可以帮助模型召回实体,如钥匙,这是圣彼得的传统属性. 基于这些发现,我们提出ClueRL,一种强化的学习方法,将Group相对政策优化(GRPO)扩展,具有本地化的优势,在思维跟踪中可被实体召回线索. ClueRL 与其注入新的实体知识,不如改变VLMs的思维方式:它引导他们更密切地关注视觉细节并发现这些线索,帮助他们使用他们已经掌握的知识. 因此,它的业绩优于《全球业绩评估》和三个实体确认基准的感知回报基线。 此外,这种寻线索行为概括到实体识别之外,是唯一用于培训的任务. 由于承认是瓶颈,收益转而以知识为基础的视觉问题回答。 它们甚至扩展到一般多式推理,在MMStar的ScienceQA和MMMU子集上分别以4.4分和4.0分提高了Quen3.5-4B.

articles.title: Neural Rendering Compiler: Generative Video Models as Programmable Renderers
articles.content: Generative video models are becoming powerful renderers, yet lack the predictable control interfaces of conventional systems such as HTML/CSS engines or Blender. Their capabilities emerge implicitly from training, making it difficult to determine what they can reliably execute. We present Neural Rendering Compiler (NeurCo), which automatically probes frozen video models to construct model-specific capability manuals describing which semantic requirements they can reliably satisfy. NeurCo represents user intent in a model-agnostic intermediate representation of objects, constraints, events, and cameras, then compiles it into model-specific execution strategies. Reliable requirements remain unchanged, while unreliable ones are selectively rewritten or compiled into alternative execution strategies. We introduce VComBench, a benchmark of 380 compositional, multi-requirement tasks spanning text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video generation. NeurCo improves requirement satisfaction from 46.8% to 52.3% on Wan and from 66.5% to 69.3% on Minimax H3, and achieves further gains when combined with prompt enhancers, including on Seedance 2.5. Our analysis reveals model-specific differences in control capabilities and trade-offs between controllability and photorealism, highlighting capability-guided compilation as a promising approach to programmable generative video rendering.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 神经渲染编译器:作为可编程渲染器的基因视频模型
articles.content_zh: 基因视频模型正在成为强大的渲染器,但缺乏HTML/CSS引擎或Blender等常规系统的可预见控制接口. 他们的能力从培训中隐含地产生,因此难以确定他们能够可靠地执行什么。 我们介绍神经渲染编译器(英语:Neural Rendering Compiler (NeurCo)),它自动探测被冻结的视频模型来构建模型特定的能力手册,描述哪些语义要求可以可靠地满足. NeurCo在对对象,约束,事件,相机的模型不可知的中间表示中代表了用户的意向,然后将其汇编成模型特定执行策略. 可靠的要求保持不变,而不可靠的要求则有选择地被改写或汇编成替代执行战略。 我们引入了VCom Bench, 一个由380个组成,多要求任务构成的基准, 跨越了文本到视频,图像到视频, 和参考到视频生成。 NeurCo将Wan的需求量满意度从46.8%提高到52.3%,而Minimax H3的满意度从66.5%提高到69.3%,如果与快速增强器相结合,包括在种子2.5上,就能取得进一步的收益。 我们的分析显示,可控性和光现实性之间在控制能力和取舍方面的模型差异,突出了能力指导汇编是可编程基因视频渲染的一种有希望的方法。

articles.title: RoboEvo$^2$: Recursive Robot Self-Improvement via Harness-Policy Co-Evolution
articles.content: Robots should adapt to unfamiliar environments and acquire new skills through interaction, then execute those skills efficiently with practice. Vision-language-action policies provide efficient control, but often need additional human demonstrations to handle unfamiliar settings; reasoning agents can discover solutions using broad prior knowledge and robot-control APIs, but repeated deliberation and repair are costly. Inspired by human learning through reasoning and practice, we propose RoboEvo$^2$, a framework for recursive harness-policy co-evolution. In Policy-to-Harness (P2H) evolution, policy failures guide a coding agent to search complementary Code, Code+ICL, and Code+Policy routes, consolidating verified solutions into reusable skills, routing strategies, and experience memory. In Harness-to-Policy (H2P) evolution, verified trajectories provide supervised training, while Counterfactual Preference Distillation (CPD) teaches the policy to favor successful corrections over failures from the same starting state. The improved policy provides stronger motor skills for subsequent search, while its remaining failures redirect harness evolution, closing the reciprocal loop. Through recursive co-evolution without additional human demonstrations, RoboEvo$^2$ improves standalone success from 11.0% to 84.1% and hybrid success from 30.4% to 90.5% on LIBERO-PRO, with similar gains and reduced agentic costs on RoboTwin C2R. Further experiments demonstrate autonomous task acquisition, cross-embodiment harness transfer, and 95.0% hybrid success on the Unitree G1-D. Our models and code will be publicly released.

articles.title_zh: RoboEvo$^2$:通过Harness-Political Co-Evolution递解机器人自我改进
articles.content_zh: 机器人应当适应不熟悉的环境,通过互动获得新技能,然后通过实践高效地运用这些技能。 视觉语言动作政策提供了高效的控制,但往往需要额外的人类演示来处理不熟悉的环境;推理代理人可以利用广泛的先行知识和机器人控制API来发现解决方案,但反复的考虑与修复费用高昂. 在人类通过推理和实践学习的启发下,我们提议采用RoboEvo$^2美元,作为循环利用政策共同演变的框架。 在"从政策到Harness"(P2H)演化中,政策失败引导一个编码代理搜索互补代码,代码+ICL,和代码+政策路径,将已核实的解决方案整合为可再用技能,路由策略,并体验记忆. 在Harness-to-Political (H2P) 演化中,被验证的轨迹提供有监督的培训,而反事实偏好分化(CPD)则教导政策有利于成功的校正而不是来自同一起始状态的失败. 改进后的政策为以后的搜索提供了更强的机动技能,而其剩余的故障则重新引导了利用进化,关闭了对等循环. RoboEvo$^2美元通过在不增加人类示威的情况下的递归共进,使单项成功率从11.0%提高到84.1%,而混合成功率从30.4%提高到90.5%,RoboTwin C2R的代理成本也随之降低。 进一步实验证明自主任务获取,交叉化活化管转移,Unitree G1-D上的混合成功率为95.0%. 我们的模型和代码将公开发布。

articles.title: Counting Beyond Frames: Codec Motion Tells Frozen Diffusion VLMs How Many
articles.content: Counting how many times something happens is among the simplest questions about a video and among the hardest for video-language models, autoregressive and diffusion alike. The difficulty lies between the frames: a model samples only a few of them, while each repetition unfolds as movement in between. Video codecs already record this movement densely as block displacements, and codec-based video models use it to shape their visual input. We are the first to show that this motion provides direct evidence for the count: a candidate count is a testable motion hypothesis, and unwinding the cycles it implies measures how strongly the observed directions support it. We present CoDiCount, a unified training-free framework that turns this test into a count potential and applies it while a frozen diffusion vision-language model (dVLM) denoises its answer. At every denoising step, structured count messages map each option letter, or each grammar-valid edit of an open integer, to the count it expresses and reweight the model's own probabilities within that set. Consistent gains over the official decoders on MotionBench, TOMATO, and SVCBench demonstrate the broad generalization of CoDiCount across diffusion models, datasets, and diverse counting tasks. With CoDiCount, a 7B dVLM outperforms GPT-5.1 and Gemini-2.5-Pro on MotionBench, surpasses GPT-4o and much larger open models on TOMATO, and matches GPT-5.4 on SVCBench.

articles.title_zh: 计算框架之外: 代码运动告诉冻散 VLMs 有多少
articles.content_zh: 数数事物发生多少次是最简单的视频问题, 难度在于帧之间:一个模型只取出其中的几个样本,而每一次重复作为运动在两者之间展开. 视频解码器已经记录了这种运动作为块位迁移的密集程度,基于解码器的视频模型用它来塑造他们的视觉输入. 我们首先表明,这项动议为计数提供了直接证据:候选人计数是一种可测试的运动假设,并且解除其意味着衡量所观察到的方向对它的支持程度的周期。 我们提出CoDiCount, 一个统一的无训练框架, 将这个测试变成计数潜力, 在每一个去诺步骤上,结构化的计数信息将每个选项字母,或者每个语法有效的编辑一个开口整数,映射到它表达的计数,并重新加权模型在该集内的自身概率. 在Motion Bench、TOMATO和SVCBench上对官方解码器的一致收益表明,CoDiCount在扩散模型、数据集和各种计数任务中得到了广泛的概括。 与CoDiCount公司,7B dVLM在Motion Bench上的表现优于GPT-5.1和双子座-2.5-Pro,在TOMATO上超越了GPT-4o和更大的开放型号,在SVCBench上与GPT-5.4相匹配.

articles.title: Atunda: Building an Afrogenic Dance Movement Dataset for AI-Driven Classification
articles.content: This paper introduces Atunda, the first systematically collected video dataset of Afrogenic dance moves, designed for training and evaluating deep learning models for movement classification. The first phase of the dataset includes nearly 400 videos covering 13 distinct dance moves from African and African Diaspora performative culture, making it the first AI-ready resource of its kind. Using this dataset, we train and evaluate various configurations of temporal convolutional neural networks, achieving a classification accuracy exceeding 95%. The baseline results provide a benchmark for future studies in movement classification, especially in the understudied area of Afrogenic performative culture and tradition. This work lays the foundation for developing in the future digital metrics of similarity, automated attribution systems, and tools that preserve and promote the cultural heritage of Afrogenic dances.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Atunda:为AI-Driven分类建立非洲裔舞蹈运动数据集
articles.content_zh: 本文介绍了阿通达,这是第一个系统收集的非洲裔舞蹈动作的视频数据集,旨在为运动分类培训和评价深层学习模式. 数据集的第一阶段包括近400个视频,涵盖来自非洲和非洲散居者表演文化的13个不同的舞蹈动作,使其成为首个AI准备的此类资源. 利用这个数据集,我们训练和评估各种时间演化神经网络的配置,实现分类精度超过95%. 基线结果为今后的迁移分类研究提供了基准,特别是在研究不足的非洲裔表演文化和传统领域。 这项工作为今后开发类似性的数字计量、自动归属系统以及保护和促进非洲裔舞蹈文化遗产的工具奠定了基础。

articles.title: A Hard Background Pairing Transfers across Classifiers and Images
articles.content: An image classifier names the object in an image, and its accuracy is the share of images named correctly. A classifier that names a car on a road may miss the same car pasted onto clouds. Composite benchmarks measure such failures by pasting objects cut from photographs onto backgrounds from other photographs. A pairing puts every object label on a different background label, such as truck on sea. The pairing on which some classifiers do worst, their hardest pairing, makes a strict test, but may be hard only for them or only on the photographs used to choose it. We show that the hardest pairing of some classifiers stays hard for others and on new photographs. We split 40 ImageNet classifiers into halves balanced by reported ImageNet accuracy. One half picks its hardest pairing of 8 object and 8 background labels from Common Objects in Context (COCO). The other half, held out of the choice, compares that pairing with random pairings of the same objects and backgrounds. For the 14 held-out classifiers with little net accuracy change after pasting objects back onto their own backgrounds, mean accuracy on composites from new photographs falls from 50.3% over random pairings to 43.7% on the hardest pairing, 6.6 percentage points lower. A benchmark using these composites can compare this pool's held-out classifiers on the fixed and random pairings.

articles.title_zh: 硬背景 分类器和图像之间的对等传输
articles.content_zh: 一个图像分类器在图像中命名对象,其准确性是正确命名的图像的共享. 一个给路上的一辆车取名的分类员可能会错过被粘入云中的同一辆车. 综合基准通过将从照片上取出的物品贴到从其他照片上取出的背景来衡量这种失败。 成对地将每个物体标签放在不同的背景标签上,比如海上的卡车. 一些分类人员最差的配对,最难的配对,做了严格的测试,但可能只对他们有困难,或者只在用来选择的相片上有困难. 我们显示,一些分类中最难配对的 总是对另一些人和新照片很困难。 我们把40个ImageNet分类器分成一半 以所报道的ImageNet精度进行平衡。 一半选取其最难配对的8个对象和8个背景标签来自上下文中的"共同对象"(COCO). 另一半是非选取的,用相同的物体和背景的随机配对来比较. 对于贴上物体后没有多少净准确性变化的14个被搁置的分类器,新相片的复合材料的平均准确度从随机配对的50.3%下降到最难配对的43.7%,低了6.6个百分点。 使用这些复合材料的基准可以比较这个集合在固定和随机配对上的被扣出分级.

articles.title: Motion Beyond Pixels: Learning Future Visual Representations for Object-Centric Dynamics
articles.content: Many embodied world models predict future states in latent spaces optimized for RGB reconstruction, which do not explicitly prioritize object-level semantics and geometry relevant to motion generation. We present MotionRep, a visual representation world model that jointly generates future DINO representations and 3D object flow, coupling semantic and geometric information with object-centric dynamics. To make high-dimensional DINO features amenable to generative modeling, we introduce DINO-VAE, which combines temporal and channel compression with latent regularization to produce compact latents while preserving semantic and geometric information. Conditioned on an initial observation, object query points, and a language instruction, a unified diffusion transformer predicts future visual representations and 3D object flow through joint attention. MotionRep employs asymmetric modality-specific noise schedules to keep the visual stream ahead of 3D object flow during joint denoising, allowing progressively refined future visual representations to guide flow generation. Experiments on simulated and real-world manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that MotionRep outperforms pixel-based baselines in 3D object flow accuracy and generalization to unseen scenes, while requiring only three denoising steps for inference. These results support predictive visual representations as an effective future-state space for object-centric dynamics modeling.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 超越像素的运动:学习对象-子动态的未来视觉表现
articles.content_zh: 许多体现的世界模型预测未来处于为RGB重建所优化的潜在空间中的状态,这些空间没有明确优先考虑与运动生成相关的对象级语义和几何. 我们提出 MotionRep,一种视觉表现世界模型,它联合生成未来的DINO表示和3D对象流,将语义和几何信息与以物体为中心的动态相接. 为了让高维的DINO特征适应基因模型,我们引入了DINO-VAE,它将时间和通道压缩与潜在正态相结合,在保存语义和几何信息的同时产生紧凑的潜质. 以初始观测为条件,对象查询点,语言指示,统一扩散变压器预测未来视觉表现和3D对象通过联合关注来流动. 动议 Rep使用非对称模式特定噪声表,使视觉流在联想解析时能先于3D物体流出,使未来视觉表现逐渐被精炼来引导流出. 关于模拟和现实世界操纵基准的实验表明,MotionRep在3D对象流精度和通向不见场景的平面基线上超越了以像素为基础的基准,同时只需要三个去名步骤即可推论. 这些结果支持预测视觉表现作为以物体为中心的动态模型的有效未来状态空间.

articles.title: PRAM: Activating Latent Multimodal Knowledge through Partwise Reasoning
articles.content: Emergent cross-modal classification and retrieval enable transfer between modalities without direct paired supervision. However, existing methods often prioritize sample-level alignment, overlooking local discriminative information and partwise statistical relations. To this end, we propose partwise reasoning across modalities (PRAM), which activates latent multimodal knowledge in frozen encoders by composing partwise statistical relations through a shared pivot modality. Specifically, we first present a multi-granularity covariance regularization module that estimates covariances from global and local vectors in two collections of modality-pivot pairs, stabilizing local estimates through adaptive blending with their cross-part means. Second, we devise a pivot-based spectral relational reasoning module that infers global and partwise statistical relations between target modalities through regularized covariance composition and extracts paired projection directions and their correlation strengths via whitening and spectral decomposition. Finally, we introduce a multi-granularity score fusion module that standardizes and fuses matching scores from global and local relations, incorporating task-specific information on pivot associations and class semantics for class prediction and candidate ranking. Extensive experiments across ten datasets demonstrate that PRAM achieves state-of-the-art performance in 16 classification settings and 19 retrieval settings, while exhibiting highly competitive performance in three sensing scenarios.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PRAM: 启动Latet 多式联运 通过部分原因获得的知识
articles.content_zh: 紧急的跨模式分类和检索使不同模式之间的转移成为可能,而没有直接的对等监督。 然而,现有方法往往优先考虑抽样一级的统一,忽略当地的歧视信息,以及部分的统计关系。 为此,我们提议采用不同模式(PRAM)进行局部推理,通过共享支点模式将部分统计关系组合成冻结编码器中的潜在多式联运知识激活。 具体地说,我们首先提出一个多角共变常态模块,在两种模式-中枢对的集合中估算出来自全球和地方向量的共相性,通过适应性与它们的跨部分方式相混合来稳定当地的估计。 第二,我们设计了一个以光谱关系推理模块为支柱,该模块通过常态化共变组成推断出目标模式之间的全球和部分统计关系,并通过白化和光谱分解提取成对的投影方向及其相关优势。 最后,我们引入了一个多角度分数聚变模块,将全球和地方关系分数相匹配的分数标准化和引信化,纳入特定任务信息,介绍枢轴协会和类语义,用于班级预测和候选人排名. 跨越10个数据集的广泛实验表明,PRAM在16个分类设置和19个检索设置中实现了最先进的性能,同时在三种感知情景中表现出了高度竞争性的性能.

articles.title: Carrying Feature Ablations Across Sparse Autoencoder Seeds
articles.content: A vision encoder turns an image into one vector per patch, refined layer by layer. A sparse autoencoder (SAE) writes each vector of one layer as a sum of learned directions, most with a coefficient of zero. Researchers call each direction a feature and edit the encoder by removing one feature. An SAE trained from another random seed learns different features. Earlier work matches the two SAEs' features one to one by how closely their directions agree. Matched features can point alike yet respond to different image parts, so removing them may change the encoder differently. We remove a feature and, separately, its match, then compare the changes in the encoder's output on the same held out images. When the second change nearly reproduces the first, we say the removal carries across seeds. A setting fixes a DINOv2 or SigLIP layer and its SAE feature count. At our tolerance, the removal carries for 12% to 70% of matched pairs across three settings. The share is 0% in two controls: an SAE whose directions stay random and, post hoc, matches shuffled among trained features. Post hoc, predicting which removals carry is more accurate with layer contributions than with directions. Some incorrect predictions remain. One persists on independent images. So pairs can be screened at the layer. Measuring the output detects errors this screen misses.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 跨 Sparse 自动编码器种子携带特性标记
articles.content_zh: 一个视觉编码器将一个图像变成每个补丁一个矢量,分层细化. 一个稀疏的自定义编码器(SAE)会将一层的每个向量写成学习方向的总和,大多数的系数为零. 研究人员将每个方向称为特征并用去掉一个特征来编辑编码器. 一个来自另一个随机种子的SAE学习了不同的特性. 早期的作品与两个SAE的特征一对一的相匹配,其取向如何接近一致. 相匹配的特性可以同时指向不同的图像部分,但可以响应不同的图像部分,因此去除它们可能会以不同的方式改变编码器. 我们删除一个功能, 并单独地,它的匹配, 然后比较编码器输出的变化 在相同的挡住的图像。 当第二次改变几乎复制了第一次, 我们说清除 携带了种子。 一个设置会修正一个 DINOv2 或 SigLIP 层及其 SAE 特性计数 。 在我们的容忍度下, 移除携带12%到70%的匹配配对 跨越三种环境。 占比在两个控件中为0%:一个SAE,其方向保持不变,在特设后,与训练过的特性相匹配. 临时后,预测哪些清除携带的,用分层贡献比用方向更准确. 仍然存在一些不正确的预测。 独立图像上就有一个。 因此可以分层筛选出对子. 测量输出会发现此屏幕漏出错误 。

articles.title: Beyond Pose Control: Anatomically Consistent Ultrasound Video Generation
articles.content: Camera-controlled video generation anticipates how a scene appears from new viewpoints by relying on a prior learned implicitly from large-scale data. Ultrasound poses the same problem, with the probe pose as the viewpoint, but under opposite conditions: anatomy offers an explicit prior that every sonographer relies on, whereas tracked scans are too scarce to learn it implicitly. As a result, pose control alone is not enough, and pose-conditioned ultrasound generators produce implausible anatomy in unscanned regions and inconsistent anatomy on revisits. We go beyond pose control and give the generator the two kinds of knowledge that make up a sonographer's mental model. An anatomical prior, built from a population of subjects, guides generation where nothing has been scanned, and is refined online by every generated chunk towards the scanned subject. A 3D latent memory, designed around the cross-sectional physics of ultrasound, compounds the generated slices into a volume of the patient and reslices it at new poses, keeping revisited anatomy consistent. The fine-grained memory enters the generator at the input, while the coarse anatomy prior guides the layout across transformer blocks. Experiments on thyroid, kidney, and lumbar spine show improved visual fidelity, pose following, and anatomical consistency over pose-conditioned and memory-augmented baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Beyond Pose Control:解剖学上一致的超声波视频生成
articles.content_zh: 相机控制的视频生成通过依靠从大规模数据中隐含的事先学到的一面,来预测一个场景是如何从新角度出现的. 超声波也带来了同样的问题,探测器与视线一样外出,但是在相反的条件下:解剖学提供了每个音响学家所依赖的明确前兆,而跟踪扫描太少,无法隐含地学习. 因此,单靠姿势控制是不够的,而姿势条件的超声发电机在未被扫描的地区产生不可信的解剖学,在重访时进行不一致的解剖学. 我们超越了姿势控制,给了生成者两种知识,构成一个音响学家的精神模型. 解剖学先由一组人组成,引导没有扫描的一代人,并且由每个生成的块对扫描对象进行在线改进。 围绕超声波的截面物理学设计的3D潜伏记忆,将所生成的切片分解入患者的体积并被重新切入到新的姿势中,保持了重回解剖学的一致性. 精细的内存在输入时会进入生成器,而粗糙的解剖学前作指导了变压器块之间的布局. 对甲状腺、肾和腰椎的实验显示,视觉上的忠心性、姿势、解剖与姿势和记忆增强基线的一致性都有所改善。

articles.title: Commit2Drive: Perception-Grounded Language Decisions as Commitments for Trajectory Planning in Vision-Language-Action Driving Models
articles.content: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models introduce language reasoning into end-to-end autonomous driving. They output a language decision together with a trajectory, which makes the planner more interpretable. However, in existing methods the language decision is either an independent output or an index that selects among similar candidate trajectories, and its annotations are not verified against the trajectory. As a result, the language decision and the trajectory are often inconsistent in closed-loop driving. To address this, we propose Commit2Drive, a framework that imposes the language decision as a consistency constraint on trajectory planning. The decision is a commitment, a maneuver class with a continuous parameter that one deterministic rule reads from any trajectory, and it is grounded in facts reported by the perception of the model itself. A Maneuver Bank maps the commitment to a code with a kinematic meaning, and consistency losses train the planner to execute every admissible decision of a scene, so that the trajectory follows the decision. An automatic data pipeline supplies the supervision. Decisions are labeled from the future motion of the expert, counterfactual executions train the decision and the trajectory together, and rule-based functions with a Vision-Language Model (VLM) generate, review and refine the language annotations. The code is a lookup that involves no hidden state of the language model, so Commit2Drive is extensible to rule-based decisions, which the same planner executes without retraining. Commit2Drive uses a 0.5B language model and runs closed-loop inference online on a single consumer graphics card. On Bench2Drive, Commit2Drive reaches a Driving Score (DS) of 78.50 and a Success Rate (SR) of 55.91% with a lightweight model, which is competitive with the state of the art, and greatly reduces the language-action inconsistency. Code will be released soon.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Committee2Drive:作为远景-语言-行动驱动模式中的轨迹规划承诺的观念-轮廓语言决定
articles.content_zh: Vision-Language-Action(VLA)模式将语言推理引入到端到端自主驱动中. 它们输出一个语言决定和一个轨迹,这使得规划者更容易被解释. 然而,在现有方法中,语言决定要么是独立的产出,要么是在类似的候选轨迹中选择的索引,其注释没有与轨迹相对照加以核实。 因此,在闭路驾驶中,语言决定和轨迹往往不一致. 为了解决这个问题,我们提议采用Committee2Drive这一框架,将语言决定作为轨道规划的一致性限制。 决定是一种承诺,一种具有连续参数的操作类,一个决定性规则从任何轨迹读取,并以模型本身感知所报告的事实为基础。 一个Maneuver银行描绘了对一个具有动能意义的代码的承诺,一致性损失训练规划者执行一个场景的每一个可受理的决定,以便轨迹遵循决定. 自动数据管道提供监督。 根据专家未来的动议,决定被贴上标签,反事实处决将决定和轨迹结合在一起,基于规则的功能具有视觉语言模型(VLM)生成、审查和完善语言说明。 代码是一种搜索,不涉及语言模型的隐藏状态,因此Cont2Drive可以被扩展到基于规则的决定,同一位规划者在没有再培训的情况下执行. Co通2Drive使用0.5B语言模型,并在单一消费图形卡上在线运行闭路推论. 在Bench2Drive上,Committee2Drive的驾驶分数(DS)为78.50分,成功率(SR)为55.91%,采用轻量级模式,与最先进的水平竞争,并大大降低了语言动作不一致. 代码很快就会发布

articles.title: DuCo: Exploiting Dual Cross-Layer Consistency for Sparse Geometric Attention
articles.content: Dense global attention is crucial for capturing cross-view geometry in visual geometry foundation models, yet its quadratic complexity limits efficient inference on long image sequences. Existing sparse attention methods primarily select entries of the global attention matrix based on attention probabilities and construct masks independently across layers, overlooking value redundancy and cross-layer information reuse. By analyzing attention distributions and clustering value representations across layers, we reveal two forms of \emph{cross-layer consistency}, characterized by highly similar attention probability distributions and localized changes in value redundancy structures. Building on these observations, we propose \textbf{DuCo}, a training-free sparse attention framework that exploits historical attention information and value redundancy for efficient geometric inference. Specifically, DuCo leverages historical attention information to estimate current-layer dense attention probabilities and introduces value clustering to exploit redundancy, with clusters efficiently refined through local updates across layers. Both factors are integrated through probability-weighted value distortion to jointly optimize four cluster representation states under an attention budget for sparse mask construction. Experiments across three visual geometry foundation models and five benchmarks demonstrate favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-offs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DuCo: 探索分几何的双相一致性
articles.content_zh: 敏锐的全球关注对于捕捉视觉几何地基模型中的交叉视野几何至关重要,然而其四相复杂性限制了对长图像序列的有效推断. 现有的稀有关注方法主要根据关注概率选择全球关注矩阵的条目,并跨层独立构建口罩,俯瞰价值冗余和跨层信息再利用. 通过分析各层的注意力分布和集群值表示,我们揭示出\emph{跨层一致性}两种形式,其特点是高度相近的注意力概率分布和价值冗余结构的局部变化. 基于这些观察,我们提议\textbf{DuCo},这是一个无训练的零散关注框架,利用历史关注信息和价值冗余来有效进行几何推断。 具体来说,DuCo利用历史关注信息来估计当前层次的密集关注概率,并引入了价值集群来利用冗余,集群通过分层局部更新得到高效的完善. 这两个因素都通过概率加权价值扭曲来整合,以便联合优化四个集群代表状态,在稀少的遮罩建筑的注意预算之下。 跨越3个视觉几何基础模型和5个基准的实验显示了有利的精度效率取舍.

articles.title: Blind spatially varying PSF estimation for fluorescence microscopy
articles.content: Optical aberrations degrade fluorescence microscopy images and measuring the underlying point spread function (PSF) often requires dedicated acquisitions or isolated emitters. Here we introduce DeepBlur, a neural network that estimates spatially varying two-dimensional PSFs directly from single images of biological structures. Trained entirely on physical simulations spanning aberrations, illumination and noise, it adapts to diverse imaging conditions without requiring user-supplied optical parameters. Using a deformable mirror, we acquire 1,290 images and assess blind PSF estimates against independent references. DeepBlur estimates agree closely with these references and improve deconvolution of experimentally aberrated images. Local PSF estimation also enables correction of spatially varying defocus and improves random-illumination super-resolution reconstruction in biological tissue. Available through DeepInv, a napari plugin and a web demonstration, DeepBlur can be readily integrated into computational microscopy workflows.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 荧光显微镜的盲点空间差异PSF估计
articles.content_zh: 光学偏差可降解荧光显微镜图像并测量所基于的点散函数(PSF)往往需要专门的获取或孤立的发射器. 在这里,我们引入了DeepBlur,一个神经网络,直接从生物结构的单个图像中,对空间变化的二维PSF进行估计. 它完全以物理模拟为主,跨越了异常、发光和噪音,适应不同的成像条件,而不需要用户提供的光学参数。 我们使用可变形的镜像,获得1,290个图像,并对照独立的参考文献评估盲目PSF估计. DeepBlur估计与这些参考文献非常一致,并改进了实验性反常图像的分解. 局部的PSF估计还能够校正空间相差分焦,并改进生物组织中的随机-发光超分辨率重建. 通过DeepInv,一款Capari插件和一款网络演示,DeepBlur可以随时被集成到计算显微镜工作流程中.

articles.title: VisualMontage: Manipulating the Beliefs of Vision-Language Agents with Authentic Image Sequences
articles.content: As agents based on vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly interpret social-media content, errors in their analysis may lend credibility to rumors and amplify their spread. In this paper, we study the problem of visual cognitive collusion, in which coordinated posts combine authentic images and locally faithful captions to induce VLM agents to infer and accept attacker-chosen target claims through their own reasoning. To enable systematic evaluation of this cognitive threat, we introduce a new benchmark comprising 544 target cases and 33.2K candidate images across eight application domains. We further propose VisualMontage, a multi-agent framework for simulating such attacks through narrative planning, image selection and ordering, and caption assignment under iterative review. We evaluate this threat through extensive experiments across 12 vision-language models, examining modality effects, production-team components, and downstream defenses. Using identical attack feeds across models without victim-specific optimization, we demonstrate cross-model transferability, achieving mean attack success rates of 61.93% for proprietary models and 68.71% for open-weight models. Moreover, 92.65% of generated feeds pass independent model-based validity auditing. Even after downstream review, residual attack success rates range from 35.3% to 76.7% across the evaluated configurations. Our additional controlled comparisons further reveal that captions can improve model-rated posting naturalness while reducing attack success. Together, these findings reveal a novel cognitive threat in social-media interpretation and motivate safeguards that assess how authentic posts jointly shape agents' reasoning and conclusions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VisualMontage:用真实图像序列操纵Visual-Language代理的信仰
articles.content_zh: 由于基于视觉语言模型(VLMs)的代理人越来越多地诠释社会-媒体内容,分析中的错误可能会为谣言提供可信度并扩大其传播. 在本文中,我们研究了视觉认知串通的问题,其中协调的帖子结合了真实的图像和当地忠实的字幕来诱导VLM代理通过自己的推理推断并接受攻击者选择目标的说法. 为了能够系统地评估这一认知威胁,我们引入了一个新的基准,包括544个目标案例和8个应用领域的33.2K候选图像。 我们进一步提出VisualMontage,这是一个多代理框架,通过叙述性规划、图像选择和订购以及迭代审查的标题任务来模拟这种攻击。 我们通过12种视觉语言模型的广泛实验来评估这种威胁,审查模式效应、生产团队组件和下游防御。 使用相同的攻击输入 跨模型 没有针对受害者的优化, 我们展示跨模型的可转移性, 实现平均攻击成功率 61.93% 对于专有模型和 68.71% 对于开放重量模型。 此外,92.65%的生成信息通过独立的基于模型的有效性审计。 即使经过下游审查,其余攻击成功率也从35.3%到76.7%不等。 我们额外的控制比较进一步表明,字幕可以改善模型评级的张贴自然性,同时减少攻击成功. 这些调查结果共同揭示了社会-媒体解释中的一种新的认知威胁,并激励了各种保障措施,这些保障措施评估了真实立场如何共同塑造代理人的推理和结论。

articles.title: You Only Look Multiple Times: YoloMT, a Real-Time Streaming Model on a T4
articles.content: We introduce a new model for real-time streaming captioning on a single GPU. YoloMT is a 449.8M-parameter streaming captioner that provides Pareto-frontier performance among generative vision models in its class. Distilled from a 27B teacher by SFT and GRPO, it leads every model under 1B parameters on OVO-Bench, MVBench, StreamingBench and Video-MME, answered from its captions, and beats LFM2.5-VL-1.6B and SmolVLM2-2.2B. YoloMT is designed to read more frames cheaply and make them informative, encoding each frame once and caching it as 16 tokens. This allows the model to incorporate and infer from past frames without additional vision passes, making it efficient and effective. We also provide a detailed recipe for training YoloMT, with its stages and data, as well as ablations that demonstrate the contribution of each component.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: YoloMT, T4 上的实时流线模型
articles.content_zh: 我们在单一的GPU上引入了实时流媒体字幕的新模式. YoloMT是一个449.8M-参数的流线标注器,在其类中的基因视觉模型中提供Pareto-frontier性能. 由SFT和GRPO从一位27B的老师中分解出,它带领了OVO-Bench,MV Bench,Streaming Bench和Video-MME上的1B参数下的每个模型,从其标题中解答,并击败了LFM2.5-VL-1.6B和SmolVLM2-2.2B. 哟 MT的设计是为了更便宜地阅读更多的帧并让它们提供信息,将每个帧编码一次并把它作为16个符. 这使该模式能够纳入过去框架并据此推断,而无需额外的视觉通行证,从而使其具有效率和效力。 我们还提供了培训YoloMT的详细方法,其中包含其阶段和数据,以及展示每个组成部分贡献的花样。

articles.title: SEAM: A Self-Evolving and Adaptive Probing Framework for Automatic MLLM Hallucination Evaluation
articles.content: The severe susceptibility of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to hallucinations poses a critical threat to their reliability, making a rigorous evaluation framework indispensable. However, existing evaluation pipelines largely rely on predefined test items, suffering from high construction costs, rapid obsolescence as MLLMs evolve, and ineffectiveness in probing model-specific weaknesses. To address these limitations, we propose SEAM, a self-evolving and adaptive probing framework for automatic MLLM hallucination evaluation. Specifically, SEAM introduces a composable Hallucination Probe Construction Library comprising ten hallucination-probing skills, three elicitation wrappers, and five question formats. Building on this library, SEAM establishes a dual-loop framework. In the inner loop (adaptive probing), skill-guided visual analysis, question composition, and hierarchical quality verification are coordinated with verifier and target-response feedback to refine test items and uncover model-specific hallucinations. In the outer loop (skill evolution), a skill updater distills historical probing trajectories into localized, reusable rule updates, which undergo held-out validation and are frozen before testing. Driven by these innovative structural designs, SEAM establishes an automated and self-evolving evaluation paradigm. Experiments across four target MLLMs and ten hallucination types demonstrate that SEAM substantially outperforms representative static benchmarks, achieving an 89.2\% relative improvement in mean valid hallucination discovery rate across 12 matched comparisons.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SEAM:自动MLLM幻觉评价的自演和适应性测试框架
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)对幻觉的高度易感性对其可靠性构成了严重威胁,因此严格的评价框架是不可或缺的。 然而,现有的评价管道主要依赖预先确定的试验项目,由于建造成本高,随着MLLMs的发展而迅速过时,在检测模型特有的弱点方面效率低下. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议建立SEAM,作为自动MLLM幻觉评估的自演和适应性的测试框架. 具体地说,SEAM引入了可调和的幻觉探险建筑库,由十种幻觉探险技巧,三道诱导包和五道问题格式组成. 在这个库的基础上,SEAM建立了一个双循环框架. 在内环(适应性检测)中,由技能指导的视觉分析,问题组成,以及分级质量核查与核查器和目标响应反馈相协调,以完善测试项目并发现模型特有的幻觉. 在外环(技能进化)中,技能更新器将历史的探险轨迹分解出局部,可再用的规则更新,经过被搁置的验证,在测试前被冻结. 在这些创新结构设计的推动下,SEAM建立了一个自动化和自发式的评价范式. 4个目标MLLM和10个幻觉类型的实验表明,SEAM的绩效大大高于代表性静态基准,在12个匹配的比较中,平均有效幻觉发现率相对提高了89.2%。

articles.title: $μ$MPC: Microsecond-Scale Nonlinear and World Model Control from Edge to GPU via Koopman-Linearized Precompilation
articles.content: We present $μ$MPC, a fast model predictive control (MPC) framework that reduces online computation using learned Koopman-linearized dynamics. By precomputing finite-horizon control-to-output maps, $μ$MPC eliminates lifted-state trajectories, yielding an action-only Koopman-Compiled QP (KC-QP) with $Hn_u$ decision variables, independent of lifted dimension. A fixed, precomputed primal operator enables efficient primal-dual iterations using only matrix-vector products and projections, accommodating changing goals and constraints without refactorization. This efficiency also enables control-aware dynamics learning through differentiable KC-QPs in the training loop and batched DAgger-style data aggregation. $μ$MPC achieves solve times as low as $23μ$s on a desktop CPU and 24 ms onboard a 168 MHz Crazyflie microcontroller. It scales to 4096D quadruped control in under 5 ms, visual planning with 2048D world models in 0.4 ms, and collision-aware planning for 200 quadrotors at over 30 Hz on the GPU. Across these benchmarks, $μ$MPC achieves up to $108\times$ faster constrained MPC and $1907\times$ faster visuomotor planning than competing methods.

articles.title_zh: $μ$MPC: 通过Koopman-Linearized预编取自边缘到GPU的微分级非线性和世界模型控制
articles.content_zh: 我们提出了$μ$MPC,这是一个快速模型预测控制(MPC)框架,它利用学到的科普曼线性动态减少在线计算. 通过预算有限视距控制到输出的地图,$μ$MPC消除了被升起的状态轨迹,产生一个只动作的克普曼编译QP(KC-QP),其中包含$Hn_u$决定变量,独立于被升起的尺寸. 一个固定的、预先计算的初级操作员能够使用只使用矩阵媒介产品和预测的高效的初级-双重迭代,在不重构的情况下适应不断变化的目标和限制。 这种效率还使得在训练循环中通过不同的KC-QP和分批Dagger式的数据汇总来进行具有控制意识的动态学习. $μ$MPC在桌面CPU上实现23μ$s的解析时间,在168MHz Crazyflie微控制器上实现24ms. 它以5ms以下的分级为4096D四重控制,以0.4ms的可视化规划为2048D世界型号,并用超过30Hz的GPU对200个四重机进行相撞感知规划. 在这些基准中,微元MPC达到108\times的MPC受限速度快,而1907\times的Vuomotor规划速度快于相竞方法。

articles.title: ADClaw: A Programmable Visual Agent for Industrial Anomaly Detection and Understanding
articles.content: Industrial anomaly detection (IAD), the task of identifying and localizing deviations from normal product conditions, is essential to automated quality inspection in manufacturing. Many vision-language models for IAD rely on large domain-specific datasets for fine-tuning and make predictions in a single pass, leaving no opportunity to re-examine ambiguous regions. Although tool-using agents can revisit these regions, predefined tool interfaces limit how they can combine intermediate results in a follow-up check. When such checks are insufficient, models may miss subtle defects or misidentify the defect type. To address this limitation, we introduce ADClaw, an inspection agent that uses executable code to test anomaly hypotheses without task-specific fine-tuning. For each hypothesis, a Structured Normality Prior identifies the applicable rules and retrieves normal visual references for the inspection target. Guided by this prior, the agent writes and executes code in a persistent Inspection Workbench to combine masks, anomaly maps, and measurements from earlier steps into a new test of the suspected defect. After each check, Hypothesis-Guided Evidence Reasoning assesses whether the evidence supports the suspected defect and its location, using gaps or inconsistencies in that evidence to guide the next code action. ADClaw achieves competitive results in detection and localization across 2D and 3D industrial anomaly detection benchmarks and in anomaly understanding on MMAD.

articles.title_zh: ADClaw:工业异常检测和理解可编程视觉剂
articles.content_zh: 工业异常探测(IAD)是查明和确定偏离正常产品条件的地方性任务,对于制造业自动化质量检查至关重要。 IDD的许多视觉语言模型依靠大型域特有数据集进行微调并单行道进行预测,因此没有机会重新审查模棱两可的区域. 虽然工具使用剂可以再去这些区域,但预先定义的工具界面限制了它们如何在后续检查中结合中间结果. 当这种检查不够时,模型可能会漏掉微妙的缺陷或误认出缺陷类型. 为解决这一限制,我们引入了ADClaw,一个使用可执行代码来测试异常假说而不进行特定任务微调的检查代理. 对于每个假说,一个结构常态(Structured Normality Preference)确定适用的规则并检索检查目标的正常视觉参考. 在此之前的指引下,代理在持续检查工作台上写出并执行代码,将口罩,异常图,以及从早期步骤的测量结果结合到对疑似缺陷的新测试. 每次检查后,"假设证据"(Hypothesis-Guided Effairs Reasoning)评估证据是否支持被怀疑的缺陷及其位置,利用证据中的漏洞或不一致来指导下个代码动作. ADClaw在2D和3D工业异常检测基准的检测和本地化以及MMAD的异常理解方面都取得了竞争结果.

articles.title: ChemoMAE: Self-Supervised Spectral Representation Learning Reveals Chemical Heterogeneity in Historical Wood
articles.content: In historical timber buildings, multiple environmental factors act over centuries on wood whose chemical composition varies across anatomical regions, producing complex patterns of degradation. Understanding how timber members degrade is important for the effective conservation and restoration of historical buildings, yet the mechanisms underlying these patterns remain unclear. To investigate these mechanisms, we used self-supervised learning to establish a common basis for comparing specimens from timber members that differ in wood species and service history. We examined transverse sections of 49 wood specimens from several historical buildings in Japan using near-infrared hyperspectral imaging. ChemoMAE, a self-supervised Transformer, learns pixelwise spectral representations through masked denoising that exploits multicollinearity among spectral variables. Clustering these representations yields spatial maps without predefined chemical-state categories. Because anatomy and degradation can produce spatially continuous regions, we formulated Local Label Agreement (LLA) to quantify agreement among labels assigned to neighboring pixels. Using spectra alone, ChemoMAE yielded higher mean LLA than baseline methods on validation specimens. We then trained ChemoMAE anew and fitted cluster centers across all specimens. Spatial structures consistent with wood anatomy and the expected effects of surface exposure emerged in the resulting maps. By cross-referencing regional spectra and spatial distributions across specimens in light of wood anatomy, service histories, and prior studies, we proposed models of internal and surface degradation as mechanistic hypotheses. This exploratory AI for Science framework gives researchers a basis for linking latent patterns learned through self-supervision with domain knowledge when investigating how material states form.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ChemoMAE:历史木材中自我监督的光谱代表性学习启示性化学异质性
articles.content_zh: 在历史木材建筑中,多个环境因素对不同解剖区域化学成分相去甚远的木材有数百年的作用,产生复杂的降解模式. 了解木材成员如何退化对于有效养护和恢复历史建筑十分重要,但这些模式背后的机制仍然不清楚。 为了调查这些机制,我们利用自我监督的学习,为比较木材成员在木材种类和服务史上不同的标本建立了共同的基础。 我们用近红外超光谱成像 检查了日本几个历史建筑的49个木材标本的横截面 ChemomoMAE是一个自我监督的变形器,通过利用光谱变量间多连系性的蒙面去诺来学习像素光谱表达. 将这些表示方式分组产生空间图,而不预先确定化学状态类别。 由于解剖学和降解可以产生空间连续的区域,我们制定了"本地标签协议"(LLA),以量化分配给相邻像素的标签之间的协议. 光利用光谱,ChemoMAE在验证标本上得出的平均LLA值高于基准方法. 然后我们重新训练了ChemoMAE 并且在所有标本上安装了集群中心。 由此产生的地图中出现了与木材解剖学相一致的空间结构以及地表暴露的预期影响。 通过参照木材解剖学、服务历史和先前的研究,相互参照区域谱系和标本之间的空间分布,我们提出了内部和地表退化模型,作为机械假设。 这种探索性科学的AI框架为研究人员提供了一个基础,在调查材料状态如何形成时,将通过自我监督学到的潜在模式与域知识联系起来。

articles.title: Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence
articles.content: Establishing effective scaling laws for medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remains a persistent and fundamental challenge. Our systematic evaluation shows that existing medical MLLMs tend to underperform frontier general-purpose MLLMs across a range of medical tasks, while scaling model size primarily improves text capabilities rather than multimodal perception, and enabling reasoning modes fails to close this visual gap. To investigate how medical multimodal intelligence scales in practice, we introduce Sage-Med-Preview, a 35B-parameter medical multimodal model with 3B activated parameters, built by combining stage-specific curation over 322.7 million candidate records with a progressive training curriculum spanning medical pretraining, staged supervised fine-tuning, and adaptive reinforcement learning. Across this curriculum, progressive supervised refinement and adaptive reinforcement learning yield consistent stage-wise gains, substantially advancing both specialized visual understanding and medical language capabilities. Evaluated against 77 competing models across 238 clinical tasks spanning 61 public and 13 private multi-center benchmarks in more than 40 modalities, Sage-Med-Preview achieves an average score of 58.26% on the 31 public multimodal benchmarks. It outperforms the state-of-the-art open-source medical model Hulu-Med-235B-A22B at 50.99% and the general scientific model Intern-S2-Preview at 52.24%, and approaches the advanced proprietary model GPT-6.2-Sol across multiple tasks such as comprehensive multimodal understanding, report generation, and visual grounding. Although substantial challenges remain in complex medical reasoning and multi-step clinical workflows, this report provides empirical evidence, actionable data and training recipes, and a rigorous benchmark toward scalable clinical multimodal intelligence.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Sage-Med:扩大医疗多模式情报
articles.content_zh: 为医疗多模式大型语言模型制定有效的扩展法仍然是一项长期和根本的挑战。 我们的系统评价表明,现有的医疗MLLMs在一系列医疗任务中往往表现不佳,而模型规模的缩小主要提高了文本能力,而不是提高了多模式感知能力,使能推理模式无法弥合这一视觉差距。 为了调查医疗多模式情报的实际规模,我们引进了Sage-Med-Preview,一种35B参数医疗多模式,有3B活性参数,将3.227亿份候选记录与涵盖医疗预训、有监督地微调和适应性强化学习的渐进培训课程相结合。 在整个课程中,逐步进行有监督的完善和适应性强化学习,在阶段性上取得了一致的成果,大大地提高了专业视觉理解和医疗语言能力。 Sage-Med-Preview在超过40种模式的超过61个公共和13个私人多中心基准的238个临床任务中,与77个相互竞争的模式进行了评价,在31个公共多模式基准中平均得分达到58.26%。 它的性能超过了最先进的开源医学模型Hulu-Med-235B-A22B的50.99%和一般科学模型Intern-S2-Preview的52.24%,并接近了先进的专有模型GPT-6.2-Sol,跨越了综合多模式理解,报告生成,视觉地基等多个任务. 尽管在复杂的医疗推理和多步骤临床工作流程方面仍然存在重大挑战,但本报告提供了经验证据、可操作的数据和培训配方,以及可扩展临床多模式智能的严格基准。

articles.title: Physics-Guided Generative Modelling of Oxy-Combustion Flame Images: From Conditional LSGANs to Denoising Diffusion Models
articles.content: Validating industrial oxy-combustion burner designs traditionally requires costly experimental campaigns in which each operating condition is physically reproduced on an instrumented rig and imaged via OH* chemiluminescence, rendering iterative design exploration prohibitively slow. This work develops deep generative surrogate models that map a 15-dimensional vector of continuous operating parameters (thermal power, swirl numbers, momentum ratios, mixture fractions, etc.) directly to a $512\times64$ heat-release flame image, trained on 1,609 experimental samples from the OXYTEC dual-swirl non-premixed oxy-combustion database. Two complementary generative paradigms are investigated, as they offer opposite strengths for surrogate modelling: a custom spatially-anchored conditional least-squares GAN (cLSGAN-L1-CBN), whose single-pass generation enables near-instantaneous inference, and a custom physics-guided denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM), whose iterative sampling favours the smooth, continuous heat-release gradients of fluid flows. Both are validated through ablation on a stratified held-out test set. The optimized cLSGAN reaches RMSE 0.022 and FID 20.68 and generates an image in about 20 ms on a mobile workstation GPU, though extended training leaves its texture realism unchanged; the DDPM improves steadily over long training horizons, reaching RMSE 0.019 and FID 20.29 at 40,000 epochs, at the cost of roughly thirty seconds per image on the same hardware --- three orders of magnitude slower than the adversarial surrogate. A nearest-neighbour analysis traces the persistent worst-case errors to sparsely sampled regions of the parameter space, and a parameter-sensitivity study confirms smooth, physically consistent responses to perturbed inputs. These results demonstrate that carefully guided generative models can act as reliable visual surrogates for combustion experiments.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 以物理为指南的氧化-燃烧基因模型 火焰影像:从有条件的LSGANs到去化扩散模型
articles.content_zh: 验证工业用氧燃烧燃烧器的设计,传统上需要成本高昂的实验运动,在这种试验活动中,每个操作条件都实际复制在一台仪器钻机上,并通过OH* 化学发光仪进行成像,使得迭代设计勘探的速度极其缓慢。 这项工作开发出深源代活性模型,将连续操作参数的15维向量(热能,回旋数,动能比,混合物分数等)直接映射到512\times64美元放热放出火焰图像上,从OXYTEC双向回旋非预混合氧燃烧数据库培养出1,609个实验样本. 研究了两个互补的基因模型,因为它们为替代模型提供了相反的优势:一个定制的空间定位条件最低平方GAN(cLSGAN-L1-CBN),其单行道生成可以近乎瞬间推论;一个定制的物理导解扩散概率模型(DDPM),其迭代取样有利于流体流平滑而连续的放热梯度. 两者均通过分级搁置的测试集进行验证。 被优化的cLSGAN达到RMSE 0.022和FID 20.68,并在移动工作站GPU上生成了约20ms的图像,虽然扩展培训使其纹理现实主义保持不变;DDPM在长时间的训练地平线上稳步改善,在40,000个历程上达到RMSE 0.019和FID 20.29,在同一硬件上每幅图像花费约30秒 -- -- 三个数量级比对抗代位慢. 最近的邻里分析将持续存在的最坏情况误差追溯到对参数空间的稀有采样区域,参数灵敏度研究确认了对扰动输入的平稳而物理上一致的反应. 这些结果表明,仔细地被引导的基因模型可以作为燃烧实验的可靠视觉代用.

articles.title: Score-based Black-box Attack via Adversarial Condition Guided Diffusion Model
articles.content: Generative models enable unrestricted adversarial attacks that aim to fool classifiers while preserving the natural appearance and semantics of the original image. However, existing diffusion-based black-box attacks largely rely on transferability from surrogates, making their effectiveness sensitive to differences between surrogate and victim. Improving transferability can also distort semantic content and degrade image quality. Moreover, retaining the original prompt to preserve fidelity leaves the diffusion model's conditional prior underused for adversarial guidance. We address these limitations by adapting score-based black-box attacks to reverse diffusion, using the victim's output probabilities to guide latent updates without accessing its gradients. We further introduce adaptive-target guidance, which uses the victim's current runner-up class as an adversarial condition to steer denoising towards the decision boundary. Because such guidance can introduce unwanted semantic changes, we also propose target-search guidance, which searches for a small perturbation of the original condition embedding using a score-based attack. This achieves comparable attack effectiveness with better image quality than runner-up guidance. Experiments on the ImageNet-Compatible dataset show that our framework outperforms transfer-based baselines in both attack effectiveness and image quality.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 以分数为基础的黑盒攻击
articles.content_zh: 基因模型可以实现无限制的对抗攻击,目的是在保持原始图像的自然外观和语义的同时愚弄分类者. 然而,现有的以传播为主的黑匣子攻击很大程度上依赖于代孕者的可转移性,使得其有效性对被代孕者和被代孕者之间的差异具有敏感性. 提高可传输性也可以扭曲语义内容并降低图像质量. 此外,保留原有的保持忠诚的提示,使得扩散模式有条件的事先未充分用于对抗性指导。 我们通过调整基于分数的黑盒攻击以反向扩散,利用受害人的输出概率来引导潜在的更新而不访问其梯度来应对这些限制. 我们进一步引入了适应性目标指导,将受害人目前的跑步类作为对抗条件,以向决定边界方向发号施令。 由于这种指导可以引入不想要的语义变化,我们还提出目标搜索指导,利用分数攻击来搜索原始条件嵌入的微小扰动. 这比起跑道向导,在图像质量上实现了可比较的攻击效果. 在ImageNet-兼容数据集上的实验表明,我们的框架在攻击效果和图像质量方面都超过了基于传输的基线。

articles.title: Compact Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environmentsvia On-Policy Training and Route-Bearing Output
articles.content: Instruction-following robots need navigation policies that reach high accuracy and remain inexpensive to train and to run on a single graphics processing unit (GPU). The most accurate vision-language navigation policies for continuous environments rely on language models with 4 to 8 billion parameters, long observation histories, and large auxiliary corpora. Two properties of the standard training setup limit smaller policies. Imitation labels cover the states that an expert visits, whereas the running policy reaches states that its own errors produce. In addition, an image-plane waypoint exists only while the route lies inside the camera view. We present \textbf{\paper}, a monocular red-green-blue (RGB) policy with 2 billion (2B) parameters that addresses both limitations. \paper adapts Qwen3-VL-2B with low-rank adapters and processes an eight-frame memory and the current view in one forward pass. The policy predicts the route direction as a bearing in the body frame of the agent, which remains defined for every heading, and a deterministic controller converts this bearing into motion. This design allows training to relabel the states that the policy itself visits. On-policy correction improves success, while bearing decoding outperforms image-plane waypoint scanning across all evaluated start headings with identical weights. On the \valunseen split, \paper achieves \rFinSR\% success on Room-to-Room in Continuous Environments (\rtor), averaged over three seeds, and \rRxFinSR\% on its Room-Across-Room counterpart (\rxr). Inference requires \rDecMs\,ms and \rInferGB\,GiB of memory, while training takes \rCostTrainTyp\ GPU-hours on one 12\,GB consumer GPU.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 连续环境中的紧凑远景-语言导航 政策培训和路线图产出
articles.content_zh: 指令跟踪机器人需要达到高精度并保持低廉的导航政策来训练和运行在单一图形处理单元(GPU)上. 连续环境最精确的视觉-语言导航政策依赖于语言模型,其参数有40至80亿个,长期观测历史,以及大型辅助阵型. 标准培训设置的两个属性限制了较小的政策. 模仿的标签包括专家访问,而运行中的政策则说其本身的错误产生。 此外,一个图像-平面的航道点只在路由位于相机视图内时存在. 我们提出\textbf\paper}, 一个单一的红-绿-蓝(RGB)政策, \paper 调整了 Qune3- VL-2B 有低等适配器, 并处理一个八帧内存和当前视图 。 政策预测路由方向为物剂体框中轴承,而物剂体框仍为每个方向所定义,而决定控制器则将这个轴承转换为活性. 这种设计允许培训重新标出政策本身访问的状态。 政策上的纠正提高了成功率,同时对所有被评价的起步标题进行超标图像平面平面扫描,并具有相同的权重。 在 \valenseen 拆分上,\paper 实现了 \rFinSR\%在连续环境中的相间对相间(\rxr)上的成功,平均超过 三种子,\rRxFinSR\%在相间对相间(\rxr)上. 推论需要\rDecMs\,ms和\rferGB\,GiB 内存,而训练则需要\rCostTrainTyp\ GPU-hours在一12\,GB消费GPU.

articles.title: M$^{2}$AdaptVLA: Multimodal Memory-Augmented Vision-Language-Action Model with Predictive Test-Time Adaptation
articles.content: Effective robotic manipulation calls for multimodal memory and rapid adaptation to shifts in contact dynamics. However, many existing policies, which retain either visual or wrench history, may miss key cues from the other modality. Moreover, even with wrench memory, fixed policies can struggle when contact conditions shift at deployment. To this end, we introduce M$^{2}$AdaptVLA, a vision-language-action model that integrates visual and wrench memories with predictive test-time adaptation. For visual memory, the model uses test-time training (TTT) to encode observation history in fast weights. Each entry in the bounded TTT bank combines the corresponding frame's features with a readout from these weights, preserving cues that predate the oldest retained frame. For wrench memory, a context gate controls how much the action expert draws on wrench history as it jointly denoises future actions and wrenches. For predictive test-time adaptation, the auxiliary wrench prediction loss also provides online self-supervision. Using measured wrenches as targets, we update low-rank policy adapters by backpropagating only through the final denoising step. Real-world experiments show that the TTT bank outperforms visual memory baselines on progress tracking, scene recall, and demonstration following. On contact-sensitive tasks, the context gate yields higher success rates than direct injection or gated cross-attention. Predictive test-time adaptation improves robustness to shifts in contact dynamics. On eight tasks requiring visual and wrench memory, M$^{2}$AdaptVLA achieves a mean success rate of 82.71%, a 31.46% absolute gain over the strongest baseline. The project page is available at https://tlf-tlf.github.io/M2AdaptVLAPage/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: M$^{2}$AdaptVLA:多模式内存增强视野-语言-行动模式与预测测试-时间适应
articles.content_zh: 有效的机器人操纵需要多模式记忆和快速适应接触动态的变化. 然而,许多现行政策要么保留视觉历史,要么保留扳手历史,可能错过了另一种模式的关键提示。 此外,即使有了扳手记忆,当部署时接触条件发生变化时,固定政策也会挣扎. 为此,我们引入了M$^{2}$AdaptVLA,一种视觉-语言-动作模型,将视觉和扳手记忆与预测的测试-时间适应相结合. 对于视觉内存,模型使用测试时间训练(TTT)来将观测历史编码为快重. 被捆绑的TTT银行的每个条目将相应帧的特性与这些重量的读出结合起来,保留了最古老的保留帧之前的提示. 对于扳手记忆,一个上下文门控制着动作专家在联合去除未来动作和扳手时所汲取的扳手历史的多少. 对于预测测试时间的适应,辅助扳手预测损失也提供在线自导自演. 利用测量到的扳手作为目标,我们更新低级的政策适配器,只通过最后去名步骤进行回向宣传. 真实世界的实验表明,TTT银行在进度跟踪,场景回想,以及随后的演示方面,能比视觉内存基线表现得更好. 在接触敏感的任务中,上下文门的成功率高于直接注射或门式交叉注意。 预测性的试验时间适应性可提高接触动态的稳健性。 在需要视觉和扳手记忆的8项任务上,M$^{2}$AdaptVLA实现了82.71%的中度成功率,比最强基线的绝对增益31.46%. 项目网页见https://tlf-tlf.github.io/M2AdaptVLAPage/。

articles.title: CADENCE: Sensor-GroundedWorld-Consistent Gaussian SLAM for Collaborative Mobile Reconstruction
articles.content: Collaborative reconstruction with consumer phones promises faster and more complete indoor maps. However, heterogeneous devices introduce degraded observations and unreliable cross-device associations, so a single poor contributor or incorrect match can corrupt the shared Gaussian map. To address this, we propose \textbf{CADENCE}, a collaborative Gaussian simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) system that separates finding cross-device matches from deciding whether and how peer observations update the map. To find matches, a sensor-grounded regional memory summarizes committed observations and ranks candidate peer regions using appearance, relative pose, gravity, barometric altitude, and observation quality. Deterministic geometric verification and optional physical checks then decide which of the proposed matches are accepted. Once a match is accepted, separate cue-based confidences control how its observations contribute to pose constraints, geometry, appearance, and memory. As a result, useful depth can still contribute even when color is unreliable. Throughout this process, local tracking remains isolated from mapping, verification, and networking. We evaluate CADENCE on eight Matterport3D houses that were not used to train the memory. On these houses, regional memory achieves an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of $0.95$ to $0.97$ and thus outperforms appearance retrieval, while verification keeps false-link rates below $0.5\,\%$. Furthermore, soft confidence weighting reduces the mean receiver peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) loss from $2.66$ to $1.05$\,dB across eight degradations while retaining useful peer depth. Finally, using inertial and platform motion, CADENCE tracks all twelve held-out iPhone scans with a mean absolute trajectory error of $6.98$\,cm, and its refined maps achieve better average rendering quality than the baselines.

articles.title_zh: 传感器环绕 世界一致的 " 合作移动重建高斯拉马 " 组织
articles.content_zh: 与消费电话合作重建有望更快和更完整的室内地图. 然而,各种设备引入了已退化的观测和不可靠的交叉设备关联,因此单个的差贡献者或不正确的匹配会腐蚀共享的高斯地图. 为了解决这个问题,我们建议\textbf{CADENCE},一个协作的高斯同时本地化和绘图(SLAM)系统,它将发现交叉设备匹配与决定是否和如何对等观测更新地图区分开来. 为了找到匹配点,一个传感器定位的区域内存总结了承诺的观测结果,并利用外观、相对姿势、重力、气压高度和观测质量对候选同行区域进行排名。 确定几何核查和可选物理检查,然后决定哪些拟议匹配被接受。 一旦一个匹配被接受,单独的基于提示的置信控制其观测如何促进形成约束,几何,外观,和内存. 因此,即使在颜色不可靠的情况下,有用的深度仍然可以作出贡献. 在整个过程中,地方跟踪仍然与测绘、核查和联网隔离开来。 我们评价CADENCE 在8个Matterport3D的房屋 没有用来训练记忆。 在这些房屋中,区域内存在接收器操作特征曲线(AUROC)下的一个区域为0.95美元至0.97美元,从而超过了外观检索,而核查将虚假链接率保持在0.5\美元以内。 此外,软置信加权将平均接收峰值信号-噪音比损失从2.66美元降至1.05美元\,dB在8个降解过程中保持了有用的同源深度。 最后,利用惯性运动和平台运动,CADENCE跟踪了所有十二个被搁置出iPhone扫描,平均绝对轨迹误差为6.98美元\,cm,其精细的地图实现了比基线更好的平均渲染质量.

articles.title: Recalling the Past to Answer the Present: Context-Aware Multi-Evidence Reasoning for Streaming Video Question Answering
articles.content: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in video understanding, yet existing video question answering (VQA) benchmarks mainly evaluate models in offline settings. Real-world streaming scenarios instead require models to answer context-dependent queries by retrieving and reasoning over evidence distributed across the video history. We introduce StreamRecall, a benchmark for context-aware Multi evidence reasoning in streaming video QA. StreamRecall requires models to retrieve, associate, and reason over temporally scattered evidence to answer queries at the appropriate moment. It contains 4,983 questions over 462 videos, with context-aligned query times and fine-grained temporal evidence annotations. We further propose the Evidence Utilization Cascade to diagnose model reasoning through evidence localization, grounding, chain completion, and answer derivation. To enable efficient long-term streaming reasoning, we present EviStream, a training-free causal visual memory mechanism that preserves reasoning-critical evidence under a fixed KV budget. Experiments reveal substantial gaps between current VLMs and realistic streaming requirements, establishing StreamRecall as a foundation for developing evidence-aware streaming video intelligence.

articles.title_zh: 回顾过去对当前问题的回答:了解背景的多证据,为视频问答提供理由
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)在视频理解上取得了显著进展,然而现有的视频问答(VQA)基准主要在离线环境下评价模型. 相反,真实世界的流传情景需要模型,通过检索和推理来回答根据具体情况提出的询问,而不是在整个视频历史中分发的证据。 我们引入了StreamRecall(英语:StreamRecall),这是在流媒体视频QA中了解上下文的多证据推理的基准. StreamRecall要求模型在适当的时候检索、联系和解释时间上分散的证据以回答询问。 它包含超过462个视频的4,983个问题,有上下文相通的查询时间和精细的时间证据说明. 我们进一步提出证据利用连带法,通过证据本地化、地基化、链式完成和答案推导来诊断模型推理。 为了能够高效地进行长期流出推理,我们提出了"EviStream",一种在固定的KV预算下保存推理关键证据的无训练因子视觉记忆机制. 实验揭示了当前甚高频和现实流线性要求之间的巨大差距,将StreamRecall作为发展证据意识流线性视频智能的基础.

articles.title: HAS: Hierarchical Adaptive Frame Sampling for Video Understanding
articles.content: Due to context-length constraints, most MLLMs cannot process full-length videos and therefore rely on sampling a subset of frames as input. However, existing sampling methods, ranging from uniform sampling to relevance-based selection, are often driven by a single sampling principle and thus struggle to accommodate the heterogeneous evidential requirements of different queries: some demand a holistic understanding of how the video unfolds over time, while others hinge on fine-grained events within a short temporal window. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{Hierarchical Adaptive Frame Sampling (HAS)}, a two-stage frame sampling framework. In the first stage, \emph{Backbone Frame Construction}, we apply a Determinantal Point Process (DPP) to sample frames that are both query-relevant and non-redundant. These selected frames capture key moments across the video and form the backbone of the sampling set, providing a foundation for subsequent enrichment. In the second stage, \emph{Adaptive Contextual Enrichment}, we analyze the temporal distribution of the backbone frames to infer the query's requirements and adaptively allocate the remaining frame budget between Local and Global Context. The Local Context enriches the backbone with fine-grained temporal dynamics and short-range causal relations, whereas the Global Context connects temporally isolated evidence and provides a holistic view of the entire video to support global understanding. Through such a hierarchical two-stage process, HAS effectively addresses diverse query requirements. Incorporated into three leading MLLMs, it demonstrates consistently superior performance across the Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and MLVU benchmarks.

articles.title_zh: Has: 分级适应性框架取样,用于视频理解
articles.content_zh: 由于上下文长度的限制,大多数MLLMs无法处理完整长度的视频,因此依赖于采样一个子集作为输入. 然而,现有的取样方法,从统一的取样到基于相关性的选择,往往由单一的取样原则所驱动,因此难以满足不同询问的不同证据要求:有些方法要求全面了解录像如何随时间演变,而另一些方法则依赖于短时间窗口内精细的情节。 为了解决这一局限性,我们提议采用\textbf{高阶适应性框架抽样(HAS)},即一个两阶段框架抽样框架。 在第一阶段,\emph{ Backbone Frame Construction} 中,我们对既与查询相关,又非冗余的样本框架采用定点过程(DPP). 这些被选中的帧捕捉到整个视频的关键瞬间,并构成了采样集的骨干,为随后的浓缩提供了基础. 在第二阶段(\emph{Adaptive Contexual Enfuel }),我们分析骨干框架的时间分布,推断出查询的要求,并适应地将剩余框架预算分配到本地和全球背景. " 本地背景 " 以精细的时间动态和短程因果关系来丰富骨干,而 " 全球背景 " 则将时间上孤立的证据连接起来,提供整个视频的整体视图,以支持全球理解。 通过这种分级两阶段的进程,有效地解决了不同的查询要求。 综合到3个领先的MLLMs中,它显示在Video-MME、LongVideo Bench和MLVU基准方面一贯表现优异。

articles.title: Rank Before You Encode: Reading a Few Percent of a Whole-Slide Image
articles.content: Classifying a whole-slide image requires encoding thousands of high-resolution tiles with a pathology foundation model, which accounts for most of the inference cost. Existing efficient methods reduce this cost by selecting fewer tiles, but typically train a new model around their selection strategy. A largely unexplored alternative is to keep an existing full-bag model frozen and run it on selected tiles at the same encoder cost. We introduce this comparison, alongside random tile sampling at matched cost. To select tiles, we fit a lightweight selector with 3.3K parameters to the attention of a frozen model, without additional slide labels. The selector ranks regions from a slide thumbnail, encodes the top K regions at 5x magnification, and selects b for processing at 20x. We evaluate seven frozen MIL aggregators on six tasks and compare them with nine efficient methods trained on the same features and splits. At a budget of (K,b)=(1000,10), encoding costs about 6.6% of the full bag and is 10-14x faster, excluding tiling. The AUROC drop is no more than 0.005 in 33 of 36 aggregator-task pairs. At (500,10), the cost falls to about 4% and inference is 13-22x faster, but AUROC drops by up to 0.035 on CAMELYON17, where small metastases are easily missed. Selection improves over random sampling by about 0.10 AUROC on tasks with focal lesions, while random sampling performs well on diffuse tasks. In our comparisons, the frozen model at (500,10) is ahead of nine efficient methods in 55 of 60 paired comparisons. Giving an existing WSI model fewer tiles is thus a baseline that a new efficient model should be compared with at matched encoder cost.
