articles.title_zh: 在您编码前排名: 读取全滑图像的一小部分
articles.content_zh: 将一整个滑坡图像分类需要用病理基础模型编码上千个高分辨率的瓦片,这占了推论成本的大部分. 现有的高效方法通过选择更少的瓷砖来降低这一成本,但通常围绕其选择策略来训练出一个新的模型. 一个基本上未探索的替代品是将现有的全袋模型冷冻并用同样的编码器成本在选定的瓷砖上运行. 我们采用这种比较,同时以相应的成本随机抽取瓷砖。 要选择瓷砖,我们把一个有3.3K参数的轻量级选择器放入被冷冻的模型的注意下,而不增加幻灯片标签. 选择者从幻灯片缩略图中排列区域,以5x放大来编码上K区域,以20x来选择b进行处理. 我们评价了七个被冻结的MIL集合器的六个任务,并将它们同九个经过同样特征和分块训练的有效方法进行比较。 在(K,b)=(1000,10)的预算中,编码费用约为满袋的6.6%,而且速度快于10-14x,不包括地砖. AUROC的降幅在36个聚合任务对中的33个不超过0.005. 在(500,10)时,成本下降到了约4%,推论速度快于13-22x,但AUROC在CAMELYON17上下降了0.035,在这里很容易错过了小元站. 选择性比随机抽样改进了约0.10 AUROC在有焦病的任务上,随机抽样在分散任务上表现良好。 在我们的比较中,冻结在(500,10)的模型在60对比较的55个中领先于9个高效方法. 因此,减少现有的西安系统模型的瓦片,是按相应的编码器成本对新的有效模型进行比较的基线。

articles.title: PURA: Video Token Pruning via Unified Spatiotemporal Redundancy Assessment
articles.content: Video large language models incur substantial inference costs from long visual token sequences. Existing video token compression methods mitigate these costs by exploiting spatial redundancy within frames and temporal redundancy across frames. However, many approaches impose predefined processing orders or fixed allocation ratios for spatial and temporal compression, limiting their ability to adapt to the varying balance of spatiotemporal redundancy across videos. To address this limitation, we propose PURA, a training-free method that prunes visual tokens through unified spatiotemporal redundancy assessment. For each token, PURA constructs spatial and temporal reference candidates and selects the reference with the lowest representation error across the two dimensions. The representation error is combined with token importance to determine each token's removal cost. To avoid the time overhead of removing the lowest-cost token one by one, we introduce Coordinated Pruning, which iteratively groups mutually compatible low-cost removals into batches for simultaneous execution and updates the pruning state after each batch until the target budget is reached. Extensive experiments on three video large language models and five video understanding benchmarks demonstrate that PURA achieves a favorable trade-off between task performance and inference efficiency.

articles.title_zh: SPURA:通过统一Spatiotemporal冗余评估制作的视频Token Pruning
articles.content_zh: 视频大语言模型从长视符号序列中产生大量推论费用. 现有的视频符号压缩方法通过利用帧内的空间冗余和跨帧的时间冗余来减轻这些成本. 然而,许多方法对空间和时间压缩规定了预先确定的处理命令或固定分配比率,限制了它们适应视频间瞬间冗余的不同平衡的能力。 为了解决这一限制,我们提议采用无培训方法,通过统一的spatiotopal冗余评估来调取视觉符号。 对于每个标志,PURA构建空间和时间参考候选人,并选择两个维度中代表差最小的参考. 表示错误与象征重要性相结合,以确定每个表示物的去除成本. 为了避免一个接一个地去掉最低成本的代号,我们引入了"协调普鲁宁"(Coorded Pruning),它迭代地将相容的低成本清除分成分批进行同时执行,并在每批之后更新普鲁宁状态,直到达到目标预算. 对3个视频大语言模型和5个视频理解基准的广泛实验表明,PURA在任务性能和推断效率之间实现了有利的取舍.

articles.title: Decoder-as-a-Probe: Verbalizing and Steering Visual Representations in LVLMs
articles.content: It is commonly accepted that high-level concepts are represented linearly in the representation space of large neural networks. For Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs), finding those interpretable directions in visual representations is important for interpretability. To find them, the classical approach is to train a linear classifier on the representations, but it needs a large amount of labels and only recovers what can be read from the representations, not what the model actually uses. In this paper we start from the following insight: The LLM Decoder of an LVLM is also a classifier whose classes are the possible next tokens. So we use its first-order Taylor expansion as a linear classifier. Hence, we introduce Decoder-as-a-Probe (DaP), which significantly outperforms classical probing and steering baselines especially when training data is sparse. (1) It verbalizes what an LVLM perceives in a given image. (2) It can surgically change the perception of the LVLM about specific attributes (e.g. change only the color, the clothes worn or the action done). Due to its simplicity and data efficiency, we believe DaP can serve as a plug-and-play tool for LVLM research, such as interpretability, hallucination mitigation or instruction tuning.

articles.title_zh: Dexcoder-as-a-Probe: LVLMs中语言化和引导视觉表现
articles.content_zh: 一般认为,高层次的概念在大型神经网络的表示空间中线性地得到体现. 对于"大视觉语言模型"(LVLMs),在视觉表现中找到这些可解释的方向对于可解释性很重要. 要找到它们,古典的方法是在表示方式上训练出一个线性分类器,但是它需要大量的标签,并且只回收能够从表示方式读取的东西,而不是模型实际使用的东西. 在本文中,我们从以下的见解开始: LLM 解码器(LLM Decoder of a LVLM)也是一个分类器,其类是可能的下个符号. 因此,我们用它的一阶泰勒扩展作为线性分类器. 因此,我们引入了Decoder-as-a-Probe(DaP),这大大超过了传统的探测和引导基线,特别是在培训数据稀少的情况下。 (1) 它将LVLM在给定的图像中所感知的言语化. (2)它可以手术地改变LVLM对特定属性的感知(例如只改变颜色,所穿的衣服或完成的动作). 由于其简洁和数据效率,我们认为DaP可以作为LVLM研究的插件和播放工具,如可解释性,幻觉缓解或指令调取.

articles.title: Long-Horizon Planning with Latent World Models via Graph Anchors
articles.content:
Latent world models plan in a compact latent space by predicting the outcomes of actions. Their planners judge a plan by the latent distance between its
  predicted end state and the goal image. We show that this distance fails in two distinct ways. First, it loses directional signal a few steps from the
  goal, causing distant goals to fail. Second, it weighs the robot arm over the manipulated object, causing manipulation to fail at contact. We measure
  both failures directly on recorded data by asking whether a lower latent distance corresponds to true progress toward the goal. Across five
  environments, six visual representations (including raw pixels and V-JEPA 2), and nine Meta-World tasks, this ranking test cleanly separates the two
  failures, and the graph distance to a goal predicts where closed-loop planning breaks down. Both failures share a single remedy: replacing the distant
  goal with a nearby target that lies on a recorded trajectory. We realize this principle with Graph Anchors, a training-free planner for frozen latent
  world models. It builds a sparse graph once over the model's own training frames and aims each planning step at a node a few moves ahead along the
  shortest path to the goal, keeping paths on recorded transitions wherever contact matters. On goals up to 400 steps away, Graph Anchors raise LeWM's
  success from 13% to 85% on PointMaze-Medium, from 8% to 87% on PointMaze-Large, and from 5% to 71% on Push-T, where stronger search toward the goal
  fails and where prior training-free planners break down under missing step horizons, subsampling shortcuts, or fragmented contact.

articles.title: Tokenisation is not in APX
articles.content: In this paper, we prove that, unless P=NP, no polynomial-time algorithm can find a tokeniser whose objective is within any constant factor of the optimum, meaning that tokenisation is not in the APX complexity class. We prove this for direct and bottom-up tokenisation, under both a compression or unigram log-likelihood objectives, and for binary or larger alphabets. We further show that, even over unary alphabets, direct tokenisation is APX-hard, and thus admits no polynomial-time approximation scheme.

articles.title_zh: 不在APX中进行切入
articles.content_zh: 在本文中,我们证明,除非P=NP,否则任何多诺时算法都找不到一个指向器,其目标在任意最优的恒定因子范围内,意味着指向不是APX复杂类. 我们证明这是直接的和自下而上的, 在一个压缩或Ungram日志相似的目标下, 对于二进制或更大的字母表。 我们进一步表明,即使超过非专用字母表,直接的表示式是APX-hard,因此不接受多名时间近似方案.

articles.title: Can image generation help visual reasoning? An empirical study
articles.content: Language models think in words; then multimodal models might think in images. We test whether a generated helper improves the answer to a visual question. A model describes the helper it needs and then answers using the original and generated images together. Across 13 vision-language model and generator pairs, generation lowers mean accuracy by 3.7 percentage points, with declines on nine of ten tasks. Two unified models, BAGEL and Janus-Pro-7B, each lose accuracy on eight tasks. On VSTAR, adding a generated image to the same planning hint lowers accuracy by 10.47 points. Repeated image edits yield different outcomes across tasks. ChartQAPro and MathVista stay below their no-generation baselines, while ERQA gains three points after ten edits.

ChartQAPro和MathVista都保持低于他们的"不生成"基线,而ERQA则在十次编辑后得到三分.

articles.title: Diverse Alternative Reasoning Traces for Hard Math Problems
articles.content: Post-training large language models (LLMs) for mathematical reasoning often relies on accepted traces whose final answers pass a verifier. For hard math problems, however, such traces can be rare under independent Monte Carlo (MC) sampling. To address this, we propose Diverse Alternative Reasoning Traces (DART), a trace-mining method that starts from a rejected trace, decomposes it into reasoning steps, and ranks them by position-weighted uncertainty. It then generates deliberately distinct alternative candidates for highly ranked steps using reference-answer guidance and a meta-thought before completing the resulting traces. On greedy-unsolved DeepMath-103K problems, DART recovers 37% more problems than MC sampling at a matched number of generated traces. Its estimated generation cost per recovered problem is nearly identical, while its cost per accepted trace is 30% lower. Post-training Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on traces mined by DART achieves the highest point estimate in five of six evaluations across MATH-500 and AIME benchmarks. These results demonstrate that revisiting rejected traces with DART can expand problem coverage and provide effective post-training data.

articles.title_zh: 困难数学问题不同的备选原因追踪
articles.content_zh: 用于数学推理的后训练大语言模型(LLMs)往往依赖于被接受的痕迹,其最终答案通过一个验证器. 然而,对于难以解决的数学问题,在独立的Monte Carlo(MC)采样下,这种痕迹可能很少见. 为了解决这个问题,我们提议了多种替代理性追踪(DART),这是一种从一个被否定的追踪开始的微量开采方法,将其分解为推理步骤,并按位置加权的不确定性排序. 然后,它利用参考答案指南和元思维,在完成所留下的痕迹之前,为排名高的台阶专门产生不同的备选候选人。 在贪婪-未解决的DeepMath-103K问题上,DART在相应数量的生成痕迹中比MC采样恢复了37%的问题. 其每发现问题的估计生成成本几乎相同,而每被接受的微量成本则会降低30%。 在MATH-500和AIME基准的6项评价中,对DART所挖出痕迹的Llama-3.1-8B-进行培训后指示达到最高点估计。 这些结果表明,重新审视与DART有关的被拒绝的痕迹可以扩大问题覆盖面并提供有效的培训后数据。

articles.title: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer
articles.content: Looped Transformers boost expressivity by reusing shared layers across loops, yet at the cost of efficiency. Pushing their expressivity-efficiency frontier requires rethinking the core mechanism connecting adjacent loops: What should be passed as a Transformer loops? We introduce Mixture-of-Loops Transformer (MoLT), whose Mixture-of-Loops Attention (MoLA) uses keys and values (KV) as memory for selective reuse across depths and loops. Under loop residual, MoLT-R retains the residual stream and reads local KV across loops for expressivity. Under loop KV, MoLT-KV instead restarts from embeddings and reads current-loop local KV with preceding-loop memory KV at earlier positions for efficiency. MoLT-KV eliminates same-position cross-loop dependence and, paired with loop forcing for parallel training, unlocks single-traversal Mixture-of-Loops (MoL) decoding beyond the training loop horizon. To balance efficiency and quality, we introduce U-shaped MoLT (U-MoLT), which separates memory construction from prediction readout and skips unused decoder traversals without changing predictions. In 400B-token pretraining, U-MoLT outperforms OLMo3 across 700M/1.5B dense and 3B MoE models, achieving 1.7x validation cross-entropy (CE) token efficiency at 700M while improving 3B MoE 10-domain perplexity by 0.75 and 10-task accuracy by 2.1 percentage points. In 100B-token continued pretraining of Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base, our U-MoLT adaptation lowers CE on all 11 domains over the matched baseline with 1.4x mean token efficiency. At inference, U-MoLT with MoL-Hybrid-2 matches non-looped OLMo3 latency at 996.6 vs. 1,000.6 ms on S-size (~113M) models. Code is available at https://github.com/hustvl/MoLT

articles.title: $μ$-Bench: Benchmarking Multi-User Task Completion in Shared Interaction Voice Agents
articles.content: Voice agents in shared spaces must satisfy interdependent multi-user requests while upholding per-user authority, privacy, and task constraints. Existing evaluations offer limited coverage when participants react throughout a session. We introduce $μ$-Bench, a benchmark for joint task completion in closed-loop, full-duplex multi-user voice interaction. Simulated participants act from isolated profiles of goals, knowledge, and permissions, adapting to the agent's speech and tool outcomes. Across 20 domains, 100 scenarios vary group size, acoustics, and follow-up demands to form 800 cases (408 tool-augmented, 392 tool-free). Joint Task Success (JTS) requires all user goals, privacy boundaries, and terminal states to hold jointly, while Pure JTS further disallows unauthorized tool calls; Attribution, Threading, and Coordination (ATC) diagnostics localize failures. Across 13 voice agents, proprietary systems peak at 62.24\% tool-free and 65.44\% tool-augmented success, while open-weight models remain below 20\%. ATC diagnostics show that open-weight models lag primarily in multi-turn attribution and threading, and controlled contrasts reveal that larger groups consistently degrade joint task success across capable systems. By coupling reactive multi-user simulation with verifiable session-level outcomes, $μ$-Bench provides a rigorous testbed for shared voice agents.

articles.title: DRBench Pro: A Knowledge-Centric Benchmark for Professional Deep Research Agents
articles.content: Deep research agents gather information from multiple sources and synthesize it into reports on complex, open-ended questions. Existing benchmarks assess report quality along several dimensions, but lack a dedicated knowledge-centric evaluation of which research directions a report covers and how deeply it explores them. We introduce DRBench Pro, a benchmark that makes structured knowledge coverage the primary evaluation target. Our automated pipeline builds local knowledge trees from Wikipedia and uses sampled subgraphs to generate research queries and evidence-grounded rubrics. Each rubric corresponds to a relation in the tree, preserving the structure of the knowledge being evaluated. Agents receive only the research query. This structure allows us to measure breadth across major research directions and depth along related knowledge chains, with their geometric mean giving overall coverage. The benchmark includes 144 cases across 24 domains and 44,102 rubrics. Evaluating 16 deep research agents reveals different strengths in breadth and depth, with the best-performing agent reaching 57.04% overall coverage. Rubric judgments agree closely with human annotations, and agent rankings remain stable across the tested metric configurations.

articles.title_zh: DRBench Pro:专业深层研究人员的知识-儿童基准
articles.content_zh: 深层研究代理人从多来源收集信息,并将其综合成关于复杂,开放式问题的报告. 现有基准按几个方面对报告质量进行评估,但缺乏以知识为中心的专门评价,无法了解报告涉及哪些研究方向,并深入探讨这些方向。 我们引入了DRBench Pro,这个基准使结构化的知识覆盖成为首要评价目标. 我们的自动管道从维基百科建立本地知识树,并使用被抽样的子图生成研究查询和以证据为根据的标语. 每个标题对应树上的关系,保留被评价知识的结构. 特工只收到研究查询 这种结构使我们能够在相关知识链上测量主要研究方向的广度和深度,其几何表示涵盖整个范围。 该基准包括24个领域的144个案例和44 102个项目。 评价16个深层研究代理人,发现在广度和深度方面有不同的长处,表现最好的代理人达到57.04%的总覆盖率. 鲁布里克判断与人的说明非常一致,在测试过的度量配置中,代理商排名保持稳定.

articles.title: Proverbs As A Window On Collective Prescriptions
articles.content: Proverbs, as repositories of traditional wisdom, have informed human reasoning for millennia. Yet the collective prescriptions they encode have remained largely unquantified. We introduce a computational framework to analyze nearly 50,000 English-language proverbs. Using large language models, validated against human judgments, we map the topical landscape of proverbs, assess their prescriptive power, and quantify their recommendations on key dimensions of human judgment and behavior. We find that most proverbs are prescriptive, offering guidance in domains under individual control, such as preparation and prudent action, whereas proverbs about uncontrollable circumstances, such as fate and mortality, tend to describe rather than prescribe. When prescriptive proverbs take a consistent stance, they favor caution over risk, long-term over short-term outcomes, honesty over deception, and kindness over malice, and show a moderate tendency toward suspicion over trust. On dimensions involving genuine trade-offs, especially autonomy versus compliance, proverbs provide contradicting advice rather than a single recommendation. This analysis provides a quantitative map of the collective prescriptions in a culture's proverbial wisdom, revealing a core of prudent, honest, and forward-looking guidance alongside varied advice where circumstances dictate the best course of action.

articles.title_zh: 作为集体处方上的窗口
articles.content_zh: Proverbs作为传统智慧的宝库,为人类的推理提供了上千年的信息. 然而,它们所编码的集体处方基本上仍未确定。 我们引入了一个计算框架,分析近5万个英语谚语。 运用大型语言模型,对照人类判断来验证,我们绘制出谚语的时事地貌,评估其指令性能,并量化其对人类判断和行为的关键层面的建议. 我们发现,大多数谚语都是规范性的,为个人控制的领域提供指导,如准备和审慎行动,而关于命运和死亡等不可控制情况的谚语则倾向于描述而不是规定。 当规范性谚语采取一贯立场时,它们倾向于谨慎而不是风险、长期而不是短期结果、诚实而不是欺骗、善意而不是恶意,并表现出怀疑而不是信任的温和倾向。 关于涉及真正取舍的方面,特别是自治与遵守,谚语提供了相互矛盾的建议,而不是单一的建议。 这一分析提供了一种文化的通俗智慧中集体处方的量化图,揭示出一套审慎、诚实和前瞻性的核心指导,以及各种建议,如果情况决定了最佳行动方针。

articles.title: Repairing the Trustworthiness of Distilled Language Models
articles.content: Knowledge distillation enables the deployment of large language models through smaller student models, but the compression process can introduce regressions in trustworthiness even when downstream performance is preserved. Repairing such failures is challenging because the original distillation corpus is often unavailable, while direct preference optimization may alter capabilities inherited from the teacher. We propose a targeted repair framework based on the proximal Bregman response function (PBRF) that addresses both limitations. We estimate the curvature required for PBRF using a surrogate proxy dataset, removing dependence on the original transfer corpus, and extend the framework to preference-based supervision through an odds-ratio objective. This enables the use of preferred and dispreferred response pairs while constraining changes to the distilled model. Our results show that the proposed approach improves targeted trustworthiness behaviors for both pre-training and post-training models while largely preserving downstream performance, providing a practical alternative to re-distillation or unconstrained preference optimization. Our experiment results show that across different distilled models, the trustworthy regression can be improved by up to 8% with less than 1% decrement in perplexity.

articles.title_zh: 修复抖动语言模型的可信赖性
articles.content_zh: 知识分馏能够通过较小的学生模型来部署大型语言模型,但压缩过程可以引入可信赖性的回归,即使下游性能得到保存. 修复这种故障具有挑战性,因为原先的蒸馏器往往不可用,而直接的偏好优化可能会改变教师继承的能力。 我们提议在Bregman近距离反应功能(PBRF)的基础上建立一个目标明确的修理框架,以解决这两个局限性。 我们使用代用代用数据集估算PBRF所需的曲率,去除对原始转移委托书的依赖,并通过概率-率目标将框架扩展到基于偏好的监督. 这样可以使用首选和不首选的反应对并同时限制对蒸馏模型的修改. 我们的结果表明,拟议办法改进了培训前和培训后模式的针对性可信赖性行为,同时在很大程度上保留了下游的绩效,为重新消化或不受限制的优化优惠提供了一个切实可行的替代办法。 我们的实验结果显示,在不同的蒸馏模型中, 值得信赖的回归可以改善8%, 而在复杂度上降低不到1%。

articles.title: The Linguistic Knowledge Benchmark: Do Language Models Know the Foundations of Early-Grade Literacy?
articles.content: Many languages of instruction in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) are poorly represented in the data used to train language models. Before these models can support early-grade literacy in such languages, we need to know whether they hold the linguistic knowledge of each language that literacy teaching relies on. To test this, we present the Linguistic Knowledge Benchmark and the reproducible, largely automated pipeline that turns curriculum documents, teacher guides and pupil books into a vetted question set organised on a fixed grid of nine linguistic domains and seven grade levels. The pipeline combines LLM-driven source survey, feature consolidation, item generation and quality control with an item-selection step inspired by item response theory and a final expert review. We instantiate it for Kiswahili (Kenya; 135 items) and English (United Kingdom; 137 items) and evaluate 121 and 119 models respectively. Frontier models exceed 90% accuracy in both languages, but accuracy falls steeply for smaller and cheaper models, and more so in Kiswahili. The two best models under 10 billion parameters reach 91.7% and 73.0% in English but only 51.9% and 40.7% in Kiswahili, and the mean accuracy of models deployable on mobile and tablet hardware is 47% in English against 24% in Kiswahili. The models most practical for low-resource classrooms are therefore the least capable in the languages they would serve. We release a 20-item sample per language, all pipeline prompts, open-source code, and a public leaderboard. This is the first rung of a three-level evaluation ladder for measuring and generating decodable text to support foundational literacy.

articles.title_zh: 语言知识基准:通用语言模型 知道早期识字的基础吗?
articles.content_zh: 中低收入国家的许多教学语言在用于培训语言模型的数据中代表性不足。 在这些模式能够支持这种语言的早期识字之前,我们需要知道它们是否掌握识字教学所依赖的每一种语言的语言知识。 为了检验这一点,我们提出了语言知识基准和可复制的、基本上自动化的管道,将课程文件、教师指南和学生书籍变成一个经过审查的问题集,由九个语言领域和七个年级组成的固定网格。 管道将LLM驱动源调查,特征整合,项目生成和质量控制与项目响应理论所启发的项目选择步骤和最终专家评审相结合. 我们对斯瓦希里语(肯尼亚;135个项目)和英语(联合王国;137个项目)进行即时评估,并分别评价121个和119个模型。 边疆模型在两种语言中都超过了90%的精度,但是对于更小更便宜的模型来说,精度急剧下降,在斯瓦希里语中尤其如此. 在100亿参数下的两个最佳模型在英语中分别达到91.7%和73.0%,但在斯瓦希里语中只有51.9%和40.7%,在移动和平板硬件上可部署的模型在英语中的平均精度为47%,而在斯瓦希里语中则为24%. 因此,最实用的低资源教室模式在所服务的语文方面最不可行。 我们发布一个20项样本 每种语言,所有管道提示,开源代码, 和一个公共领导板。 这是衡量和生成可解码文本以支持基础扫盲的三级评价梯级的第一组。

articles.title: VulnSafe: Measuring Vulnerability-Aware Relational Safety in Large Language Models
articles.content: Emotionally supportive interactions require large language models not only to avoid overtly harmful content, but also to recognize vulnerability-related risk, regulate their relational stance, preserve user agency, and provide context-appropriate support. Existing safety benchmarks often measure isolated violations, leaving unclear what underlying response competence their scores represent. We introduce VulnSafe, a Chinese capability assessment centered on Vulnerability-Aware Response Competence (VARC). VARC organizes relational safety into five complementary constructs: Risk Perception, Safety Preservation, Autonomy Protection, Supportive Response, and Boundary Management. Following an evidence-centered design, 41 scenarios elicit construct-relevant behavior through 2,050 balanced prompts and scenario-specific scoring rubrics. The assessment further separates proactive should-do behavior from prohibitive should-not behavior. Across eight representative LLMs, results show distinct competence profiles and larger disparities than prohibitive requirements. VulnSafe therefore makes relational safety interpretable as a multidimensional model capability rather than as refusal compliance alone.

articles.title_zh: VulnSafe:衡量脆弱性 -- -- 大语言模型中注意关系安全
articles.content_zh: 情感上的支持性互动需要大型语言模型,这不仅是为了避免明显有害的内容,而且是为了识别与脆弱性有关的风险,调节其关系姿态,维护用户代理,提供适合具体情况的支持. 现有的安全基准往往衡量孤立的侵权行为,因此不清楚其分数代表何种基本的应对能力。 我们介绍VulnSafe,这是中国的一项能力评估,其核心是脆弱-警觉反应能力。 VARC将关系安全组织成五个互补结构:风险感知、安全保全、自主保护、辅助反应和边界管理。 根据以证据为中心的设计,41个情景通过2,050个平衡的提示和具体情景的评分分分来引发与构造有关的行为。 评估进一步区分了主动应做的行为和令人望而却步的行为。 八个具有代表性的法学硕士课程的结果表明,与令人望而却步的要求相比,能力特点不同,差距更大。 因此,VulnSafe将关系安全解释为一种多层面的模型能力,而不仅仅是拒绝遵守。

articles.title: PersonaFactory: Stylistic User Prompt Augmentation with Synthetic Persona Bank
articles.content: Large language models increasingly replace real people in the AI development pipeline, as they are used to generate training dialogues at scale and to drive alignment and evaluation. However, out-of-the-box models produce monolingual and stylistically flat texts as synthetic user prompts, failing to replicate the real user-AI communication mechanics. We present PersonaFactory, an end-to-end pipeline that generates detailed user personas and uses them to augment existing user prompts from their point of view, producing a bank of over 740000 structured synthetic personas detailing their background and communication behaviors, and a corpus of roughly 1.24 million persona-styled synthetic conversations spanning 85 languages. We evaluate the effect of personal features on style adoption and intent preservation, using an LLM-judge and heuristic metrics to assess augmentation fidelity together with the downstream impact on assistant persona control through training data. Results show that our structured, attribute-based style representation enables per-axis control and better intent preservation at comparable style fidelity than free-text persona descriptions used in existing methods. A human expert evaluation found the augmented conversations plausible, with favorable ratings for intent preservation, style naturalness, and multilingual authenticity. Finally, PersonaFactory conversations achieve comparable performance to original training data on capability benchmarks, are preferred on real user prompts at equal reply length, and adapt their reply style more closely to users without explicit steering.

articles.title_zh: Persona Factory: Stylistic 用户与合成人银行的快速增强
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模式越来越多地取代AI开发管道中的真实人员,因为这些模式被用于形成规模化的训练对话并驱动校正和评价. 然而,出箱模型作为合成用户的提示,产生单语言和风格平坦的文本,未能复制真正的用户-AI通信力学. 我们介绍PersonaFactory,一个端到端的管道,生成详细的用户人物并利用它们从他们的角度来增强现有的用户提示,生成一个超过740000个结构化合成人的银行,详细介绍他们的背景和交流行为,以及大约124万个人形合成对话,涵盖85种语言。 我们评估个人特征对采用风格和意向保护的影响,使用LLM法官和高压衡量标准评估增强忠诚度,以及通过培训数据对助理人员控制产生的下游影响。 结果显示,我们的结构化的、基于属性的风格表现使得每个轴能够控制,并且比现有方法中使用的自由文字人物描述更能保持相似的风格忠诚。 一项人类专家评价认为,增加的对话是可信的,对意图保全、风格自然和多语种真实性给予有利的评价。 最后,PersonaFactory对话实现了与能力基准原始培训数据的可比较性能,在真实的用户提示上首选了相同的回执长度,并在没有明确引导的情况下更紧密地适应用户的回执风格.

articles.title: When Every Rollout Fails: Splicing Learner-Conditioned Options into Long-Horizon Agent RL
articles.content: Group-based reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards often yields all-fail groups on long-horizon agent tasks: every sampled trajectory receives zero reward, leaving group-relative methods without a reward-based policy gradient. A common remedy supplies complete solutions from a stronger model, but full trajectories are expensive and expose the learner to long off-policy histories. We introduce SPLICE, which constructs local training targets from failed current-policy trajectories online. For each all-fail group, a proposal model selects a splice point in a current-policy trajectory and generates several bounded options from that point. We estimate each option's value using repeated current-policy continuations, convert positive estimates into a return-weighted local target, and fit the current policy on the options. We evaluate SPLICE across two policy families on two long-horizon agent tasks, Software Engineering with SWE-bench Verified and Deep Research with BrowseComp-Plus. SPLICE outperforms GRPO and full-trajectory guidance baselines in all four settings, improving over GRPO by 2.8--9.8 percentage points. On initially failed SWE tasks, it raises GRPO's graduation rate by 10.8 percentage points. Further experiments show that SPLICE improves performance while reducing costly proposal-model computation.

articles.title_zh: 当每一次推出失败时:将学习者有条件的选项复制到长视代理 RL
articles.content_zh: 基于团体的有可核查的奖励的强化学习,往往让全失败的团体承担长视野的代理任务:每个被抽样的轨迹都得到零奖励,使团体相对的方法没有基于奖励的政策梯度. 共同的补救方法从更强大的模型中提供完整的解决方案,但完整的轨迹代价高昂并让学习者接触到长期不政策的历史. 我们引入了SPLICE,它从当前政策失败的线上构建出本地培训目标. 对于每个全失败组,一个建议书模型会选择当前政策轨迹中的相接点,并从该点产生几个有界限的选项. 我们利用重复的当前政策延续来估计每个选项的价值,将正值估计数转换成一个加权的当地目标,并适应目前关于选项的政策。 我们评价了两个政策家族的SPLICE, 两项长距离代理任务, 软件工程与SWE-bench验证, 和深层研究与浏览Comp-Plus。 SPLICE 成绩优于 GRPO和所有四种环境下的全导轨指导基线,比GRPO提高了2.8-9.8个百分点. 在最初失败的SWE任务上,它提高了GRPO的毕业率10.8个百分点. 进一步的实验表明,SPLICE提高了性能,同时降低了昂贵的建议书模型计算.

articles.title: DFly2: Turbocharging Long-Context Speculative Decoding by Sharing the Target's Sparsity
articles.content: To avoid the quadratic cost of dense attention over long contexts, models such as DeepSeek-V4 and Hy4 have turned natively sparse, and speculative decoding, which matters most where decoding is slowest, increasingly runs on them. Their drafters, however, still keep a context cache of their own, over the whole prompt or a sliding window. Beyond memory, such a cache costs prefill time, prefix-cache hits and decode concurrency. Drafters that read the target's cache avoid one of their own, but settle only which cache, not which positions, and still read everything or a recent window. Neither rule is made for the query at hand, and computing a selection per query in the drafter would cost more as the context grows. Yet a natively sparse target already picks positions for each query, over a cache it keeps anyway. Both of the drafter's choices are therefore already made, and paid for, by the target: its cache and its selection. We measure how far one selection carries: made a step early, it still covers close to nine tenths of what each later token selects on DS-V4.1-Flash. We present DFly2, a block-parallel drafter that shares the target's sparsity. Each draft layer reads the KV its paired target layer cached (KV sharing), at the positions that layer's indexer selected, a fixed number anywhere in the context (Index sharing). DFly2 thus runs no scoring pass and keeps no cache of its own. On DS-V4.1-Flash, GLM-5.3-Flash and Hy4~flash, whose sparse attention and architecture differ, it accepts more tokens per step than DFlash and DSpark trained on the same recipe, over general, long-context and agentic benchmarks. Its margin over the stronger baseline widens from 3.9%-10.5% on general workloads to 10.0%-31.5% on long-context and agentic ones. At high concurrency on DS-V4.1-Flash, at matched per-user decode speed, its throughput is 62% and 81% higher on two 64K sets.

articles.title_zh: DFly2: 涡轮充电长文本分光解码 通过共享目标分光
articles.content_zh: 为了避免在长时间内引起密集关注的四重成本,DeepSeek-V4和Hy4等模型已变成本土稀有,而投机性解码(在解码速度最慢的地方最为重要)则越来越多地运行在它们身上. 然而,他们的起草者仍然保留着他们自己的上下文缓存,覆盖整个快取或滑动窗口. 除了内存之外,这样的缓存会花费预填时间,前缀-cache点击并解码通用语. 阅读目标缓存的起草者会回避自己的一个,但只结算哪个缓存,而不是哪个位置,仍然会读出所有内容或最近的窗口. 没有为手头的查询制定规则,随着上下文的增长,计算起草器中每个查询的选取成本会更高. 然而,一个本地人稀少的目标已经选择了每个查询的位置,通过它保存的缓存。 因此,起草者的两种选择都已经由目标作出和支付:它的缓存和选择. 我们测量一个选择带多远: 提前一步,它仍然覆盖 近十分之九的后期 符号选择在DS-V4.1-Flash上。 我们提出DFly2, 一个块平行的起草器, 分享目标 sparersity。 每个草稿层读取其配对的目标层缓存(KV share),在所选择的层索引器位置上,在上下文的任何地方(Index share)都有一个固定的数字. DFly2因此运行了没有得分的通关并保留了自己的缓存. 在DS-V4.1-Flash,GLM-5.3-Flash和Hy4~flash上,它们的注意力和架构不尽相同,它们每步接受比DFlash和DSpark接受相同食谱训练,比一般,长文和代理基准还要多. 其高于较强基线的幅度从一般工作量的3.9%至10.5%增至长文和代理工作量的10.5%至31.5%。 在DS-V4.1-Flash的高通货率下,以对应的每个用户解码速度,它在两套64K的通货量为62%和81%.

articles.title: One Model, Many Modes: Evolving System Prompt Ensembles for Creative Generation
articles.content: Preference-aligned LLMs can exhibit mode collapse, concentrating their output distributions around a narrow set of high-reward responses. This limits creative generation, which requires quality, novelty, and diversity. Existing test-time methods often emphasize diversity, giving less attention to whether individual responses are both high-quality and novel. This distinction matters in practical use, where users may seek a single compelling, original response. We formalize creative generation as a multi-objective distributional optimization problem and introduce SEPO, a training-free framework for System Prompt Ensemble Optimization. The framework combines prompt evolution with greedy max-min selection to identify behaviorally distinct system prompts under a quality constraint, then uniformly samples one prompt per response at inference time. Across four creative generation tasks with increasing quality requirements and three open-weight models, SEPO ranks first in 8 of 12 settings on the harmonic mean of quality, diversity, and novelty, while no baseline leads in more than two. On average, it raises LLM-judged diversity from 1.92 to 3.43 and novelty from 1.00 to 3.34 over base sampling (1-5 scale), with quality decreasing from 3.72 to 3.30. We further show that expanding the optimized ensemble increases separation among prompt-conditioned response distributions. These results support system prompt ensemble optimization as a promising approach to improving LLM creativity at inference time.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 一种模式,多种模式: 演化系统 即兴创作集
articles.content_zh: 偏好相通的LLMs可以显示模式崩溃,将其输出分布集中在一套狭窄的高回报响应上. 这限制了创造力,这需要质量、新颖性和多样性。 现有的试验时间方法往往强调多样性,较少注意个人反应是否既高质量又新颖. 这种区分在实际应用中很重要,用户可以寻求单一的令人信服的原始反应。 我们正式将创造力生成作为一个多目标分布优化问题,并引入SEPO,即系统即时优化的无培训框架. 框架结合了即时演化和贪婪的"最大分量"选择,以识别在质量约束下行为区分的系统提示,然后在推论时间统一抽取出每个回复一个即时. 在质量要求不断提高的4个创造性发电任务和3个开放重量型号中,SEPO在12个环境中,在质量、多样性和新颖性等口号的8个中排名第一,而在两个以上没有基线领先。 平均而言,在基准采样(1至5个尺度)上,LLM判定的多样性从1.92提高到3.43,新颖性从1.00提高到3.34,质量从3.72下降到3.30。 我们进一步显示,扩大优化后的综艺节目会增加快速条件反应分布之间的分离. 这些成果支持系统促进综艺优化,作为在推断时间提高LLM创造力的有希望的方法.

articles.title: Reading Fine-Tuning Diffs Through Lenses: Model Diffing for Backdoor Detection
articles.content: We introduce a common scoring system based on token readouts to evaluate weight, activation and output-based model diffing methods for backdoor detection in fine-tuning processes. We also improve existing weight and activation based methods by incorporating the $J$-lens and its refinement, the $J{+}{+}$-lens. We test our setup in experiments where we compare a backdoored model with the base model from which it was fine-tuned. Our results show that incorporating the $J{+}{+}$-lens improves the weight-based method in all our settings, while the $J$-lens improves its ranks within single layers. The strongest single method is $ΔW J{+}{+}$, the weight difference decoded through the $J{+}{+}$-lens of the base model, which ranks a token naming the backdoor among its first ten tokens in 11 of our 12 settings. Moreover, we show that output and activation based methods such as ADL and Diff Mining can easily break if the backdoored model is penalised during fine-tuning for giving the backdoor's words probability on clean inputs, whereas the weight-based methods are not affected. Conversely, permuting the hidden units or training only the layers that read the residual stream hides the backdoor from the weight-based methods but not from ADL and Diff Mining. No single method resists both attacks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过镜头读取 Fine-Tuning Diffs:用于后门检测的模型 Diffing
articles.content_zh: 我们采用了基于符号读取的通用分分数系统来评价重量,激活和输出的模型分量方法,用于微调过程中的后门检测. 我们还改进了现有的加权法和基于激活法的方法,将日元贷款及其完善,即日元贷款纳入其中。 我们在实验中测试我们的设置, 我们比较一个后门模型 与基础模型, 从它微调。 我们的结果显示,纳入美元-美元-仑可以改善我们所有环境中的权重方法,而美元-仑则提高单层内的地位。 最强的单一方法为$ΔW J{+}{+}$,通过基模$J{+}{+}$-lens解码出重量相差值,将后门命名为"后门"的符号排在我们12个设置中第11个的10个符号中. 此外,我们表明,如果在对后门模型进行微调时对输出和活化方法,如ADL和Diff Mining进行微调,使后门的词有可能是清洁输入,而重量方法则不受影响,那么这些方法很容易被打破。 反之,穿透隐藏的单元或训练只有读取残流的地层隐藏了后门的重量法,而不是ADL和Diff Mining. 没有任何单一的方法能抵抗两种攻击.

articles.title: Collect for Coverage, Replay with Evidence: Adaptive and Efficient On-Policy Distillation for Long-Horizon Agents
articles.content: Fully online on-policy distillation (OPD) is costly for long-horizon agents because each update depends on fresh environment rollouts. Prefix replay offers an efficient alternative by sampling current-student responses from stored histories, reducing idle time for long-tail rollouts and allowing each collected trajectory to support multiple updates. However, our analysis of the complete prefix replay pipeline identifies two limitations in long-horizon settings. In trajectory collection, teacher-only trajectories miss student-induced histories, while broader history coverage can reduce teacher reliability. In trajectory reuse, fixed position-based schedules cannot identify critical decisions that may occur at any trajectory depth. We introduce CARE-OPD (Collect for coverAge, Replay with Evidence) to address both limitations. Student-seeded teacher completions and response-level confidence gating expand history coverage while filtering unreliable updates. Hindsight replay allocation then uses downstream execution evidence to select consequential turns. Across long-horizon tasks Software Engineering and Deep Research, CARE-OPD outperforms online OPD and prior prefix replay baselines. On SWE-bench Verified, it raises task success to 59.5% while reducing end-to-end training time by 45% and environment actions by 44% relative to asynchronous online OPD.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 收集报道,重放证据:长视线特工的适应性和高效政策扭曲
articles.content_zh: 全面在线政策蒸馏(OPD)对于长视剂来说成本高昂,因为每次更新都取决于新鲜环境的推出. 前缀重放提供了一个高效的替代方案,从所储存的历史中取样流子学生的响应,减少长尾展开的闲置时间,并允许所收集的每个轨迹支持多个更新. 然而,我们对完整前缀回放管道的分析确定了长视环境的两个局限性. 在轨迹收集中,只有教师的轨迹错过了学生引起的历史,而更广泛的历史覆盖范围可以降低教师的可靠性. 在轨迹再利用中,基于固定位置的时间表无法确定可能在任何轨迹深度上作出的关键决定。 我们引入了CARE-OPD(Collect for CoverAge, Replay with Effective),以解决这两个局限性. 学生种子教师完成和响应级信心相克扩大了历史覆盖范围,同时过滤不可靠的更新. Hindsight再播放分配,然后使用下游执行证据来选择相应的转弯. 在整个长视野任务软件工程和深层研究中,CARE-OPD在在线OPD和前缀重放基线上都超越了业绩. 在SWE-bench验证中,它将任务成功率提高到59.5%,同时相对于同步在线OPD将端到端培训时间减少45%,环境行动减少44%.

articles.title: Bigger Model or Bigger Table? How Much Backbone a Chorus N-gram Module Replaces
articles.content: We ask how much of a transformer's backbone the Chorus N-gram module replaces. Chorus adds hashed tables of token bigrams and trigrams to its input and attention. We train models of 16M to 349M parameters on 1.34 billion tokens of Polish printed before 1918 and find the size of a plain model with the same held-out loss. A separate learning-rate search for each kind of model cuts Chorus's gain at 47M by about a third. With tables about as large as the backbone, Chorus then matches a plain model 1.34 times its size at 16M and 1.16 to 1.20 times from 107M to 349M. With these tables, each added parameter replaces at most 0.31 backbone parameters. Chorus trains slower than a plain model of its size and faster than one of the same loss. On a fact quiz the two differ about as much as two seeds of one model. The results rest on one corpus, one 8,000-token vocabulary and a fifth of an epoch.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 大模型还是大桌子? 一个Chorus N-gram模块替换多少后骨
articles.content_zh: 我们问一台变压器的骨干中有多少Chorus N-gram模块取代. Chors在其投入和关注中还加入了散列的符牌大写和三写表. 我们把16M到349M参数的模型训练在1918年以前印刷的13.4亿个波兰令牌上,并找到同样被搁置损失的平地模型的大小. 对每种模型的单独学习率搜索,将Chorus在47M的增益削减了大约三分之一. 配上约与骨干相大型的表格后,Chorus再与平地型号相匹配,其尺寸为1,6M的1.34倍,而从107M到349M的1.16到1.20倍. 通过这些表格,每个新增参数最多替换0.31个主干参数. 相较于大小平坦的模型而速度快于同一种损失. 事实上,在一项测试中,两种不同, 大约两个种子 一个型号。 其结果仅取自一个体格,一个8000个托克词汇和一个纪元的五分之一.

articles.title: From Shared Patterns to Individual Evidence: Two-Stage Reasoning for Emerging Entities in Temporal Knowledge Graphs
articles.content: Temporal knowledge graphs (TKGs) continually introduce emerging entities whose interaction histories evolve from zero-shot debuts into sparse, bursty few-shot trajectories. However, current paradigms are fragmented: pattern-transfer methods lack catalog-wide event memory, whereas online memory models suffer from endpoint-role asymmetry that degrades unseen-answer ranking. Furthermore, sparse early interactions exhibit both long-range dispersion and local redundancy under skewed distribution. To address these challenges, we propose INSPIRE (Integrating Shared Patterns and Individual Evidence for Reasoning), a two-stage forecasting framework over a known catalog. In Stage I, INSPIRE learns an availability-aware shared-pattern predictor that fuses event-updated memory across the full candidate catalog while applying coordinated query- and catalog-side masking. Subsequently, Stage II freezes this predictor and optimizes a lightweight individual-evidence adapter (EA) combining textual semantic priors with correlation-weighted long-range event statistics under support- and role-balanced co-answer supervision with prior-odds debiasing and soft residual alignment. In addition, we decompose evaluation by endpoint roles and track longitudinal emerging-answer cohorts via query-micro and answer-entity macro metrics. Across four benchmarks based on the ICEWS and GDELT event datasets, INSPIRE improves Emerging MRR by 16.73%-88.83% over the strongest baselines. Relative to paired Stage I predictors, EA further increases Emerging MRR by 8.28%-32.63%, Answer-new MRR by 7.81%-41.24%, and cohort macro MRR by 9.64%-39.94%, gains attributed to semantic priors and candidate-level score competition suppressing mismatched established competitors without zero-support prior shortcuts. The official code is publicly available at https://github.com/KcAcoZhang/INSPIRE.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从共享模式到个人证据:新兴实体在临时知识图中的双层理由
articles.content_zh: 时空知识图(TKGs)不断引入新兴实体,其互动历史从零镜头起步演化为稀有的多镜头轨迹. 然而,目前的范式是支离破碎的:模式-传输方法缺乏全目录的事件内存,而在线内存模型则会受端点-作用不对称的困扰而退化出未见答案的排名. 此外,分散的早期相互作用很稀少,在分布偏差的情况下,还存在局部冗余现象。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议综合共享模式和个人证据以说明理由,一个双阶段预测框架,取代已知目录。 在第一阶段,INSPIRE学习了一种可用感知的共享模式预测器,该预测器将事件更新的内存贯穿整个候选目录,同时采用协调的查询和目录侧面掩码。 随后,第二阶段冻结了这个预测器,并优化了一种轻量级个人证据适配器(EA),在支持和角色平衡的共答监督下,将文字语义前缀与相关加权长距离事件统计结合,与前缀去比和软后缀相配合. 此外,我们按端点角色分解评价,并通过查询-微观和答复-实体宏观尺度跟踪纵向新兴回答组。 在基于ICEWS和GDELT事件数据集的四项基准中,INSPIRE将新兴的MRR比最强的基线提高16.73%-88.83%. 相对于配对的第一阶段预测器,EA进一步将新兴的MRR增加了8.28%-32.63%,Answer-new MRR增加了7.81%-41.24%,组群宏观MRR增加了9.64%-39.94%,归结于语义学前科和候选级别的分数竞争,抑制了没有事先零支持的已建立竞争对手. 官方代码可在https://github.com/KcAcoZhang/INSPIRE上公开查阅.

articles.title: When the Proxy Is Wrong: Mismatch-Corrected Bandits for Adaptive Data Sampling
articles.content: Data allocation methods often use a small proxy model to select training data for a larger target model. However, this proxy can rank data differently from the target, leading to suboptimal training performance. To address this problem, we model the mismatch between the proxy and target models and incorporate it into the allocation decision. To do so, the problem is cast as a multi-fidelity bandit, where each arm is a data intervention. The proxy reward is observed every round, whereas the target reward is revealed only on rare audits of the same update. These paired observations identify arm-wise mismatches without assuming a shared offset or preservation of rankings. Mismatch-corrected bandits correct the proxy with paired residuals, audit only uncertain decisions, and pace the audit budget over training. From a theoretical viewpoint, we prove a regret decomposition and lower bounds under stationarity. These bounds show that proxy-only allocation can incur linear regret and that a minimum number of paired audits is necessary. Under abrupt changes, using the audit budget early can also incur linear regret. A sliding-window policy that spreads audits over training achieves regret of order $\sqrt{Γ_T T\log T}$ where $Γ_T$ denotes the number of change points. Experimentally, we test the approach in a closed-loop proof of concept on CivilComments-WILDS, where BERT-Small guides the training of BERT-Large. Mismatch correction improves worst-group accuracy over a target-only policy with the same target-model budget. Spreading audits over training improves worst-group accuracy by 6.3 to 10.5 percentage points at the same audit count.

articles.title_zh: 当代理错误时:用于适应性数据抽样的错配-校正匪类
articles.content_zh: 数据分配方法经常使用一个小的代理模型来选择培训数据,用于更大的目标模型. 然而,这个代理可以对数据进行与目标不同的排序,导致培训表现不理想. 为了解决这一问题,我们模拟代理模式与目标模式之间的不匹配,并将其纳入分配决定. 为此,问题被铸成多信仰的强盗,每个臂都是数据干预. 代理奖赏每轮都遵守,而目标奖赏则只在对相同更新的罕见审计中披露. 这些对齐的观测发现臂与臂的错配,而不假设共享相抵或保留排名. 错失校正的匪徒会用配对的残余来纠正代理,审计只有不确定的决定,审计预算速度会比培训更快. 从理论上来说,我们证明了一种遗憾的分解和在站立性下的下限。 这些界限表明,只有代理分配才能引起线性遗憾,必须至少进行对等审计。 在突然变化的情况下,及早使用审计预算也可能造成线性遗憾。 将审计分散于培训的滑入窗口政策对订单$\sqrt\T造成遗憾 T\log T} $ 表示变化点数的美元 。 在Civil Pops-WILDS上,我们通过一个封闭式的概念证明来测试这个方法,BERT-Small指导BERT-Large的训练. 错误的校正提高了最差组的准确性,优于具有相同目标模式预算的仅标政策. 对培训进行分散审计,使最坏群体的准确性在同一审计点上提高了6.3至10.5个百分点。

articles.title: PoVi: Agentic Poetry-to-Video Generation with Knowledge Grounding and Figurative Understanding
articles.content: Poetry-to-video generation requires more than translating text into visual scenes. Poetic language is highly compressed, often depends on historical and cultural knowledge, and frequently conveys meaning through metaphor, imagery, and other non-literal expressions. We introduce PoVi, a benchmark and agentic framework for grounded poetry-to-video generation, evaluating semantic grounding, discourse coherence, and audiovisual realization. PoVi reconstructs poem semantics into an evidence-bounded representation and progressively transforms them into narration, interpretation, character assets, and shot-level visual plans, followed by narration-aligned video generation. Across three planning backbones and four video generators, PoVi consistently improves over single-call generation, with the largest gains on implicit background knowledge and metaphorical relations. PoVi provides a testbed for studying knowledge-grounded, long-horizon multimodal generation beyond direct text-to-video synthesis.

articles.title_zh: PoVi:具有知识基础和形象理解的代理诗作到影视创作
articles.content_zh: "从诗到视频"的生成需要的不仅仅是将文字翻译成视觉场景. 诗歌语言被高度压缩,常常依赖于历史和文化知识,并经常通过比喻,图像等非文学表达来表达意义. 我们引入了PoVi,这是一个基于诗歌到视频生成的基准和代理框架,评价语义定位、话语一致性和视听实现。 PoVi将"诗语义"重建为以证据为界的代表作,并逐渐将其转化为叙事,诠释,人物资产,并有镜头级的视觉计划,再由叙事相接的视频生成. 在三个规划主干线和四个视频发电机中,PoVi在单调生成上不断改进,在隐含背景知识和比喻关系上收益最大. PoVi提供了一个测试台,用于研究超越直接文本到视频合成的基于知识的长视多模式生成.

articles.title: Technical Report MEG2text: Beyond Alignment in Non-Invasive Brain-to-Text
articles.content: Non-invasive brain-to-text seeks to recover language from brain activity without surgery. A central challenge is turning learned brain-language representations into accurate word predictions. We present MEG2text, a decoding system that combines corrected training and evaluation, brain-text alignment, a class-balanced word readout, and target-word language-model fusion. On LibriBrain100's word-ranking task, MEG2text reaches 64.12% mean Top-10 balanced accuracy, improving on published MEG-XL by 16.92 percentage points across four corpora, with gains on each corpus. Controlled comparisons show that both implementation corrections and a learned readout contribute to this improvement. Candidate-level analysis reveals that some words receive informative scores yet consistently lose to competing candidates, while an identical-feature comparison shows that learning the classification rule improves decoding without changing the representation. These findings identify the decoding rule as a consequential part of non-invasive brain-to-text and show how system improvements can make better use of aligned neural features.

articles.title_zh: 技术报告MEG2text:超越非侵入性大脑对文本的对齐
articles.content_zh: 非侵入性脑到文字寻求从脑活中恢复语言而无需手术. 一项核心挑战是将所学的脑语言表述转化为准确的字词预测. 我们介绍MEG2text,一种将校正的训练和评价,脑文本对齐,班级平衡的单词读取,以及目标词语言模型聚变相结合的解码系统. 在LibriBrain100的文字排行任务上,MEG2text达到了64.12%的TOP-10平衡精度,在公布的MEG-XL上提高了16.92个百分点,在4个Corpora上,每件都取得了收益. 控制下的比较表明,实施纠正和学习的宣读都有助于这一改进。 候选人一级的分析显示,有些词获得信息性分数,但一直输给竞争对手,而一个相同特点的比较表明,学习分类规则可以改善编解码,而不会改变代表性。 这些发现将解码规则确定为非侵入性脑到文字的必然部分,并显示系统改进如何能更好地利用对齐神经特征.

articles.title: Neural Rendering Compiler: Generative Video Models as Programmable Renderers
articles.content: Generative video models are becoming powerful renderers, yet lack the predictable control interfaces of conventional systems such as HTML/CSS engines or Blender. Their capabilities emerge implicitly from training, making it difficult to determine what they can reliably execute. We present Neural Rendering Compiler (NeurCo), which automatically probes frozen video models to construct model-specific capability manuals describing which semantic requirements they can reliably satisfy. NeurCo represents user intent in a model-agnostic intermediate representation of objects, constraints, events, and cameras, then compiles it into model-specific execution strategies. Reliable requirements remain unchanged, while unreliable ones are selectively rewritten or compiled into alternative execution strategies. We introduce VComBench, a benchmark of 380 compositional, multi-requirement tasks spanning text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video generation. NeurCo improves requirement satisfaction from 46.8% to 52.3% on Wan and from 66.5% to 69.3% on Minimax H3, and achieves further gains when combined with prompt enhancers, including on Seedance 2.5. Our analysis reveals model-specific differences in control capabilities and trade-offs between controllability and photorealism, highlighting capability-guided compilation as a promising approach to programmable generative video rendering.

articles.title_zh: 神经渲染编译器:作为可编程渲染器的基因视频模型
articles.content_zh: 基因视频模型正在成为强大的渲染器,但缺乏HTML/CSS引擎或Blender等常规系统的可预见控制接口. 他们的能力从培训中隐含地产生,因此难以确定他们能够可靠地执行什么。 我们介绍神经渲染编译器(英语:Neural Rendering Compiler (NeurCo)),它自动探测被冻结的视频模型来构建模型特定的能力手册,描述哪些语义要求可以可靠地满足. NeurCo在对对象,约束,事件,相机的模型不可知的中间表示中代表了用户的意向,然后将其汇编成模型特定执行策略. 可靠的要求保持不变,而不可靠的要求则有选择地被改写或汇编成替代执行战略。 我们引入了VCom Bench, 一个由380个组成,多要求任务构成的基准, 跨越了文本到视频,图像到视频, 和参考到视频生成。 NeurCo将Wan的需求量满意度从46.8%提高到52.3%,而Minimax H3的满意度从66.5%提高到69.3%,如果与快速增强器相结合,包括在种子2.5上,就能取得进一步的收益。 我们的分析显示,可控性和光现实性之间在控制能力和取舍方面的模型差异,突出了能力指导汇编是可编程基因视频渲染的一种有希望的方法。

articles.title: EPPC-CARE: Staged Hierarchical Annotation of Communication Behaviors in Secure Patient-Provider Messages
articles.content: Objectives: Patient portal messages provide invaluable information about communication dynamics between patients and healthcare providers, but extracting it manually is labor-intensive. We developed and evaluated EPPC-CARE, an automated framework for identifying communication behaviors together with the supporting text for each classification. Materials and Methods: From 867 messages, we obtained 5,516 reference standard annotations. Each annotation is a triplet of communication-related text (span), a broader communication category (Code), and a specific subcategory (Sub-code). We evaluated EPPC-CARE's identified triplets across six open-weight large language models (LLMs) against supervised fine-tuning and communication-based models such as EPPC-OASIS. We also compared EPPC-CARE with human expert annotations on 100 messages. Results: EPPC-CARE improved performance over EPPC-OASIS across all six models. EPPC-CARE's Triplet F1 improved by 2.90 percentage points on average, with a best score of 64.4%. On the human expert evaluation subset, EPPC-CARE and the human expert showed comparable agreement with the reference standard, with differences favoring EPPC-CARE. Discussion: These findings suggest that identifying triplet components (span, code, subcode) sequentially can improve performance across model families while preserving the supporting text behind each identification. EPPC-CARE links the communication code and subcode with the source text (span), supporting human verification of automated annotations in clinical informatics. EPPC-CARE may therefore make larger-scale studies of patient-provider communication more feasible and provide a foundation for human-in-the-loop annotation workflows. Conclusion: EPPC-CARE offers a more reliable and reviewable approach for automated characterization of communication behaviors in secure patient-provider messaging.

articles.title_zh: EPPC-CARE: 安全病人-提供信件中通信行为的分阶段分级说明
articles.content_zh: 目标:病人门户网站信息提供有关病人与保健提供者之间交流动态的宝贵信息,但人工提取信息需要劳动密集型。 我们开发并评价了EPPC-CARE,这是一个自动框架,用于识别通信行为,以及每种分类的辅助文本。 材料和方法: 从867条信息中,我们获得了5,516个参考标准说明. 每条注释是通信相关文本(span),更广泛的通信类别(Code)和特定的子类别(Sub-code)的三重音. 我们对照EPPC-OASIS等有监督的微调和通信模式,评估了EPPC-CARE在6个开放量大语言模型(LLMs)中确定的三重体. 我们还将EPPC-CARE与关于100条信息的人类专家说明相比较。 成果:在六个模式中,欧洲石油伙伴关系中心-欧洲石油伙伴关系中心的业绩都比欧洲石油伙伴关系中心-美洲组织信息系统有所改善。 EPPC-CARE的Triplet F1平均改进2.90个百分点,最佳得分64.4%. 在人类专家评价子集方面,EPPC-CARE和人类专家表现出与参考标准相当的一致,不同的是赞成EPPC-CARE。 讨论: 这些调查结果表明,相继确定三重元件(span,代码,子代码)可以改善各模范家族的性能,同时保留每次识别背后的支持文本. EPPC-CARE将通信代码和子代码与源文本(span)相连接,支持临床信息学中自动注释的人类验证. 因此,EPPC-CARE可以使更大规模地研究病人与提供者之间的沟通更为可行,并为人与人之间的通知工作流程提供基础。 结论:EPPC-CARE为在安全的病人-提供者信息传递中自动描述通信行为提供了一个更可靠和可审查的方法。

articles.title: AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base
articles.content: We present AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base, a mixture-of-experts language model with 80 billion total parameters and approximately 3 billion active parameters per token, trained from scratch at Yandex and released under the Apache 2.0 license. The model combines Kimi Delta Attention with full attention, uses Attention Residuals, and is trained with Muon. Training comprises general pretraining on 17.5 trillion tokens, two context-extension stages, and a dedicated stage for reasoning and agentic interaction. We describe the data collection and augmentation pipelines, evaluation protocols, architectural ablations, and scaling-law experiments. We identify the limitations of held-out training loss as a proxy for downstream performance and introduce an auxiliary loss on mixture-of-experts outputs to stabilize training at the predicted learning rate. Domain-specific data selection and augmentation improve factual knowledge, mathematics, and programming skills, while agent trajectories introduced during pretraining improve performance on agentic benchmarks after supervised fine-tuning. In zero-shot reasoning evaluation, the model achieves leading results among open base models of comparable size, with 88.7% pass@8 on IMO-AnswerBench and 82.9% pass@8 on LiveCodeBench v5-v6. To evaluate Russian-language factual knowledge, we introduce and release two benchmarks with their evaluation protocols: WikiWebFacts, which tests short factual questions drawn from encyclopedic sources and search queries, and HardMultiQA, which tests more demanding factual questions inspired by user interactions. Our model scores 86.5% on WikiWebFacts and 67.9% on HardMultiQA, compared with 83.2% and 65.4% for DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base (284B total and 13B active parameters) and 72.8% and 54.5% for Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-Base (120B total and 12B active parameters), outperforming both larger models on these benchmarks.

articles.title_zh: 爱丽丝-基金会-80B-A3B-Base
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base,是一种专家混合语言模型,总参数为800亿个,每个符牌的活性参数约为30亿个,在Yandex从零开始训练,并以Apache 2.0许可证发行. 该模型将基米三角洲注意力与全注意力结合起来,使用注意力残余,并被与穆恩一起训练. 培训包括17.5万亿令牌的一般预训、两个上下文延伸阶段和一个推理和代理互动的专门阶段。 我们描述了数据收集和增强管道、评估协议、建筑模拟和缩放法实验。 我们确定被搁置培训损失的局限性,作为下游业绩的取而代之,并引入专家混合产出的辅助损失,使培训稳定在预测的学习速度。 特定领域的数据选择和增强提高了实际知识、数学和编程技能,而在前期培训中引入的代理轨迹在经过监督的微调后提高了代理基准的性能。 在零镜头推理评价中,该模型在可比较大小的开放基模型中取得了领先结果,有88.7%通过@8的IMO-Answer Bench,82.9%通过@8的LiveCode Bench v5-v6. 为了评价俄语实事求是的知识,我们引入并发布了两个带有其评价协议的基准:WikiWebFacts测试从百科全书来源和搜索查询中提取的简短实事求是的问题;Hard MultiQA测试由用户互动所激发的更严格的实事求是的问题. 我们的模型在WikiWebFacts和Hard MultiQA上的得分分别为86.5%和67.9%,而DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base的得分分别为83.2%和65.4%(共计284B和13B活性参数),而Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-Base的得分则分别为72.8%和54.5%(共计120B和12B活性参数),在这些基准上这两个较大的模型都表现得更好.
